




|| namau tassa bhagavatau arahatau sammāsambuddhassa||

dīghanikāyai

sīlakkhandhavaggaabhinavaṭīkā

ganthārambhakathā

yau  daisaitvāna saddhammaṃ, gambhīraṃ duddasaṃ varaṃ|

dīghadassī ciraṃ kālaṃ, patiṭṭhāpaisi sāsanaṃ||1||

vinaiyyajjhāsayai chaikaṃ, mahāmatiṃ mahādayaṃ|

natvāna taṃ sasaddhammagaṇaṃ gāravabhājanaṃ||2||

saṅgītittayamāruḷhā, dīghāgamavarassa yā|

saṃvaṇṇanā yā ca tassā, vaṇṇanā sādhuvaṇṇitā|| 3||

ācariyadhammapāla-  tthairainaivābhisaṅkhatā|

sammā nipuṇagambhīra-duddasatthappakāsanā||4||

kāmañ‍ca sā tathābhūtā, paramparābhatā pana|

pāṭhatau atthatau cāpi, bahuppamādalaikhanā||5||

saṅkhaipattā ca sautūhi, sammā ñātuṃ suduk‍karā|

tasmā sabrahmacārīnaṃ, yācanaṃ samanussaraṃ||6||

yau’naikasaitanāgindau, rājā nānāraṭṭhissarau|

sāsanasaudhanai daḷhaṃ, sadā ussāhamānasau||7||

taṃ nissāya ‘‘mamaisaupi, satthusāsanajautanai|

appaiva nāmupatthambhau, bhavaiyyā’’ti vicintayaṃ||8||

vaṇṇanaṃ  ārabhissāmi, sādhippāyamahāpayaṃ|

atthaṃ tamupanissāya, añ‍ñañ‍cāpi yathārahaṃ||9||

cak‍kābhivuḍḍhikāmānaṃ, dhīrānaṃ cittatausanaṃ|

sādhuvilāsiniṃ nāma, taṃ suṇātha samāhitāti|| 10||

ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā

nānānayanipuṇagambhīravicitrasikkhattayasaṅgahassa buddhānubuddhasaṃvaṇṇitassa saddhāvahaguṇasampan‍nassa dīghāgamavarassa gambhīraduranubaudhatthadīpakaṃ saṃvaṇṇanamimaṃ karauntau sakasamayasamayantaragahanajjhaugāhanasamatthau mahāvaiyyākaraṇauyamācariyau saṃvaṇṇanārambhai ratanattayapaṇāmapayaujanādividhānāni karauntau paṭhamaṃ tāva ratanattayapaṇāmaṃ kātuṃ ‘‘karuṇāsītalahadaya’’ntiādimāha| aittha ca saṃvaṇṇanārambhai ratanattayapaṇāmakaraṇappayaujanaṃ tattha tattha bahudhā papañ‍cainti ācariyā| tathā hi vaṇṇayanti –

‘‘saṃvaṇṇanārambhai  satthari paṇāmakaraṇaṃ dhammassa svākkhātabhāvaina satthari pasādajananatthaṃ, satthu ca avitathadaisanabhāvappakāsanaina dhammai pasādajananatthaṃ| tadubhayappasādā hi mahatau atthassa siddhi hautī’’ti (dha॰ sa॰ ṭī॰ 1-1)|

atha vā ‘‘ratanattayapaṇāmavacanaṃ attanau ratanattayappasādassa viñ‍ñāpanatthaṃ, taṃ pana viñ‍ñūnaṃ cittārādhanatthaṃ, taṃ aṭṭhakathāya gāhaṇatthaṃ, taṃ sabbasampattinipphādanattha’’nti| atha vā ‘‘saṃvaṇṇanārambhai ratanattayavandanā saṃvaṇṇaitabbassa dhammassa pabhavanissayavisuddhipaṭivaidanatthaṃ, taṃ pana dhammasaṃvaṇṇanāsu viñ‍ñūnaṃ bahumānuppādanatthaṃ, taṃ sammadaiva taisaṃ uggahaṇadhāraṇādik‍kamaladdhabbāya sammāpaṭipattiyā sabbahitasukhanipphādanattha’’nti| atha vā ‘‘maṅgalabhāvatau, sabbakiriyāsu pubbakic‍cabhāvatau, paṇḍitaihi samācaritabhāvatau, āyatiṃ paraisaṃ diṭṭhānugatiāpaj‍janatau ca saṃvaṇṇanāyaṃ ratanattayapaṇāmakiriyā’’ti| atha vā ‘‘catugambhīrabhāvayuttaṃ dhammavinayaṃ saṃvaṇṇaitukāmassa mahāsamuddaṃ augāhantassa viya pañ‍ñāvaiyyattiyasaman‍nāgatassāpi mahantaṃ bhayaṃ sambhavati, bhayakkhayāvahañ‍caitaṃ ratanattayaguṇānussaraṇajanitaṃ  paṇāmapūjāvidhānaṃ, tatau ca saṃvaṇṇanāyaṃ ratanattayapaṇāmakiriyā’’ti| atha vā ‘‘asattharipi satthābhinivaisassa laukassa yathābhūtaṃ satthari aiva sammāsambuddhai satthusambhāvanatthaṃ, asatthari ca satthusambhāvanaparic‍cajāpanatthaṃ, ‘tathāgatappavaiditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ pariyāpuṇitvā attanau dahatī’ti (pārā॰ 195) ca vuttadausapariharaṇatthaṃ saṃvaṇṇanāyaṃ paṇāmakiriyā’’ti| atha vā ‘‘buddhassa bhagavatau paṇāmavidhānaina sammāsambuddhabhāvādhigamāya buddhayānaṃ paṭipaj‍jantānaṃ ussāhajananatthaṃ, saddhammassa ca paṇāmavidhānaina pac‍caikabuddhabhāvādhigamāya pac‍caikabuddhayānaṃ paṭipaj‍jantānaṃ ussāhajananatthaṃ, saṅghassa ca paṇāmavidhānaina paramatthasaṅghabhāvādhigamāya sāvakayānaṃ paṭipaj‍jantānaṃ ussāhajananatthaṃ saṃvaṇṇanāyaṃ paṇāmakiriyā’’ti| atha vā ‘‘maṅgalādikāni satthāni anantarāyāni, ciraṭṭhitikāni, bahumatāni ca bhavantīti aivaṃladdhikānaṃ cittaparitausanatthaṃ saṃvaṇṇanāyaṃ paṇāmakiriyā’’ti| atha vā ‘‘sautujanānaṃ yathāvuttapaṇāmaina anantarāyaina uggahaṇadhāraṇādinipphādanatthaṃ saṃvaṇṇanāyaṃ paṇāmakiriyā| sautujanānuggahamaiva hi padhānaṃ katvā ācariyaihi saṃvaṇṇanārambhai thutipaṇāmaparidīpakāni vākyāni nikkhipīyanti, itarathā vināpi taṃ nikkhaipaṃ kāyamanaupaṇāmainaiva yathādhippaitappayaujanasiddhitau kimaitaina ganthagāravakaraṇainā’’ti ca aivamādinā| mayaṃ pana idhādhippaitamaiva payaujanaṃ dassayissāma, tasmā saṃvaṇṇanārambhai ratanattayapaṇāmakaraṇaṃ yathāpaṭiñ‍ñātasaṃvaṇṇanāya anantarāyaina parisamāpanatthanti vaiditabbaṃ| idamaiva ca payaujanaṃ ācariyaina idhādhippaitaṃ| tathā hi vakkhati ‘‘iti mai pasan‍namatinau  …pai॰… tassānubhāvainā’’ti| ratanattayapaṇāmakaraṇañhi yathāpaṭiñ‍ñātasaṃvaṇṇanāya anantarāyaina parisamāpanatthaṃ ratanattayapūjāya pañ‍ñāpāṭavabhāvatau, tāya ca pañ‍ñāpāṭavaṃ rāgādimalavidhamanatau| vuttañhaitaṃ –

‘‘yasmiṃ mahānāma samayai ariyasāvakau tathāgataṃ anussarati, naivassa tasmiṃ samayai rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hauti, na dausapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hauti, na mauhapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hauti, ujugatamaivassa tasmiṃ samayai cittaṃ hautī’’tiādi (a॰ ni॰ 6.10; a॰ ni॰ 11.11)|

tasmā  ratanattayapūjāya vikkhālitamalāya pañ‍ñāya pāṭavasiddhi| atha vā ratanattayapūjāya pañ‍ñāpadaṭṭhānasamādhihaituttā pañ‍ñāpāṭavaṃ| vuttañhaitaṃ –

‘‘ujugatacittau khau pana mahānāma ariyasāvakau labhati atthavaidaṃ, labhati dhammavaidaṃ, labhati dhammaupasaṃhitaṃ pāmauj‍jaṃ, pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyau passambhati, passaddhakāyau sukhaṃ vaidayati, sukhinau cittaṃ samādhiyatī’’ti (a॰ ni॰ 6.10; a॰ ni॰ 11.11)|

samādhissa ca pañ‍ñāya padaṭṭhānabhāvau ‘‘samāhitau yathābhūtaṃ pajānātī’’ti (saṃ॰ ni॰ 3.5; 4.99; 5.1071; naitti॰ 40; paiṭakau॰ 66; mi॰ pa॰ 14) vuttauyaiva| tatau aivaṃ paṭubhūtāya pañ‍ñāya khaidamabhibhuyya paṭiñ‍ñātaṃ saṃvaṇṇanaṃ samāpayissati| taina vuttaṃ ‘‘ratanattayapaṇāmakaraṇañhi…pai॰… pañ‍ñāpāṭavabhāvatau’’ti| atha vā ratanattayapūjāya āyuvaṇṇasukhabalavaḍḍhanatau anantarāyaina parisamāpanaṃ vaiditabbaṃ| ratanattayapaṇāmaina hi āyuvaṇṇasukhabalāni vaḍḍhanti| vuttañhaitaṃ –

‘‘abhivādanasīlissa, nic‍caṃ vuḍḍhāpacāyinau|

cattārau dhammā vaḍḍhanti, āyu vaṇṇau sukhaṃ bala’’nti|| (dha॰ pa॰ 109)|

tatau āyuvaṇṇasukhabalavuddhiyā hautvaiva kāriyaniṭṭhānanti vuttaṃ ‘‘ratanattayapūjāya āyu…pai॰… vaiditabba’’nti| atha vā ratanattayapūjāya paṭibhānāparihānāvahattā anantarāyaina parisamāpanaṃ vaiditabbaṃ| aparihānāvahā hi ratanattayapūjā| vuttañhaitaṃ –

‘‘sattimai  bhikkhavai, aparihānīyā dhammā, katamai satta? satthugāravatā, dhammagāravatā, saṅghagāravatā, sikkhāgāravatā, samādhigāravatā, kalyāṇamittatā, sauvacassatā’’ti (a॰ ni॰ 7.34) tatau paṭibhānāparihānaina hautvaiva yathāpaṭiñ‍ñātaparisamāpananti vuttaṃ ‘‘ratanattaya…pai॰… vaiditabba’’nti| atha vā pasādavatthūsu pūjāya puñ‍ñātisayabhāvatau anantarāyaina parisamāpanaṃ vaiditabbaṃ| puñ‍ñātisayā hi pasādavatthūsu pūjā| vuttañhaitaṃ –

‘‘pūjārahai  pūjayatau, buddhai yadiva sāvakai|

papañ‍casamatik‍kantai, tiṇṇasaukapariddavai||

tai tādisai pūjayatau, nibbutai akutaubhayai|

na sak‍kā puñ‍ñaṃ saṅkhātuṃ, imaittamapi kainacī’’ti|| (khu॰ pā॰ 196; apa॰ 1.10.2)|

puñ‍ñātisayau ca yathādhippaitaparisamāpanupāyau| yathāha –

‘‘aisa daivamanussānaṃ, sabbakāmadadau nidhi|

yaṃ yadaivābhipatthainti, sabbamaitaina labbhatī’’ti|| (khu॰ pā॰ 8.10)|

upāyaisu ca paṭipan‍nassa hautvaiva kāriyaniṭṭhānanti vuttaṃ ‘‘pasādavatthūsu…pai॰… vaiditabba’’nti| aivaṃ ratanattayapūjā niratisayapuñ‍ñakkhaittasambuddhiyā aparimaiyyappabhāvau puñ‍ñātisayauti bahuvidhantarāyaipi laukasan‍nivāsai antarāyanibandhanasakalasaṃkilaisaviddhaṃsanāya pahauti, bhayādiupaddavañ‍ca nivāraiti| tasmā suvuttaṃ ‘‘saṃvaṇṇanārambhai ratanattayapaṇāmakaraṇaṃ yathāpaṭiñ‍ñātasaṃvaṇṇanāya anantarāyaina parisamāpanatthanti vaiditabba’’nti|

aivaṃ pana sapayaujanaṃ ratanattayapaṇāmaṃ kattukāmau buddharatanamūlakattā saisaratanānaṃ paṭhamaṃ tassa paṇāmaṃ kātumāha – ‘‘karuṇāsītalahadayaṃ…pai॰… gativimutta’’nti| buddharatanamūlakāni hi dhammasaṅgharatanāni, taisu ca dhammaratanamūlakaṃ saṅgharatanaṃ, tathābhāvau ca ‘‘puṇṇacandau viya bhagavā, candakiraṇanikarau viya taina daisitau dhammau, candakiraṇasamuppāditapīṇitau laukau viya saṅghau’’ti aivamādīhi aṭṭhakathāyamāgataupamāhi vibhāvaitabbau| atha vā sabbasattānaṃ aggauti katvā paṭhamaṃ buddhau, tappabhavatau, tadupadaisitatau ca tadanantaraṃ dhammau, tassa dhammassa sādhāraṇatau, tadāsaivanatau ca tadanantaraṃ saṅghau vuttau| ‘‘sabbasattānaṃ vā hitai viniyaujakauti katvā paṭhamaṃ buddhau, sabbasattahitattā tadanantaraṃ dhammau, hitādhigamāya paṭipan‍nau adhigatahitau cāti katvā tadanantaraṃ saṅghau vuttau’’ti aṭṭhakathāgatanayaina anupubbatā vaiditabbā|

buddharatanapaṇāmañ‍ca  karauntau kaivalapaṇāmatau thaumanāpubbaṅgamauvasātisayauti ‘‘karuṇāsītalahadaya’’ntiādipadaihi thaumanāpubbaṅgamataṃ dassaiti| thaumanāpubbaṅgamaina hi paṇāmaina satthu guṇātisayayaugau, tatau cassa anuttaravandanīyabhāvau, taina ca attanau paṇāmassa khaittaṅgatabhāvau, taina cassa khaittaṅgatassa paṇāmassa yathādhippaitanipphattihaitubhāvau dassitauti| thaumanāpubbaṅgamatañ‍ca dassaintau yassā saṃvaṇṇanaṃ kattukāmau, sā suttantadaisanā karuṇāpañ‍ñāppadhānāyaiva, na vinayadaisanā viya karuṇāppadhānā, nāpi abhidhammadaisanā viya pañ‍ñāppadhānāti tadubhayappadhānamaiva thaumanamārabhati| aisā hi ācariyassa pakati, yadidaṃ ārambhānurūpathaumanā| tainaiva ca vinayadaisanāya saṃvaṇṇanārambhai ‘‘yau kappakauṭīhipi…pai॰… mahākāruṇikassa tassā’’ti (pārā॰ aṭṭha॰ ganthārambhakathā) karuṇāppadhānaṃ, abhidhammadaisanāya saṃvaṇṇanārambhai ‘‘karuṇā viya…pai॰… yathārucī’’ti (dha॰ sa॰ aṭṭha॰ 1) pañ‍ñāppadhānañ‍ca thaumanamāraddhaṃ| vinayadaisanā hi āsayādinirapaikkhakaivalakaruṇāya pākatikasattaināpi asautabbārahaṃ suṇantau, apucchitabbārahaṃ pucchantau, avattabbārahañ‍ca vadantau sikkhāpadaṃ pañ‍ñapaisīti karuṇāppadhānā| tathā hi uk‍kaṃsapariyantagatahirauttappaupi bhagavā laukiyasādhujanaihipi pariharitabbāni ‘‘sikharaṇī, sambhin‍nā’’tiādivacanāni, (pārā॰ 185) yathāparādhañ‍ca garahavacanāni mahākaruṇāsañ‍cauditamānasau mahāparisamajjhai abhāsi, taṃtaṃsikkhāpadapañ‍ñatti kāraṇāpaikkhāya ca vairañ‍jādīsu sārīrikaṃ khaidamanubhausi| tasmā kiñ‍cāpi bhūmantarapac‍cayākārasamayantarakathānaṃ viya vinayapañ‍ñattiyāpi samuṭṭhāpikā pañ‍ñā anañ‍ñasādhāraṇatāya atisayakic‍cavatī, karuṇāya kic‍caṃ pana tataupi adhikanti vinayadaisanāya karuṇāppadhānatā vuttā| karuṇābyāpārādhikatāya hi daisanāya karuṇāpadhānatā, abhidhammadaisanā pana kaivalapañ‍ñāppadhānā paramatthadhammānaṃ yathāsabhāvapaṭivaidhasamatthāya pañ‍ñāya tattha sātisayappavattitau| suttantadaisanā pana karuṇāpañ‍ñāppadhānā taisaṃ taisaṃ sattānaṃ āsayānusayādhimutticaritādibhaidaparicchindanasamatthāya pañ‍ñāya sattaisu ca mahākaruṇāya tattha sātisayappavattitau| suttantadaisanāya hi mahākaruṇāya samāpattibahulau vinaiyyasantānai tadajjhāsayānulaumaina  gambhīramatthapadaṃ patiṭṭhapaisi| tasmā ārambhānurūpaṃ karuṇāpañ‍ñāppadhānamaiva thaumanaṃ katanti vaiditabbaṃ, ayamaittha samudāyatthau|

ayaṃ  pana avayavatthau – kiratīti karuṇā, paradukkhaṃ vikkhipati pac‍cayavaikal‍lakaraṇaina apanaitīti atthau| dukkhitaisu vā kiriyati pasāriyatīti karuṇā| atha vā kiṇātīti karuṇā, paradukkhai sati kāruṇikaṃ hiṃsati vibādhati, paradukkhaṃ vā vināsaitīti atthau| paradukkhai sati sādhūnaṃ kampanaṃ hadayakhaidaṃ karautīti vā karuṇā| atha vā kamiti sukhaṃ, taṃ rundhatīti karuṇā| aisā hi paradukkhāpanayanakāmatālakkhaṇā attasukhanirapaikkhatāya kāruṇikānaṃ sukhaṃ rundhati vibandhatīti, sabbattha saddasatthānusāraina padanipphatti vaiditabbā| uṇhābhitattaihi saivīyatīti sītaṃ, uṇhābhisamanaṃ| taṃ lāti gaṇhātīti sītalaṃ, ‘‘cittaṃ vā tai khipissāmi, hadayaṃ vā tai phālaissāmī’’ti (saṃ॰ ni॰ 1.246; su॰ ni॰ āḷavakasutta) aittha urau ‘‘hadaya’’nti vuttaṃ, ‘‘vak‍kaṃ hadaya’’nti (ma॰ ni॰ 1.110; 2.114; 3.154) aittha hadayavatthu, ‘‘hadayā hadayaṃ mañ‍ñai añ‍ñāya tacchatī’’ti (ma॰ ni॰ 1.63) aittha cittaṃ, idhāpi cittamaiva abbhantaraṭṭhaina hadayaṃ| attanau sabhāvaṃ vā haratīti hadayaṃ, ra-kārassa da-kāraṃ katvāti nairuttikā| karuṇāya sītalaṃ hadayamassāti karuṇāsītalahadayau, taṃ karuṇāsītalahadayaṃ| 

kāmañ‍caittha paraisaṃ hitaupasaṃhārasukhādiaparihānijjhānasabhāvatāya, byāpādādīnaṃ ujuvipac‍canīkatāya ca sattasantānagatasantāpavicchaidanākārappavattiyā maittāmuditānampi cittasītalabhāvakāraṇatā upalabbhati, tathāpi paradukkhāpanayanākārappavattiyā parūpatāpāsahanarasā avihiṃsābhūtā karuṇāva visaisaina bhagavatau cittassa cittapassaddhi viya sītibhāvanimittanti tassāyaiva cittasītalabhāvakāraṇatā vuttā| karuṇāmukhaina vā maittāmuditānampi hadayasītalabhāvakāraṇatā vuttāti daṭṭhabbaṃ| na hi sabbattha niravasaisatthau upadisīyati, padhānasahacaraṇāvinābhāvādinayaihipi yathālabbhamānaṃ gayhamānattā| apicaittha taṃsampayuttañāṇassa chaasādhāraṇañāṇapariyāpan‍natāya asādhāraṇañāṇavisaisanibandhanabhūtā sātisayaṃ, niravasaisañ‍ca sabbañ‍ñutañ‍ñāṇaṃ  viya savisayabyāpitāya mahākaruṇābhāvamupagatā anañ‍ñasādhāraṇasātisayabhāvappattā karuṇāva hadayasītalattahaitubhāvaina vuttā| atha vā satipi maittāmuditānaṃ paraisaṃ hitaupasaṃhārasukhādiaparihānijjhānasabhāvatāya sātisayai hadayasītalabhāvanibandhanattai sakalabuddhaguṇavisaisakāraṇatāya tāsampi kāraṇanti karuṇāya aiva hadayasītalabhāvakāraṇatā vuttā| karuṇānidānā hi sabbaipi buddhaguṇā| karuṇānubhāvanibbāpiyamānasaṃsāradukkhasantāpassa hi bhagavatau paradukkhāpanayanakāmatāya anaikānipi kappānamasaṅkhyaiyyāni akilantarūpassaiva niravasaisabuddhakaradhammasambharaṇaniratassa samadhigatadhammādhipataiyyassa ca san‍nihitaisupi sattasaṅghātasamupanītahadayūpatāpanimittaisu na īsakampi  cittasītibhāvassa añ‍ñathattamahausīti| tīsu caittha vikappaisu paṭhamai vikappai avisaisabhūtā buddhabhūmigatā, dutiyai tathaiva mahākaruṇābhāvūpagatā, tatiyai paṭhamābhinīhāratau paṭṭhāya tīsupi avatthāsu pavattā bhagavatau karuṇā saṅgahitāti daṭṭhabbaṃ|

pajānātīti pañ‍ñā, yathāsabhāvaṃ pakāraihi paṭivijjhatīti atthau| pañ‍ñapaitīti vā pañ‍ñā, taṃ tadatthaṃ pākaṭaṃ karautīti atthau| sāyaiva ñaiyyāvaraṇappahānatau pakāraihi dhammasabhāvajautanaṭṭhaina paj‍jautauti pañ‍ñāpaj‍jautau| pañ‍ñavatau hi aikapal‍laṅkainapi nisin‍nassa dasasahassilaukadhātu aikapaj‍jautā hauti| vuttañhaitaṃ bhagavatā ‘‘cattāraumai bhikkhavai, paj‍jautā| katamai cattārau? candapaj‍jautau, sūriyapaj‍jautau, aggipaj‍jautau, pañ‍ñāpaj‍jautau, imai khau bhikkhavai, cattārau paj‍jautā| aitadaggaṃ bhikkhavai, imaisaṃ catun‍naṃ paj‍jautānaṃ yadidaṃ pañ‍ñāpaj‍jautau’’ti (a॰ ni॰ 4.145)| taina vihatau visaisaina samugghāṭitauti pañ‍ñāpaj‍jautavihatau, visaisatā caittha upari āvi bhavissati| muyhanti taina, sayaṃ vā muyhati, muyhanamattamaiva vā tanti mauhau, avij‍jā| svaiva visayasabhāvapaṭicchādanatau andhakārasarikkhatāya tamau viyāti mauhatamau| satipi tamasaddassa sadisakappanamantaraina avij‍jāvācakattai mauhasaddasan‍nidhānaina tabbisaisakatāvaittha yuttāti sadisakappanā| pañ‍ñāpaj‍jautavihatau mauhatamau  yassāti pañ‍ñāpaj‍jautavihatamauhatamau, taṃ pañ‍ñāpaj‍jautavihatamauhatamaṃ|

nanu ca sabbaisampi khīṇāsavānaṃ pañ‍ñāpaj‍jautaina avij‍jandhakārahatatā sambhavati, atha kasmā añ‍ñasādhāraṇāvisaisaguṇaina bhagavatau thaumanā vuttāti? savāsanappahānaina anañ‍ñasādhāraṇavisaisatāsambhavatau| sabbaisampi hi khīṇāsavānaṃ pañ‍ñāpaj‍jautahatāvij‍jandhakārattaipi sati saddhādhimuttaihi viya diṭṭhippattānaṃ sāvakapac‍caikabuddhaihi sammāsambuddhānaṃ savāsanappahānaina kilaisappahānassa visaisau vij‍jataivāti| atha vā paraupadaisamantaraina attanau santānai ac‍cantaṃ avij‍jandhakāravigamassa nipphāditattā (nibbattitattā ma॰ ni॰ ṭī॰ 1.1), tattha ca sabbañ‍ñutāya balaisu ca vasībhāvassa samadhigatattā, parasantatiyañ‍ca dhammadaisanātisayānubhāvaina sammadaiva tassa pavattitattā, bhagavāyaiva visaisatau pañ‍ñāpaj‍jautavihatamauhatamabhāvaina thaumaitabbauti| imasmiñ‍ca atthavikappai pañ‍ñāpaj‍jautapadaina sasantānagatamauhavidhamanā paṭivaidhapañ‍ñā caiva parasantānagatamauhavidhamanā daisanāpañ‍ñā ca sāmañ‍ñaniddaisaina, aikasaisanayaina vā saṅgahitā| na tu purimasmiṃ atthavikappai viya paṭivaidhapañ‍ñāyaivāti vaiditabbaṃ|

aparau  nayau – bhagavatau ñāṇassa ñaiyyapariyantikattā sakalañaiyyadhammasabhāvāvabaudhanasamatthaina anāvaraṇañāṇasaṅkhātaina pañ‍ñāpaj‍jautaina sakalañaiyyadhammasabhāvacchādakamauhatamassa vihatattā anāvaraṇañāṇabhūtaina anañ‍ñasādhāraṇapañ‍ñāpaj‍jautavihatamauhatamabhāvaina bhagavatau thaumanā vaiditabbā| imasmiṃ pana atthavikappai mauhatamavidhamanantai adhigatattā anāvaraṇañāṇaṃ kāraṇūpacāraina sakasantānai mauhatamavidhamananti vaiditabbaṃ| abhinīhārasampattiyā savāsanappahānamaiva hi kilaisānaṃ ñaiyyāvaraṇappahānanti, parasantānai pana mauhatamavidhamanassa kāraṇabhāvatau phalūpacāraina anāvaraṇañāṇamaiva mauhatamavidhamananti vuc‍cati| anāvaraṇañāṇanti ca sabbañ‍ñutañ‍ñāṇamaiva, yaina dhammadaisanāpac‍cavaikkhaṇāni karauti| tadidañhi ñāṇadvayaṃ atthatau aikamaiva| anavasaisasaṅkhatāsaṅkhatasammutidhammārammaṇatāya sabbañ‍ñutañ‍ñāṇaṃ  tatthāvaraṇābhāvatau nissaṅgacāramupādāya anāvaraṇañāṇanti, visayappavattimukhaina pana añ‍ñaihi asādhāraṇabhāvadassanatthaṃ dvidhā katvā chaḷāsādhāraṇañāṇabhaidai vuttaṃ|

kiṃ panaittha kāraṇaṃ avij‍jāsamugghātauyaivaikau pahānasampattivasaina bhagavatau thaumanāya gayhati, na pana sātisayaṃ niravasaisakilaisappahānanti? vuc‍catai – tappahānavacanainaiva hi tadaikaṭṭhatāya sakalasaṃkilaisasamugghātassa jautitabhāvatau niravasaisakilaisappahānamaittha gayhati| na hi sau saṃkilaisau atthi, yau niravasaisāvij‍jāsamugghātanaina na pahīyatīti| atha vā sakalakusaladhammuppattiyā, saṃsāranivattiyā ca vij‍jā viya niravasaisākusaladhammuppattiyā, saṃsārappavattiyā ca avij‍jāyaiva padhānakāraṇanti tabbighātavacanainaiva sakalasaṃkilaisasamugghātavacanasiddhitau sauyaivaikau gayhatīti| atha vā sakalasaṃkilaisadhammānaṃ muddhabhūtattā avij‍jāya taṃ samugghātauyaivaikau gayhati| yathāha –

‘‘avij‍jā muddhāti jānāhi, vij‍jā muddhādhipātinī|

saddhāsatisamādhīhi, chandavīriyaina saṃyutā’’ti|| (su॰ ni॰ 1032; cūḷa॰ ni॰ 51)|

sanarāmaralaukagarunti aittha pana paṭhamapakatiyā avibhāgaina sattaupi narauti vuc‍cati, idha pana dutiyapakatiyā manujapurisauyaiva, itarathā laukasaddassa avattabbatā siyā| ‘‘yathā hi paṭhamapakatibhūtau sattau itarāya pakatiyā saiṭṭhaṭṭhaina purai uc‍caṭṭhānai saiti pavattatīti purisauti vuc‍cati, aivaṃ jaiṭṭhabhāvaṃ naitīti narauti| puttabhātubhūtaupi hi puggalau mātujaiṭṭhabhaginīnaṃ pituṭṭhānai  tiṭṭhati, pagaiva bhattubhūtau itarāsa’’nti (vi॰ aṭṭha॰ 43-46) nāvāvimānavaṇṇanāyaṃ vuttaṃ| aikasaisappakappanaina puthuvacanantaviggahaina vā narā, maraṇaṃ marau, sau natthi yaisanti amarā, saha naraihi, amaraihi cāti sanarāmarau|garati uggacchati uggatau pākaṭau bhavatīti garu, garasaddau hi uggamai| apica pāsāṇacchattaṃ viya bhāriyaṭṭhaina ‘‘garū’’ti vuc‍cati|

mātāpitācariyaisu, duj‍jarai alahumhi ca|

mahantai cuggatai caiva, nichaikādikaraisu ca|

tathā vaṇṇavisaisaisu, garusaddau pavattati||

idha pana sabbalaukācariyai tathāgatai| kaici pana ‘‘garu, gurūti ca dvidhā gahaitvā bhāriyavācakattai garusaddau, ācariyavācakattai tu gurusaddau’’ti vadanti, taṃ na gahaitabbaṃ| pāḷivisayai hi sabbaisampi yathāvuttānamatthānaṃ vācakattai garusaddauyaivicchitabbau akārassa ākārabhāvaina ‘‘gārava’’nti taddhitantapadassa savuddhikassa dassanatau| sak‍katabhāsāvisayai pana gurusaddauyaivicchitabbau ukārassa vuddhibhāvaina añ‍ñathā taddhitantapadassa dassanatauti| sanarāmarau ca sau laukau cāti sanarāmaralaukau, tassa garūti tathā, taṃ sanarāmaralaukagaruṃ| ‘‘sanaramarūlaukagaru’’ntipi paṭhanti, tadapi ariyāgāthattā vuttilakkhaṇatau, atthatau ca yuttamaiva| atthatau hi dīghāyukāpi samānā yathāparicchaidaṃ maraṇasabhāvattā marūti daivā vuc‍canti| aitaina daivamanussānaṃ viya tadavasiṭṭhasattānampi yathārahaṃ guṇavisaisāvahatāya bhagavatau upakārakataṃ dassaiti| nanu caittha daivamanussā padhānabhūtā, atha kasmā taisaṃ appadhānatā niddisīyatīti? atthatau padhānatāya gahaitabbattā| añ‍ñau hi saddak‍kamau, añ‍ñau atthak‍kamauti saddak‍kamānusāraina padhānāpadhānabhāvau na caudaitabbau| aidisaisu hi samāsapadaisu padhānampi appadhānaṃ viya niddisīyati yathā taṃ ‘‘sarājikāya parisāyā’’ti, tasmā sabbattha atthatauva adhippāyau gavaisitabbau, na byañ‍janamattaina| yathāhu paurāṇā –

‘‘atthañhi nāthau saraṇaṃ avauca,

na byañ‍janaṃ laukahitau mahaisi||

tasmā akatvā ratimakkharaisu,

atthai nivaisaiyya matiṃ matimā’’ti|| (kaṅkhā॰ aṭṭha॰ paṭhamapārājikakaṇḍavaṇṇanā)|

kāmañ‍caittha  sattasaṅkhārabhājanavasaina tividhau laukau, garubhāvassa pana adhippaitattā garukaraṇasamatthassaiva yuj‍janatau sattalaukavasaina atthau gahaitabbau| sau hi laukīyanti aittha puñ‍ñāpuñ‍ñāni, tabbipākau cāti laukau, dassanatthai ca laukasaddamicchanti saddavidū| amaraggahaṇaina caittha upapattidaivā adhippaitā| aparau nayau – samūhatthau aittha laukasaddau samudāyavasaina laukīyati pañ‍ñāpīyatīti katvā| saha naraihīti sanarā, taiyaiva amarāti sanarāmarā, taisaṃ laukau tathā, purimanayainaiva yaujaitabbaṃ| amarasaddaina caittha upapattidaivā viya visuddhidaivāpi saṅgayhanti| taipi hi paramatthatau maraṇābhāvatau amarā| imasmiṃ pana atthavikappai narāmarānamaiva gahaṇaṃ uk‍kaṭṭhaniddaisavasaina yathā ‘‘satthā daivamanussāna’’nti (dī॰ ni॰ 1.157, 255)| tathā hi sabbānatthaparihānapubbaṅgamāya niravasaisahitasukhavidhānatapparāya niratisayāya payaugasampattiyā, sadaivamanussāya pajāya ac‍cantamupakāritāya aparimitanirupamappabhāvaguṇasamaṅgitāya ca sabbasattuttamau bhagavā aparimāṇāsu laukadhātūsu aparimāṇānaṃ sattānaṃ uttamamanañ‍ñasādhāraṇaṃ gāravaṭṭhānanti| kāmañ‍ca itthīnampi tathāupakārattā bhagavā garuyaiva, padhānabhūtaṃ pana laukaṃ dassaituṃ purisaliṅgaina vuttanti daṭṭhabbaṃ| nairuttikā pana avisaisanicchitaṭṭhānai tathā niddiṭṭhamicchanti yathā ‘‘narā nāgā ca gandhabbā, abhivādaitvāna pak‍kamu’’nti (apa॰ 1.1.48)| tathā cāhu –

‘‘napuṃsakaina liṅgaina, saddaudāhu pumaina vā|

niddissatīti ñātabbamavisaisavinicchitai’’ti||

vandaiti aittha pana –

vattamānāya pañ‍camyaṃ, sattamyañ‍ca vibhattiyaṃ|

aitaisu tīsu ṭhānaisu, vandaisaddau pavattati||

idha pana vattamānāyaṃ añ‍ñāsamasambhavatau| tattha ca uttamapurisavasainatthau gahaitabbau ‘‘ahaṃ vandāmī’’ti| namanathutiyatthaisu ca vandasaddamicchanti ācariyā, taina ca sugatapadaṃ, nāthapadaṃ vā ajjhāharitvā yaujaitabbaṃ| saubhanaṃ gataṃ gamanaṃ aitassāti sugatau| gamanañ‍caittha kāyagamanaṃ, ñāṇagamanañ‍ca, kāyagamanampi vinaiyyajanaupasaṅkamanaṃ, pakatigamanañ‍cāti dubbidhaṃ| bhagavatau hi vinaiyyajanaupasaṅkamanaṃ aikantaina taisaṃ hitasukhanipphādanatau  saubhanaṃ, tathā lakkhaṇānubyañ‍janapaṭimaṇḍitarūpakāyatāya dutavilambitakhalitānukaḍḍhananippīḷanuk‍kuṭika-kuṭilākulatādidausarahita- mavahasitarājahaṃsa-  vasabhavāraṇamigarājagamanaṃ pakatigamanañ‍ca, vimalavipulakaruṇāsativīriyādiguṇavisaisasahitampi ñāṇagamanaṃ abhinīhāratau paṭṭhāya yāva mahābaudhi, tāva niravaj‍jatāya saubhanamaivāti| atha vā ‘‘sayambhūñāṇaina sakalampi laukaṃ pariñ‍ñābhisamayavasaina parijānantau sammā gatau avagatauti sugatau|  yau hi gatyatthau, sau buddhayatthau| yau ca buddhayatthau, sau gatyatthauti| tathā laukasamudayaṃ pahānābhisamayavasaina pajahantau anuppattidhammatamāpādaintau sammā gatau atītauti sugatau| laukaniraudhaṃ sacchikiriyābhisamayavasaina sammā gatau adhigatauti sugatau| laukaniraudhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ bhāvanābhisamayavasaina sammā gatau paṭipan‍nauti sugatau, ayañ‍catthau ‘sautāpattimaggaina yai kilaisā pahīnā, tai kilaisai na punaiti na pac‍caiti na pac‍cāgacchatī’ti (mahāni॰ 38; cūḷani॰ 27) sugatautiādinā niddaisanayaina vibhāvaitabbau|

aparau nayau – sundaraṃ sammāsambaudhiṃ, nibbānamaiva vā gatau adhigatauti sugatau| bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ atthasaṃhitaṃ yathārahaṃ kālayuttamaiva vācaṃ vinaiyyānaṃ sammā gadatīti vā sugatau, da-kārassa ta-kāraṃ katvā, taṃ sugataṃ| puñ‍ñāpuñ‍ñakammaihi upapaj‍janavasaina gantabbāti gatiyau, upapattibhavavisaisā| tā pana nirayādibhaidaina pañ‍cavidhā, sakalassāpi bhavagāmikammassa ariyamaggādhigamaina avipākārahabhāvakaraṇaina nivattitattā pañ‍cahipi tāhi visaṃyuttau hutvā muttauti gativimuttau| uddhamuddhabhavagāminau hi daivā taṃtaṃkammavipākadānakālānurūpaina tatau tatau bhavatau muttāpi muttamattāva, na pana visañ‍ñaugavasaina muttā, gatipariyāpan‍nā ca taṃtaṃbhavagāmikammassa ariyamaggaina anivattitattā, na tathā bhagavā| bhagavā pana yathāvuttappakāraina visaṃyuttau hutvā muttauti| tasmā anaina bhagavatau katthacipi gatiyā apariyāpan‍nataṃ dassaiti| yatau ca bhagavā ‘‘daivātidaivau’’ti vuc‍cati| tainaivāha –

‘‘yaina  daivūpapatyassa, gandhabbau vā vihaṅgamau|

yakkhattaṃ yaina gacchaiyyaṃ, manussattañ‍ca abbajai|

tai mayhaṃ āsavā khīṇā, viddhastā vinaḷīkatā’’ti|| (a॰ ni॰ 4.36)|

taṃtaṃgatisaṃvattanakānañhi kammakilaisānaṃ mahābaudhimūlaiyaiva aggamaggaina pahīnattā natthi bhagavatau taṃtaṃgatipariyāpan‍natāti ac‍cantamaiva bhagavā sabbabhavayaunigativiñ‍ñāṇaṭṭhitisattāvāsasattanikāyaihi parimuttauti| atha vā kāmaṃ saupādisaisāyapi nibbānadhātuyā tāhi gatīhi  vimuttau, aisā pana ‘‘pañ‍ñāpaj‍jautavihatamauhatama’’nti aitthaivantaugadhāti iminā padaina anupādisaisāya nibbānadhātuyāva thaumaitīti daṭṭhabbaṃ|

aittha pana attahitasampattiparahitapaṭipattivasaina dvīhākāraihi bhagavatau thaumanā katā hauti| taisu anāvaraṇañāṇādhigamau, saha vāsanāya kilaisānamac‍cantappahānaṃ, anupādisaisanibbānappatti ca attahitasampatti nāma, lābhasak‍kārādinirapaikkhacittassa pana sabbadukkhaniyyānikadhammadaisanāpayaugatau daivadattādīsupi viruddhasattaisu nic‍caṃ hitajjhāsayatā, vinītabbasattānaṃ ñāṇaparipākakālāgamanañ‍ca āsayatau parahitapaṭipatti nāma| sā pana āsayapayaugatau duvidhā, parahitapaṭipatti tividhā ca attahitasampatti imāya gāthāya yathārahaṃ pakāsitā hauti| ‘‘karuṇāsītalahadaya’’nti hi aitaina āsayatau parahitapaṭipatti, sammā gadanatthaina sugatasaddaina payaugatau parahitapaṭipatti| ‘‘pañ‍ñāpaj‍jautavihatamauhatamaṃ gativimutta’’nti aitaihi, catusac‍capaṭivaidhatthaina ca sugatasaddaina tividhāpi attahitasampatti, avasiṭṭhaṭṭhaina pana taina, ‘‘sanarāmaralaukagaru’’nti ca aitaina sabbāpi attahitasampatti, parahitapaṭipatti ca pakāsitā hauti|

atha vā haituphalasattūpakāravasaina tīhākāraihi thaumanā katā| tattha haitu nāma mahākaruṇāsamāyaugau, baudhisambhārasambharaṇañ‍ca, tadubhayampi paṭhamapadaina yathārutatau, sāmatthiyatau ca pakāsitaṃ| phalaṃ pana ñāṇappahānaānubhāvarūpakāyasampadāvasaina catubbidhaṃ| tattha sabbañ‍ñutañāṇapadaṭṭhānaṃ maggañāṇaṃ, tammūlakāni ca dasabalādiñāṇāni ñāṇasampadā, savāsanasakalasaṃkilaisānamac‍cantamanuppādadhammatāpādanaṃ pahānasampadā, yathicchitanipphādanai ādhipac‍caṃ ānubhāvasampadā, sakalalaukanayanābhisaikabhūtā pana lakkhaṇānubyañ‍janapaṭimaṇḍitā attabhāvasampatti rūpakāyasampadā| tāsu ñāṇappahānasampadā dutiyapadaina, sac‍capaṭivaidhatthaina ca sugatasaddaina pakāsitā, ānubhāvasampadā tatiyapadaina, rūpakāyasampadā saubhanakāyagamanatthaina sugatasaddaina lakkhaṇānubyañ‍janapāripūriyā vinā tadabhāvatau| yathāvuttā duvidhāpi parahitapaṭipatti sattūpakārasampadā, sā pana sammā gadanatthaina sugatasaddaina pakāsitāti vaiditabbā|

apica imāya gāthāya sammāsambaudhi tammūla – tappaṭipattiyādayau anaikai buddhaguṇā ācariyaina pakāsitā haunti| aisā hi ācariyānaṃ pakati, yadidaṃ yaina kainaci pakāraina atthantaraviñ‍ñāpanaṃ| kathaṃ? ‘‘karuṇāsītalahadaya’’nti hi aitaina sammāsambaudhiyā mūlaṃ dassaiti| mahākaruṇāsañ‍cauditamānasau hi bhagavā saṃsārapaṅkatau sattānaṃ samuddharaṇatthaṃ katābhinīhārau anupubbaina pāramiyau pūraitvā anuttaraṃ sammāsambaudhimadhigatauti karuṇā sammāsambaudhiyā mūlaṃ| ‘‘pañ‍ñāpaj‍jautavihatamauhatama’’nti aitaina sammāsambaudhiṃ dassaiti| sabbañ‍ñutañāṇapadaṭṭhānañhi aggamaggañāṇaṃ, aggamaggañāṇapadaṭṭhānañ‍ca sabbañ‍ñutañ‍ñāṇaṃ ‘‘sammāsambaudhī’’ti vuc‍cati| sammā gamanatthaina sugatasaddaina sammāsambaudhiyā paṭipattiṃ dassaiti līnuddhac‍capatiṭṭhānāyūhanakāmasukhattakilamathānuyaugasassatucchaidābhinivaisādiantadvayarahitāya karuṇāpañ‍ñāpariggahitāya majjhimāya paṭipattiyā pakāsanatau, itaraihi sammāsambaudhiyā padhānāppadhānappabhaidaṃ payaujanaṃ dassaiti| saṃsāramahaughatau sattasantāraṇañhaittha padhānaṃ, tadañ‍ñamappadhānaṃ| taisu ca padhānaina payaujanaina parahitapaṭipattiṃ dassaiti, itaraina attahitasampattiṃ, tadubhayaina ca attahitapaṭipan‍nādīsu catūsu puggalaisu bhagavatau catutthapuggalabhāvaṃ pakāsaiti| taina ca anuttaraṃ dakkhiṇaiyyabhāvaṃ, uttamañ‍ca vandanīyabhāvaṃ, attanau ca vandanāya khaittaṅgatabhāvaṃ vibhāvaiti|

apica karuṇāggahaṇaina laukiyaisu mahaggatabhāvappattāsādhāraṇaguṇadīpanatau sabbalaukiyaguṇasampatti dassitā, pañ‍ñāggahaṇaina sabbañ‍ñutañ‍ñāṇapadaṭṭhānamaggañāṇadīpanatau  sabbalaukuttaraguṇasampatti| tadubhayaggahaṇasiddhau hi atthau ‘‘sanarāmaralaukagaru’’ntiādinā vipañ‍cīyatīti| karuṇāggahaṇaina ca nirupak‍kilaisamupagamanaṃ dassaiti, pañ‍ñāggahaṇaina apagamanaṃ| tathā karuṇāggahaṇaina laukasamañ‍ñānurūpaṃ bhagavatau pavattiṃ dassaiti laukavauhāravisayattā karuṇāya, pañ‍ñāggahaṇaina laukasamañ‍ñāya anatidhāvanaṃ| sabhāvānavabaudhaina hi dhammānaṃ sabhāvaṃ atidhāvitvā sattādiparāmasanaṃ hauti| tathā karuṇāggahaṇaina mahākaruṇāsamāpattivihāraṃ dassaiti, pañ‍ñāggahaṇaina tīsu kālaisu appaṭihatañāṇaṃ, catusac‍cañāṇaṃ, catupaṭisambhidāñāṇaṃ, catuvaisāraj‍jañāṇaṃ, karuṇāggahaṇaina mahākaruṇāsamāpattiñāṇassa gahitattā saisāsādhāraṇañāṇāni, cha abhiñ‍ñā, aṭṭhasu parisāsu akampanañāṇāni, dasa balāni, cuddasa buddhaguṇā, sauḷasa ñāṇacariyā, aṭṭhārasa buddhadhammā, catucattārīsa ñāṇavatthūni, sattasattati ñāṇavatthūnīti aivamādīnaṃ anaikaisaṃ pañ‍ñāpabhaidānaṃ vasaina ñāṇacāraṃ dassaiti| tathā karuṇāggahaṇaina caraṇasampattiṃ, pañ‍ñāggahaṇaina vij‍jāsampattiṃ| karuṇāggahaṇaina attādhipatitā, pañ‍ñāggahaṇaina dhammādhipatitā| karuṇāggahaṇaina laukanāthabhāvau, pañ‍ñāggahaṇaina attanāthabhāvau| tathā karuṇāggahaṇaina pubbakārībhāvau, pañ‍ñāggahaṇaina katañ‍ñutā| karuṇāggahaṇaina aparantapatā, pañ‍ñāggahaṇaina anattantapatā| karuṇāggahaṇaina vā buddhakaradhammasiddhi, pañ‍ñāggahaṇaina buddhabhāvasiddhi| tathā karuṇāggahaṇaina parasantāraṇaṃ, pañ‍ñāggahaṇaina  attasantāraṇaṃ| tathā karuṇāggahaṇaina sabbasattaisu anuggahacittatā, pañ‍ñāggahaṇaina sabbadhammaisu virattacittatā dassitā hauti sabbaisañ‍ca buddhaguṇānaṃ karuṇā ādi tan‍nidānabhāvatau, pañ‍ñā pariyausānaṃ tatau uttari karaṇīyābhāvatau| iti ādipariyausānadassanaina sabbai buddhaguṇā dassitā haunti| tathā karuṇāggahaṇaina sīlakkhandhapubbaṅgamau samādhikkhandhau dassitau hauti| karuṇānidānañhi sīlaṃ tatau pāṇātipātādiviratippavattitau, sā ca jhānattayasampayauginīti, pañ‍ñāvacanaina pañ‍ñākkhandhau| sīlañ‍ca sabbabuddhaguṇānaṃ ādi, samādhi majjhai, pañ‍ñā pariyausānanti aivampi ādimajjhapariyausānakalyāṇā sabbai buddhaguṇā dassitā haunti nayatau dassitattā| aisau aiva hi niravasaisatau buddhaguṇānaṃ dassanupāyau, yadidaṃ nayaggāhaṇaṃ, añ‍ñathā kau  nāma samatthau bhagavatau guṇai anupadaṃ niravasaisatau dassaituṃ| tainaivāha –

‘‘buddhaupi buddhassa bhaṇaiyya vaṇṇaṃ,

kappampi cai añ‍ñamabhāsamānau||

khīyaitha kappau ciradīghamantarai,

vaṇṇau na khīyaitha tathāgatassā’’ti||

tainaiva ca āyasmatā sāriputtatthairaināpi buddhaguṇaparicchaidanaṃ pati bhagavatā anuyuttaina ‘‘nau haitaṃ bhantai’’ti paṭikkhipitvā ‘‘api ca mai bhantai dhammanvayau viditau’’ti sampasādanīyasuttai vuttaṃ|

aivaṃ saṅkhaipaina sakalasabbañ‍ñuguṇaihi bhagavatau thaumanāpubbaṅgamaṃ paṇāmaṃ katvā idāni saddhammassāpi thaumanāpubbaṅgamaṃ paṇāmaṃ karauntau ‘‘buddhaupī’’tiādimāha| tatthāyaṃ saha padasambandhaina saṅkhaipatthau – yathāvuttavividhaguṇagaṇasaman‍nāgatau buddhaupi yaṃ ariyamaggasaṅkhātaṃ dhammaṃ, saha pubbabhāgapaṭipattidhammaina vā ariyamaggabhūtaṃ dhammaṃ bhāvaitvā caiva yaṃ phalanibbānasaṅkhātaṃ dhammaṃ, pariyattidhammapaṭipattidhammaihi vā saha phalanibbānabhūtaṃ dhammaṃ sacchikatvā ca sammāsambaudhisaṅkhātaṃ buddhabhāvamupagatau, vītamalamanuttaraṃ taṃ dhammampi vandaiti|

tattha buddhasaddassa tāva ‘‘bujjhitā sac‍cānīti buddhau| baudhaitā pajāyāti buddhau’’tiādinā niddaisanayaina atthau vaiditabbau| atha vā aggamaggañāṇādhigamaina savāsanāya sammauhaniddāya ac‍cantavigamanatau, aparimitaguṇagaṇālaṅkatasabbañ‍ñutañ‍ñāṇappattiyā vikasitabhāvatau  ca buddhavāti buddhau jāgaraṇavikasanatthavasaina| atha vā kassacipi ñaiyyadhammassa anavabuddhassa abhāvaina ñaiyyavisaisassa kammabhāvāgahaṇatau kammavacanicchāyābhāvaina avagamanatthavasaina kattuniddaisauva labbhati, tasmā buddhavāti buddhautipi vattabbau| padaisaggahaṇai hi asati gahaitabbassa nippadaisatāva viñ‍ñāyati yathā ‘‘dikkhitau na dadātī’’ti| aivañ‍ca katvā kammavisaisānapaikkhā kattari aiva buddhasaddasiddhi vaiditabbā, atthatau  pana pāramitāparibhāvitau sayambhuñāṇaina saha vāsanāya vihataviddhastaniravasaisakilaisaumahākaruṇāsabbañ‍ñutañ‍ñāṇādiaparimaiyyaguṇagaṇādhārau khandhasantānau buddhau, yathāha –

‘‘buddhauti yau sau bhagavā sayambhū anācariyakau pubbai ananussutaisu dhammaisu sāmaṃ sac‍cāni abhisambujjhi, tattha ca sabbañ‍ñutaṃ pattau, balaisu ca vasībhāva’’nti (mahāni॰ 192; cūḷani॰ 97; paṭi॰ ma॰ 161)|

apisaddau sambhāvanai, taina aivaṃ guṇavisaisayuttau saupi nāma bhagavā īdisaṃ dhammaṃ bhāvaitvā, sacchikatvā ca buddhabhāvamupagatau, kā nāma kathā añ‍ñaisaṃ sāvakādibhāvamupagamanaiti dhammai sambhāvanaṃ dīpaiti| buddhabhāvanti sammāsambaudhiṃ| yaina hi nimittabhūtaina sabbañ‍ñutañ‍ñāṇapadaṭṭhānaina aggamaggañāṇaina, aggamaggañāṇapadaṭṭhānaina ca sabbañ‍ñutañ‍ñāṇaina bhagavati ‘‘buddhau’’ti nāmaṃ, tadārammaṇañ‍ca ñāṇaṃ pavattati, tamaividha ‘‘bhāvau’’ti vuc‍cati| bhavanti buddhisaddā aitaināti hi bhāvau| tathā hi vadanti –

‘‘yaina yaina nimittaina, buddhi saddau ca vattatai|

taṃtaṃnimittakaṃ bhāvapac‍cayaihi udīrita’’nti||

bhāvaitvāti uppādaitvā, vaḍḍhaitvā vā| sacchikatvāti pac‍cakkhaṃ katvā| caiva-saddau ca-saddau ca tadubhayattha samuc‍cayai| taina hi saddadvayaina na kaivalaṃ bhagavā dhammassa bhāvanāmattaina buddhabhāvamupagatau, nāpi sacchikiriyāmattaina, atha khau tadubhayainaivāti samuc‍cinauti| upagatauti pattau, adhigatauti atthau| aitassa ‘‘buddhabhāva’’nti padaina sambandhau| vītamalanti aittha virahavasaina aiti pavattatīti vītau, malatau vītau, vītaṃ vā malaṃ yassāti vītamalau, taṃ vītamalaṃ| ‘‘gatamala’’ntipi pāṭhau dissati, aivaṃ sati saupasaggau viya anupasaggaupi gatasaddau virahatthavācakau vaiditabbau dhātūnamanaikatthattā| gacchati apagacchatīti hi gatau, dhammau| gataṃ vā malaṃ, purimanayaina samāsau| anuttaranti uttaravirahitaṃ| yathānusiṭṭhaṃ paṭipaj‍jamānai apāyatau, saṃsāratau ca apatamānai katvā dhāraitīti dhammau, navavidhau laukuttaradhammau| tappakāsanattā, sacchikiriyāsammasanapariyāyassa ca labbhamānattā pariyattidhammaupi idha saṅgahitau| tathā hi ‘‘abhidhammanayasamuddaṃ adhigacchi, tīṇi piṭakāni sammasī’’ti ca aṭṭhakathāyaṃ vuttaṃ, tathā ‘‘yaṃ dhammaṃ bhāvaitvā sacchikatvā’’ti ca vuttattā bhāvanāsacchikiriyāyaugyatāya buddhakaradhammabhūtāhi pāramitāhi saha pubbabhāgaadhisīlasikkhādayaupi idha saṅgahitāti vaiditabbā| tāpi hi vigatapaṭipakkhatāya vītamalā, anañ‍ñasādhāraṇatāya anuttarā ca| kathaṃ pana tā bhāvaitvā, sacchikatvā ca bhagavā buddhabhāvamupagatauti? vuc‍catai – sattānañhi saṃsāravaṭṭadukkhanissaraṇāya [nissaraṇatthāya (paṇṇāsa ṭī॰) nissaraṇai (katthaci)] katamahābhinīhārau mahākaruṇādhivāsanapaisalajjhāsayau pañ‍ñāvisaisapariyaudātanimmalānaṃ dānadamasañ‍ñamādīnaṃ uttamadhammānaṃ kappānaṃ satasahassādhikāni cattāri asaṅkhyaiyyāni sak‍kac‍caṃ nirantaraṃ niravasaisaṃ bhāvanāsacchikiriyāhi kammādīsu adhigatavasībhāvau acchariyācintaiyyamahānubhāvau adhisīlādhicittānaṃ paramuk‍kaṃsapāramippattau bhagavā pac‍cayākārai catuvīsatikauṭisatasahassamukhaina mahāvajirañāṇaṃ paisaitvā anuttaraṃ sammāsambaudhisaṅkhātaṃ buddhabhāvamupagatauti|

imāya pana gāthāya vij‍jāvimuttisampadādīhi anaikaihi guṇaihi yathārahaṃ saddhammaṃ thaumaiti| kathaṃ? aittha hi ‘‘bhāvaitvā’’ti aitaina vij‍jāsampadāya thaumaiti, ‘‘sacchikatvā’’ti aitaina vimuttisampadāya| tathā paṭhamaina jhānasampadāya, dutiyaina vimaukkhasampadāya| paṭhamaina vā samādhisampadāya, dutiyaina samāpattisampadāya| atha vā paṭhamaina khayañāṇabhāvaina, dutiyaina anuppādañāṇabhāvaina| paṭhamaina vā vij‍jūpamatāya, dutiyaina vajirūpamatāya| paṭhamaina vā virāgasampattiyā, dutiyaina niraudhasampattiyā| tathā paṭhamaina niyyānabhāvaina, dutiyaina nissaraṇabhāvaina| paṭhamaina vā haitubhāvaina, dutiyaina asaṅkhatabhāvaina| paṭhamaina vā dassanabhāvaina, dutiyaina vivaikabhāvaina| paṭhamaina vā adhipatibhāvaina, dutiyaina amatabhāvaina dhammaṃ thaumaiti| atha vā ‘‘yaṃ dhammaṃ bhāvaitvā buddhabhāvaṃ upagatau’’ti aitaina svākkhātatāya dhammaṃ thaumaiti, ‘‘sacchikatvā’’ti aitaina sandiṭṭhikatāya| tathā paṭhamaina akālikatāya, dutiyaina aihipassikatāya| paṭhamaina vā aupanaiyyikatāya, dutiyaina pac‍cattaṃvaiditabbatāya| paṭhamaina vā saha pubbabhāgasīlādīhi saikkhaihi sīlasamādhipañ‍ñākkhandhaihi, dutiyaina saha asaṅkhatadhātuyā asaikkhaihi dhammaṃ thaumaiti|

‘‘vītamala’’nti  iminā pana saṃkilaisābhāvadīpanaina visuddhatāya dhammaṃ thaumaiti, ‘‘anuttara’’nti aitaina añ‍ñassa visiṭṭhassa abhāvadīpanaina paripuṇṇatāya| paṭhamaina vā pahānasampadāya, dutiyaina sabhāvasampadāya| paṭhamaina vā bhāvanāphalayaugyatāya| bhāvanāguṇaina hi sau saṃkilaisamalasamugghātakau, tasmānaina bhāvanākiriyāya phalamāha| dutiyaina sacchikiriyāphalayaugyatāya| taduttarikaraṇīyābhāvatau hi anañ‍ñasādhāraṇatāya anuttarabhāvau sacchikiriyānibbattitau, tasmānaina sacchikiriyāphalamāhāti|

aivaṃ saṅkhaipainaiva sabbasaddhammaguṇaihi saddhammassāpi thaumanāpubbaṅgamaṃ paṇāmaṃ katvā idāni ariyasaṅghassāpi thaumanāpubbaṅgamaṃ paṇāmaṃ karauntau ‘‘sugatassa aurasāna’’ntiādimāha| tattha sugatassāti sambandhaniddaisau, ‘‘puttāna’’nti aitaina sambajjhitabbau| urasi bhavā, jātā, saṃvuddhā vā aurasā, attajau khaittajau antaivāsikau din‍nakauti catubbidhaisu puttaisu attajā, taṃsarikkhatāya pana ariyapuggalā ‘‘aurasā’’ti vuc‍canti| yathā hi manussānaṃ aurasaputtā attajātatāya pitusantakassa dāyaj‍jassa visaisabhāginau haunti, aivamaitaipi saddhammasavanantai ariyāya jātiyā jātatāya bhagavatau santakassa vimuttisukhassa dhammaratanassa ca dāyaj‍jassa visaisabhāginauti| atha vā bhagavatau dhammadaisanānubhāvaina ariyabhūmiṃ auk‍kamamānā, auk‍kantā ca ariyasāvakā bhagavatau urai vāyāmajanitābhijātatāya sadisakappanamantaraina nippariyāyainaiva ‘‘aurasā’’ti vattabbatamarahanti| tathā hi tai bhagavatā āsayānusayacariyādhimuttiādiaulaukanaina, vaj‍jānucintanaina ca hadayai katvā vaj‍jatau nivāraitvā anavaj‍jai patiṭṭhāpaintaina sīlādidhammasarīrapausanaina saṃvaḍḍhāpitā| yathāha bhagavā itivuttakai ‘‘ahamasmi bhikkhavai brāhmaṇau…pai॰… tassa mai tumhai puttā aurasā mukhatau jātā’’tiādi (itivu॰ 100)| nanu sāvakadaisitāpi daisanā ariyabhāvāvahāti? sac‍caṃ, sā pana tammūlikattā, lakkhaṇādivisaisābhāvatau ca ‘‘bhagavatau dhammadaisanā’’  ic‍caiva saṅkhyaṃ gatā, tasmā bhagavatau aurasaputtabhāvauyaiva taisaṃ vattabbauti, aitaina catubbidhaisu puttaisu ariyasaṅghassa attajaputtabhāvaṃ dassaiti| attanau kulaṃ punainti saudhainti, mātāpitūnaṃ vā hadayaṃ pūraintīti puttā, attajādayau| ariyā pana dhammatantivisaudhanaina, dhammānudhammapaṭipattiyā cittārādhanaina ca tappaṭibhāgatāya bhagavatau puttā nāma, taisaṃ| tassa ‘‘samūha’’nti padaina sambandhau|

saṃkilaisanimittaṃ hutvā guṇaṃ māraiti vibādhatīti mārau, daivaputtamārau| sināti parai bandhati aitāyāti sainā, mārassa sainā tathā, mārañ‍ca mārasainañ‍ca mathainti vilauthaintīti mārasainamathanā, taisaṃ| ‘‘māramārasainamathanāna’’nti hi vattabbaipi aikadaisasarūpaikasaisavasaina aivaṃ vuttaṃ| mārasaddasan‍nidhānaina vā saināsaddaina mārasainā gahaitabbā, gāthābandhavasaina caittha rassau| ‘‘mārasainamaddanāna’’ntipi katthaci pāṭhau, sau ayuttauva ariyājātikattā imissā gāthāya| nanu ca ariyasāvakānaṃ maggādhigamasamayai bhagavatau viya tadantarāyakaraṇatthaṃ daivaputtamārau vā mārasainā vā na apasādaiti, atha kasmā aivaṃ vuttanti? apasādaitabbabhāvakāraṇassa vimathitattā| taisañhi apasādaitabbatāya kāraṇai saṃkilaisai vimathitai taipi vimathitā nāma hauntīti| atha vā khandhābhisaṅkhāramārānaṃ viya daivaputtamārassāpi guṇamāraṇai sahāyabhāvūpagamanatau kilaisabalakāyau idha ‘‘mārasainā’’ti vuc‍cati yathāha bhagavā –

‘‘kāmā tai paṭhamā sainā, dutiyā arati vuc‍cati|

tatiyā khuppipāsā tai, catutthī taṇhā pavuc‍cati||

pañ‍camaṃ thinamiddhaṃ tai, chaṭṭhā bhīrū pavuc‍cati|

sattamī vicikicchā tai, makkhau thambhau tai aṭṭhamau||

lābhau silaukau sak‍kārau,

micchāladdhau ca yau yasau|

yau cattānaṃ samuk‍kaṃsai,

parai ca avajānati||

aisā  namuci tai sainā, kaṇhassābhippahārinī|

na naṃ asūrau jināti, jaitvā ca labhatai sukha’’nti|| (su॰ ni॰ 438; mahāni॰ 28; cūḷani॰ 47)|

sā ca taihi ariyasāvakaihi diyaḍḍhasahassabhaidā, anantabhaidā vā kilaisavāhinī satidhammavicayavīriyasamathādiguṇapaharaṇīhi audhisau mathitā, viddhaṃsitā, vihatā ca, tasmā ‘‘mārasainamathanā’’ti vuc‍canti| vilauthanañ‍caittha viddhaṃsanaṃ, vihananaṃ vā| apica khandhābhisaṅkhāramac‍cudaivaputtamārānaṃ taisaṃ sahāyabhāvūpagamanatāya saināsaṅkhātassa kilaisamārassa ca mathanatau ‘‘mārasainamathanā’’tipi atthau gahaitabbau| aivañ‍ca sati pañ‍camāranimmathanabhāvaina atthau paripuṇṇau hauti| ariyasāvakāpi hi samudayappahānapariñ‍ñāvasaina khandhamāraṃ, sahāyavaikal‍lakaraṇaina  sabbathā, appavattikaraṇaina ca abhisaṅkhāramāraṃ, balavidhamanavisayātik‍kamanavasaina mac‍cumāraṃ, daivaputtamārañ‍ca samucchaidappahānavasaina sabbasau appavattikaraṇaina kilaisamāraṃ mathaintīti, iminā pana taisaṃ aurasaputtabhāvai kāraṇaṃ, tīsu puttaisu ca anujātataṃ dassaiti| mārasainamathanatāya hi tai bhagavatau aurasaputtā, anujātā cāti|

aṭṭhan‍nanti gaṇanaparicchaidau, tainasatipi taisaṃ taṃtaṃbhaidaina anaikasatasahassasaṅkhyābhaidai ariyabhāvakaramaggaphaladhammabhaidaina imaṃ gaṇanaparicchaidaṃ nātivattanti maggaṭṭhaphalaṭṭhabhāvānativattanatauti dassaiti| pi-saddau, api-saddau vā padalīḷādinā kāraṇaina aṭṭhānai payuttau, sau ‘‘ariyasaṅgha’’nti aittha yaujaitabbau, taina na kaivalaṃ buddhadhammaiyaiva, atha khau ariyasaṅghampīti sampiṇḍaiti| yadipi avayavavinimuttau samudāyau nāma kauci natthi avayavaṃ upādāya samudāyassa vattabbattā, aviñ‍ñāyamānasamudāyaṃ pana viñ‍ñāyamānasamudāyaina visaisitumarahatīti āha ‘‘aṭṭhan‍nampi samūha’’nti, aitaina ‘‘ariyasaṅgha’’nti aittha na yaina kainaci saṇṭhānādinā, kāyasāmaggiyā vā samudāyabhāvau, api tu maggaṭṭhaphalaṭṭhabhāvainaivāti visaisaiti| avayavamaiva sampiṇḍaitvā ūhitabbau vitak‍kaitabbau, saṃūhanitabbau vā saṅghaṭitabbauti samūhau, sauyaiva samauhau vacanasiliṭṭhatādinā| dvidhāpi hi pāṭhau yuj‍jati| ārakattā kilaisaihi, anayai na iriyanatau, ayai ca iriyanatau ariyā niruttinayaina| atha vā sadaivakaina laukaina saraṇanti araṇīyatau upagantabbatau, upagatānañ‍ca tadatthasiddhitau ariyā, diṭṭhisīlasāmañ‍ñaina saṃhatau, samaggaṃ vā kammaṃ samudāyavasaina samupagatauti saṅghau, ariyānaṃ saṅghau, ariyau ca sau saṅghau ca yathāvuttanayaināti vā ariyasaṅghau, taṃ ariyasaṅghaṃ| bhagavatau aparabhāgai buddhadhammaratanānampi samadhigamau saṅgharatanādhīnauti ariyasaṅghassa bahūpakārataṃ dassaituṃ idhaiva ‘‘sirasā vandai’’ti vuttaṃ| avassañ‍cāyamatthau sampaṭicchitabbau vinayaṭṭhakathādīsupi (pārā॰ aṭṭha॰ ganthārambhakathā) tathā vuttattā| kaici pana purimagāthāsupi taṃ padamānaitvā yaujainti, tadayuttamaiva ratanattayassa asādhāraṇaguṇappakāsanaṭṭhānattā, yathāvuttakāraṇassa ca sabbaisampi saṃvaṇṇanākārānamadhippaitattāti|

imāya pana gāthāya ariyasaṅghassa pabhavasampadā pahānasampadādayau anaikai guṇā dassitā haunti| kathaṃ? ‘‘sugatassa aurasānaṃ puttāna’’nti hi aitaina ariyasaṅghassa pabhavasampadaṃ dassaiti sammāsambuddhapabhavatādīpanatau| ‘‘mārasainamathanāna’’nti aitaina pahānasampadaṃ sakalasaṃkilaisappahānadīpanatau| ‘‘aṭṭhan‍nampi samūha’’nti aitaina ñāṇasampadaṃ maggaṭṭhaphalaṭṭhabhāvadīpanatau| ‘‘ariyasaṅgha’’nti aitaina sabhāvasampadaṃ sabbasaṅghānaṃ aggabhāvadīpanatau| atha vā ‘‘sugatassa aurasānaṃ puttāna’’nti ariyasaṅghassa visuddhanissayabhāvadīpanaṃ| ‘‘mārasainamathanāna’’nti sammāujuñāyasāmīcipaṭipan‍nabhāvadīpanaṃ| ‘‘aṭṭhan‍nampi samūha’’nti āhunaiyyādibhāvadīpanaṃ| ‘‘ariyasaṅgha’’nti anuttarapuñ‍ñakkhaittabhāvadīpanaṃ| tathā ‘‘sugatassa aurasānaṃ puttāna’’nti aitaina ariyasaṅghassa laukuttarasaraṇagamanasabbhāvaṃ dassaiti| laukuttarasaraṇagamanaina hi tai bhagavatau aurasaputtā jātā| ‘‘mārasainamathanāna’nti aitaina abhinīhārasampadāsiddhaṃ pubbabhāgasammāpaṭipattiṃ dassaiti| katābhinīhārā hi sammāpaṭipan‍nā māraṃ, mārasainaṃ vā abhivijinanti| ‘‘aṭṭhan‍nampi samūha’’nti aitaina viddhastavipakkhai saikkhāsaikkhadhammai dassaiti puggalādhiṭṭhānaina maggaphaladhammānaṃ dassitattā| ‘‘ariyasaṅgha’’nti aitaina aggadakkhiṇaiyyabhāvaṃ dassaiti anuttarapuñ‍ñakkhaittabhāvassa dassitattā| saraṇagamanañ‍ca sāvakānaṃ sabbaguṇassa ādi, sapubbabhāgapaṭipadā saikkhā sīlakkhandhādayau majjhai, asaikkhā sīlakkhandhādayau  pariyausānantiādimajjhapariyausānakalyāṇā saṅkhaipatau sabbaipi ariyasaṅghaguṇā dassitā hauntīti|

aivaṃ gāthāttayaina saṅkhaipatau sakalaguṇasaṃkittanamukhaina ratanattayassa paṇāmaṃ katvā idāni taṃ nipac‍cakāraṃ yathādhippaitapayaujanai pariṇāmaintau ‘‘iti mai’’tiādimāha| tattha iti-saddau nidassanai| taina gāthāttayaina yathāvuttanayaṃ nidassaiti| maiti attānaṃ karaṇavacanaina kattubhāvaina niddisati| tassa ‘‘yaṃ puñ‍ñaṃ mayā laddha’’nti pāṭhasaisaina sambandhau, sampadānaniddaisau vā aisau, ‘‘atthī’’ti pāṭhasaisau, sāminiddaisau vā ‘‘yaṃ mama puñ‍ñaṃ vandanāmaya’’nti| pasīdīyatai pasan‍nā, tādisā mati pañ‍ñā, cittaṃ vā yassāti pasan‍namati, añ‍ñapadaliṅgappadhānattā imassa samāsapadassa ‘‘pasan‍namatinau’’ti vuttaṃ| ratiṃ nayati, janaiti, vahatīti vā ratanaṃ, sattavidhaṃ, dasavidhaṃ vā ratanaṃ, tamiva imānīti nairuttikā| sadisakappanamañ‍ñatra pana yathāvuttavacanatthainaiva buddhādīnaṃ ratanabhāvau yuj‍jati| taisañhi ‘‘itipi sau bhagavā’’tiādinā (dī॰ ni॰ 1.157, 255) yathābhūtaguṇai āvaj‍jantassa amatādhigamahaitubhūtaṃ anappakaṃ pītipāmauj‍jaṃ uppaj‍jati| yathāha –

‘‘yasmiṃ mahānāma samayai ariyasāvakau tathāgataṃ anussarati, naivassa tasmiṃ samayai rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hauti, na dausa…pai॰… na mauha…pai॰… ujugatamaivassa tasmiṃ samayai cittaṃ hauti tathāgataṃ ārabbha| ujugatacittau khau pana mahānāma ariyasāvakau  labhati atthavaidaṃ, labhati dhammavaidaṃ, labhati dhammūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmauj‍jaṃ, pamuditassa pīti jāyatī’’tiādi (a॰ ni॰ 6.10; 11.11)|

cittīkatādibhāvau vā ratanaṭṭhau| vuttañhaitaṃ aṭṭhakathāsu –

‘‘cittīkataṃ mahagghañ‍ca, atulaṃ dul‍labhadassanaṃ|

anaumasattaparibhaugaṃ, ratanaṃ taina vuc‍catī’’ti|| (khu॰ pā॰ aṭṭha॰ 6.3; udāna॰ aṭṭha॰ 47; dī॰ ni॰ aṭṭha॰ 2.33; su॰ ni॰ 1.226; mahāni॰ aṭṭha॰ 1.226)|

cittīkatabhāvādayau ca anañ‍ñasādhāraṇā sātisayatau buddhādīsuyaiva labbhantīti| vitthārau ratanasuttavaṇṇanāyaṃ (khu॰ pā॰ aṭṭha॰ 6.3; su॰ ni॰ aṭṭha॰ 1.226) gahaitabbau| ayamatthau  pana nibbacanatthavasaina na vuttau, atha kaināti cai? laukai ratanasammatassa vatthunau garukātabbatādiatthavasaināti saddavidū| sādhūnañ‍ca ramanatau, saṃsāraṇṇavā ca taraṇatau, sugatinibbānañ‍ca nayanatau ratanaṃ tulyatthasamāsavasaina, alamatipapañ‍caina| aikasaisapakappanaina, puthuvacananibbacanaina vā ratanāni| tiṇṇaṃ samūhau, tīṇi vā samāhaṭāni, tayau vā avayavā assāti tayaṃ, ratanānamaiva tayaṃ, nāñ‍ñaisanti ratanattayaṃ| avayavavinimuttassa pana samudāyassa abhāvatau tīṇi aiva ratanāni tathā vuc‍canti, na samudāyamattaṃ, samudāyāpaikkhāya pana aikavacanaṃ kataṃ| vandīyatai vandanā, sāva vandanāmayaṃ yathā ‘‘dānamayaṃ sīlamaya’’nti (dī॰ ni॰ 3.305; itivu॰ 60; naitti॰ 33)| vandanā caittha kāyavācācittaihi tiṇṇaṃ ratanānaṃ guṇanin‍natā, thaumanā vā| apica tassā caitanāya sahajātādaupakāraikau saddhāpañ‍ñāsativīriyādisampayuttadhammau vandanā, tāya pakatanti vandanāmayaṃ yathā ‘‘sauvaṇṇamayaṃ rūpiyamaya’’nti, atthatau pana yathāvuttacaitanāva| ratanattayai, ratanattayassa vā vandanāmayaṃ ratanattayavandanāmayaṃ| puj‍jabhavaphalanibbattanatau puñ‍ñaṃ niruttinayaina, attanau kārakaṃ, santānaṃ vā punāti visaudhaitīti puñ‍ñaṃ, sakammakattā dhātussa kāritavasaina atthavivaraṇaṃ labbhati, saddanipphatti pana suddhavasainaivāti saddavidū|

taṃtaṃsampattiyā vibandhanavasaina sattasantānassa antarai vaimajjhai aiti āgacchatīti antarāyau, diṭṭhadhammikādianatthau| paṇāmapayaujanai vuttavidhinā suṭṭhu vihatau viddhastau antarāyau assāti suvihatantarāyau| vihananañ‍caittha taduppādakahaitupariharaṇavasaina taisaṃ antarāyānamanuppattikaraṇanti  daṭṭhabbaṃ| hutvāti pubbakālakiriyā, tassa ‘‘atthaṃ pakāsayissāmī’’ti aitaina sambandhau| tassāti yaṃ-saddaina uddiṭṭhassa vandanāmayapuñ‍ñassa| ānubhāvaināti balaina|

‘‘taijau ussāhamantā ca, pabhū sattīti pañ‍cimai|

‘ānubhāvau’ti vuc‍canti, ‘pabhāvau’ti ca tai vadai’’ti|| –

vuttaisu hi atthaisu idha sattiyaṃ vattati| anu punappunaṃ taṃsamaṅgiṃ bhāvaiti vaḍḍhaitīti hi anubhāvau, sauyaiva ānubhāvauti udānaṭṭhakathāyaṃ, atthatau pana yathāladdhasampattinimittakassa purimakammassa balānuppadānavasasaṅkhātā vandanāmayapuñ‍ñassa sattiyaiva, sā ca suvihatantarāyatāya karaṇaṃ, haitu vā sambhavati|

aittha pana ‘‘pasan‍namatinau’’ti aitaina attanau pasādasampattiṃ dassaiti| ‘‘ratanattayavandanāmaya’’nti aitaina ratanattayassa khaittabhāvasampattiṃ, tatau ca tassa puñ‍ñassa attanau pasādasampattiyā, ratanattayassa ca khaittabhāvasampattiyāti dvīhi aṅgaihi atthasaṃvaṇṇanāya upaghātakaupaddavānaṃ vihananai samatthataṃ dīpaiti| caturaṅgasampattiyā dānacaitanā viya hi dvayaṅgasampattiyā paṇāmacaitanāpi antarāyavihananaina diṭṭhadhammikāti|

aivaṃ ratanattayassa nipac‍cakārakaraṇai payaujanaṃ dassaitvā idāni yassā dhammadaisanāya atthaṃ saṃvaṇṇaitukāmau, tadapi saṃvaṇṇaitabbadhammabhāvaina dassaitvā guṇābhitthavanavisaisaina abhitthavaituṃ ‘‘dīghassā’’tiādimāha| ayañhi ācariyassa pakati, yadidaṃ taṃtaṃsaṃvaṇṇanāsu āditau tassa tassa saṃvaṇṇaitabbadhammassa visaisaguṇakittanaina thaumanā| tathā hi taisu taisu papañ‍casūdanīsāratthapakāsanīmanaurathapūraṇīaṭṭhasālinīādīsu yathāk‍kamaṃ ‘‘paravādamathanassa, ñāṇappabhaidajananassa, dhammakathikapuṅgavānaṃ vicittapaṭibhānajananassa,

tassa gambhīrañāṇaihi, augāḷhassa abhiṇhasau|

nānānayavicittassa, abhidhammassa āditau’’ti|| ādinā –

thaumanā katā| tattha dīghassāti dīghanāmakassa| dīghasuttaṅkitassāti dīghaihi abhiāyatavacanappabandhavantaihi suttaihi lakkhitassa, anaina ‘‘dīghau’’ti ayaṃ imassa āgamassa  atthānugatā samañ‍ñāti dassaiti| nanu ca suttāniyaiva āgamau, kathaṃ sau taihi aṅkīyatīti? sac‍camaitaṃ paramatthatau, pañ‍ñattitau pana suttāni upādāya āgamabhāvassa pañ‍ñattattā avayavaihi suttaihi avayavībhūtau āgamau aṅkīyati| yathaiva hi atthabyañ‍janasamudāyai ‘‘sutta’’nti vauhārau, aivaṃ suttasamudāyai āgamavauhārauti| paṭic‍casamuppādādinipuṇatthabhāvatau nipuṇassa| āgacchanti attatthaparatthādayau aittha, aitaina, aitasmāti vā āgamau, uttamaṭṭhaina, patthanīyaṭṭhaina ca sau varauti  āgamavarau| apica āgamasammataihi bāhirakapavaiditaihi bhāratapurāṇakathānarasīhapurāṇakathādīhi varautipi āgamavarau, tassa| buddhānamanubuddhā buddhānubuddhā, buddhānaṃ sac‍capaṭivaidhaṃ anugamma paṭividdhasac‍cā aggasāvakādayau ariyā, taihi atthasaṃvaṇṇanāvasaina, guṇasaṃvaṇṇanāvasaina ca saṃvaṇṇitauti tathā| atha vā buddhā ca anubuddhā ca, taihi saṃvaṇṇitau yathāvuttanayaināti tathā, tassa| sammāsambuddhainaiva hi tiṇṇampi piṭakānaṃ atthasaṃvaṇṇanāk‍kamau bhāsitau, tatau paraṃ saṅgāyanādivasaina sāvakaihīti ācariyā vadanti| vuttañ‍ca majjhimāgamaṭṭhakathāya upālisuttavaṇṇanāyaṃ ‘‘vaiyyākaraṇassāti vitthāraitvā atthadīpakassa| bhagavatā hi abyākataṃ tantipadaṃ nāma natthi, sabbaisaṃyaiva atthau kathitau’’ti (ma॰ ni॰ aṭṭha॰ 3.76)| saddhāvahaguṇassāti buddhādīsu pasādāvahaguṇassa| nanu ca sabbampi buddhavacanaṃ taipiṭakaṃ saddhāvahaguṇamaiva, atha kasmā ayamañ‍ñasādhāraṇaguṇaina thaumitauti? sātisayatau imassa tagguṇasampan‍nattā| ayañhi āgamau brahmajālādīsu sīladiṭṭhādīnaṃ anavasaisaniddaisādivasaina, mahāpadānādīsu (dī॰ ni॰ 2.3) purimabuddhānampi guṇaniddaisādivasaina, pāthikasuttādīsu (dī॰ ni॰ 3.1.4) titthiyai madditvā appaṭivattiyasīhanādanadanādivasaina, anuttariyasuttādīsu visaisatau buddhaguṇavibhāvanaina ratanattayai sātisayaṃ saddhaṃ āvahatīti|

aivaṃ saṃvaṇṇaitabbadhammassa abhitthavanampi katvā idāni saṃvaṇṇanāya sampati vakkhamānāya āgamanavisuddhiṃ dassaituṃ ‘‘atthappakāsanattha’’ntiādimāha| imāya hi gāthāya saṅgītittayamāruḷhadīghāgamaṭṭhakathātauva sīhaḷabhāsāmattaṃ vinā ayaṃ vakkhamānasaṃvaṇṇanā āgatā, nāñ‍ñatau, tadaiva kāraṇaṃ katvā vattabbā, nāñ‍ñanti attanau saṃvaṇṇanāya āgamanavisuddhiṃ dassaiti| aparau nayau – paramanipuṇagambhīraṃ buddhavisayamāgamavaraṃ attanau balainaiva vaṇṇayissāmīti añ‍ñaihi vattumpi asak‍kuṇaiyyattā saṃvaṇṇanānissayaṃ dassaitumāha ‘‘atthappakāsanattha’’ntiādi| imāya hi pubbācariyānubhāvaṃ nissāyaiva tassa atthaṃ vaṇṇayissāmīti attanau saṃvaṇṇanānissayaṃ dassaiti| tattha ‘‘atthappakāsanattha’’nti pāṭhatthau, sabhāvatthau, ñaiyyatthau, pāṭhānurūpatthau, tadanurūpatthau, sāvasaisatthau, nivarasaisatthau, nītatthau, naiyyatthautiādinā  anaikappakārassa atthassa pakāsanatthāya, pakāsanāya vā| gāthābandhasampattiyā dvibhāvau| atthau kathīyati aitāyāti atthakathā, sāyaiva aṭṭhakathā ttha-kārassa ṭṭha-kāraṃ katvā yathā ‘‘dukkhassa pīḷanaṭṭhau’’ti (paṭi॰ ma॰ 1.17; 2.8), ayañ‍ca sasañ‍ñaugavidhi ariyājātibhāvatau| akkharacintakāpi hi ‘‘tathānaṃṭṭha yuga’’nti lakkhaṇaṃ vatvā idamaivudāharanti|

yāya’tthamabhivaṇṇainti, byañ‍janatthapadānugaṃ|

nidānavatthusambandhaṃ, aisā aṭṭhakathā matā||

āditautiādimhi paṭhamasaṅgītiyaṃ| chaḷabhiñ‍ñatāya paramaina cittavasībhāvaina saman‍nāgatattā, jhānādīsu pañ‍cavasitā sabbhāvatau ca vasinau, thairā mahākassapādayau, taisaṃ sataihi pañ‍cahi| yā saṅgītāti yā aṭṭhakathā atthaṃ pakāsaituṃ yuttaṭṭhānai ‘‘ayamaitassa atthau, ayamaitassa atthau’’ti saṅgahaitvā vuttā| anusaṅgītā ca pacchāpīti na kaivalaṃ paṭhamasaṅgītiyamaiva, atha khau pacchā dutiyatatiyasaṅgītīsupi| na ca pañ‍cahi vasisataihi āditau saṅgītāyaiva, api tu yasatthairādīhi anusaṅgītā cāti saha samuc‍cayaina atthau vaiditabbau| samuc‍cayadvayañhi pac‍caikaṃ kiriyākālaṃ samuc‍cinauti|

atha paurāṇaṭṭhakathāya vij‍jamānāya kimaitāya adhunā puna katāya saṃvaṇṇanāyāti punaruttiyā, niratthakatāya ca dausaṃ samanussaritvā taṃ pariharantau ‘‘sīhaḷadīpa’’ntiādimāha| taṃ pariharaṇainaiva hi imissā saṃvaṇṇanāya nimittaṃ dassaiti| tattha sīhaṃ lāti gaṇhātīti sīhaḷau la-kārassa ḷa-kāraṃ katvā yathā ‘‘garuḷau’’ti| tasmiṃ vaṃsai ādipurisau sīhakumārau, tabbaṃsajātā pana tambapaṇṇidīpai khattiyā, sabbaipi ca janā taddhitavasaina, sadisavauhāraina vā sīhaḷā, taisaṃ nivāsadīpaupi taddhitavasaina, ṭhānīnāmaina vā ‘‘sīhaḷau’’ti vaiditabbau| jalamajjhai dippati, dvidhā vā āpau aittha sandatīti dipau, sauyaiva dīpau, bhaidāpaikkhāya taisaṃ dīpauti tathā| panasaddau arucisaṃsūcanai, taina kāmañ‍ca sā saṅgītittayamāruḷhā, tathāpi puna aivaṃbhūtāti aruciyabhāvaṃ saṃsūcaiti| tadatthasambandhatāya pana purimagāthāya ‘‘kāmañ‍ca saṅgītā  anusaṅgītā cā’’ti sānuggahatthayaujanā sambhavati| añ‍ñatthāpi hi tathā dissatīti| ābhatāti jambudīpatau ānītā| athāti saṅgītikālatau pacchā, aivaṃ sati ābhatapadaina sambandhau| athāti vā mahāmahindatthairainābhatakālatau pacchā, aivaṃ sati ṭhapitapadaina sambandhau| sā hi dhammasaṅgāhakatthairaihi paṭhamaṃ tīṇi piṭakāni saṅgāyitvā tassa atthasaṃvaṇṇanānurūpainaiva vācanāmaggaṃ  āraupitattā tissau saṅgītiyau āruḷhāyaiva, tatau pacchā ca mahāmahindatthairaina tambapaṇṇidīpamābhatā, pacchā pana tambapaṇṇiyaihi mahāthairaihi nikāyantaraladdhisaṅkarapariharaṇatthaṃ sīhaḷabhāsāya ṭhapitāti| ācariyadhammapālatthairau pana pacchimasambandhamaiva duddasattā pakāsaiti| tathā ‘‘dīpavāsīnamatthāyā’’ti idampi ‘‘ṭhapitā’’ti ca ‘‘apanaitvā āraupaintau’’ti ca aitaihi padaihi sambajjhitabbaṃ| aikapadampi hi āvuttiyādinayaihi anaikatthasambandhamupagacchati| purimasambandhaina caittha sīhaḷadīpavāsīnamatthāya nikāyantaraladdhisaṅkarapariharaṇaina sīhaḷabhāsāya ṭhapitāti tambapaṇṇiyatthairaihi ṭhapanapayaujanaṃ dassaiti| pacchimasambandhaina pana imāya saṃvaṇṇanāya jambudīpavāsīnaṃ, añ‍ñadīpavāsīnañ‍ca atthāya sīhaḷabhāsāpanayanassa, tantinayānucchavikabhāsāraupanassa ca payaujananti| mahāissariyattā mahindauti rājakumārakālai nāmaṃ, pacchā pana guṇamahantatāya mahāmahindauti vuc‍cati| sīhaḷabhāsā nāma anaikakkharaihi aikatthassāpi vauharaṇatau paraisaṃ vauharituṃ atiduk‍karā kañ‍cukasadisā sīhaḷānaṃ samudāciṇṇā bhāsā|

aivaṃ hautu paurāṇaṭṭhakathāya, adhunā kariyamānā pana aṭṭhakathā kathaṃ karīyatīti anuyaugai sati imissā aṭṭhakathāya karaṇappakāraṃ dassaitumāha ‘‘apanaitvānā’’tiādi| tattha tatau mūlaṭṭhakathātau sīhaḷabhāsaṃ apanaitvā pautthakai anāraupitabhāvaina niraṅkaritvāti sambandhau, aitaina ayaṃ vakkhamānā aṭṭhakathā saṅgītittayamāraupitāya mūlaṭṭhakathāya sīhaḷabhāsāpanayanamattamañ‍ñatra atthatau saṃsandati caiva samaiti ca yathā ‘‘gaṅgaudakaina yamunaudaka’’nti dassaiti| ‘‘manaurama’’ mic‍cādīni ‘‘bhāsa’’nti aitassa sabhāvaniruttibhāvadīpakāni visaisanāni| sabhāvaniruttibhāvaina hi paṇḍitānaṃ manaṃ ramayatīti manauramā| tanauti atthamaitāya, tanīyati vā atthavasaina vivarīyati, vaṭṭatau vā sattai tāraiti, nānātthavisayaṃ vā kaṅkhaṃ taranti aitāyāti tanti, pāḷi| tassā nayasaṅkhātāya gatiyā chaviṃ chāyaṃ anugatāti tantinayānucchavikā| asabhāvaniruttibhāsantarasaṃkiṇṇadausavirahitatāya vigatadausā, tādisaṃ sabhāvaniruttibhūtaṃ –

‘‘sā māgadhī mūlabhāsā, narā yāyā’dikappikā|

brahmānau cassutālāpā, sambuddhā cāpi bhāsarai’’ti|| –

vuttaṃ pāḷigatibhāsaṃ pautthakai likhanavasaina āraupaintauti atthau, iminā saddadausābhāvamāha|

samayaṃ  avilaumaintauti siddhantamaviraudhaintau, iminā pana atthadausābhāvamāha| aviruddhattā aiva hi tai thairavādāpi idha pakāsayissanti| kaisaṃ pana samayanti āha ‘‘thairāna’’ntiādi, aitaina rāhulācariyādīnaṃ jaitavanavāsīabhayagirivāsīnikāyānaṃ samayaṃ nivattaiti| thiraihi sīlasutajhānavimuttisaṅkhātaihi guṇaihi saman‍nāgatāti thairā| yathāha ‘‘cattāraumai bhikkhavai thairakaraṇā dhammā| katamai cattārau? idha bhikkhavai bhikkhu sīlavā hautī’’tiādi (a॰ ni॰ 4.22)| apica sac‍cadhammādīhi thirakaraṇaihi saman‍nāgatattā thairā| yathāha dhammarājā dhammapadai –

‘‘yamhi sac‍cañ‍ca dhammau ca, ahiṃsā saṃyamau damau|

sa vai vantamalau dhīrau, ‘thairau’iti pavuc‍catī’’ti|| (dha॰ pa॰ 260)|

taisaṃ| mahākassapatthairādīhi āgatā ācariyaparamparā thairavaṃsau, tappariyāpan‍nā hutvā āgamādhigamasampan‍nattā pañ‍ñāpaj‍jautaina tassa samuj‍jalanatau taṃ pakāraina dīpainti, tasmiṃ vā padīpasadisāti thairavaṃsapadipā| vividhaina ākāraina nicchīyatīti vinicchayau, gaṇṭhiṭṭhānaisu khīlamaddanākāraina pavattā vimaticchaidanīkathā, suṭṭhu nipuṇau saṇhau vinicchayau aitaisanti sunipuṇavinicchayā| atha vā vinicchinautīti vinicchayau, yathāvuttavisayaṃ ñāṇaṃ, suṭṭhu nipuṇau chaikau vinicchayau aitaisanti sunipuṇavinicchayā| mahāmaighavanai ṭhitau vihārau mahāvihārau, yau satthu mahābaudhinā viraucati, tasmiṃ vasanasīlā mahāvihāravāsinau, tādisānaṃ samayaṃ avilaumaintauti atthau, aitaina mahākassapādithairaparamparāgatau, tatauyaiva aviparitau saṇhasukhumau vinicchayauti mahāvihāravāsīnaṃ samayassa pamāṇabhūtataṃ puggalādhiṭṭhānavasaina dassaiti|

hitvā punappunabhatamatthanti aikattha vutampi puna añ‍ñattha ābhatamatthaṃ punaruttibhāvatau, ganthagarukabhāvatau ca cajitvā tassa āgamavarassa atthaṃ pakāsayissāmīti atthau|

aivaṃ karaṇappakārampi dassaitvā ‘‘dīpavāsīnamatthāyā’’ti vuttappayaujanatau añ‍ñampi saṃvaṇṇanāya payaujanaṃ dassaituṃ ‘‘sujanassa cā’’tiādimāha| tattha sujanassa cāti ca-saddau samuc‍cayatthau, taina na kaivalaṃ jambudīpavāsīnamaiva atthāya, atha khau sādhujanatausanatthañ‍cāti samuc‍cinauti| tainaiva ca tambapaṇṇidīpavāsīnampi atthāyāti ayamatthau siddhau hauti uggahaṇādisukaratāya taisampi bahūpakārattā| ciraṭṭhitatthañ‍cāti aitthāpi ca-saddau na kaivalaṃ tadubhayatthamaiva, api tu tividhassāpi sāsanadhammassa, pariyattidhammassa vā pañ‍cavassasahassaparimāṇaṃ  cirakālaṃ ṭhitatthañ‍cāti samuc‍cayatthamaiva dassaiti| pariyattidhammassa hi ṭhitiyā paṭipattidhammapaṭivaidhadhammānampi ṭhiti hauti tassaiva taisaṃ mūlabhāvatau| pariyattidhammau pana sunikkhittaina padabyañ‍janaina, tadatthaina ca ciraṃ sammā patiṭṭhāti, saṃvaṇṇanāya ca padabyañ‍janaṃ aviparītaṃ sunikkhittaṃ, tadatthaupi aviparītau sunikkhittau hauti, tasmā saṃvaṇṇanāya aviparītassa padabyañ‍janassa, tadatthassa ca sunikkhittassa upāyabhāvamupādāya vuttaṃ ‘‘ciraṭṭhitatthañ‍ca dhammassā’’ti| vuttañhaitaṃ bhagavatā –

‘‘dvaimai bhikkhavai dhammā saddhammassa ṭhitiyā asammausāya anantaradhānāya saṃvattanti| katamai dvai? sunikkhittañ‍ca padabyañ‍janaṃ, atthau ca sunītau, imai khau…pai॰… saṃvattantī’’tiādi (a॰ ni॰ 2.21)|

aivaṃ payaujanampi dassaitvā vakkhamānāya saṃvaṇṇanāya mahattaparic‍cāgaina ganthagarukabhāvaṃ pariharitumāha ‘‘sīlakathā’’tiādi| tathā hi vuttaṃ ‘‘na taṃ vicarayissāmī’’ti| aparau nayau – yadaṭṭhakathaṃ kattukāmau, tadaikadaisabhāvaina visuddhimaggau gahaitabbauti kathikānaṃ upadaisaṃ karauntau  tattha vicāritadhammai uddaisavasaina dassaitumāha ‘‘sīlakathā’’tiādi| tattha sīlakathāti cārittavārittādivasaina sīlavitthārakathā| dhutadhammāti piṇḍapātikaṅgādayau tairasa kilaisadhunanakadhammā| kammaṭṭhānānīti bhāvanāsaṅkhātassa yaugakammassa pavattiṭṭhānattā kammaṭṭhānanāmāni dhammajātāni| tāni pana pāḷiyamāgatāni aṭṭhatiṃ saiva na gahaitabbāni, atha khau aṭṭhakathāyamāgatānipi dvaiti ñāpaituṃ ‘‘sabbānipī’’ti vuttaṃ| cari yāvidhānasahitauti rāgacaritādīnaṃ sabhāvādividhānaina saha pavattau, idaṃ pana ‘‘jhānasamāpattivitthārau’’ti imassa visaisanaṃ| aittha ca rūpāvacarajjhānāni jhānaṃ, arūpāvacarajjhānāni samāpatti|  tadubhayampi vā paṭiladdhamattaṃ jhānaṃ, samāpaj‍janavasībhāvappattaṃ samāpatti| apica tadapi ubhayaṃ jhānamaiva, phalasamāpattiniraudhasamāpattiyau pana samāpatti, tāsaṃ vitthārauti atthau|

laukiyalaukuttarabhaidānaṃ chan‍nampi abhiñ‍ñānaṃ gahaṇatthaṃ ‘‘sabbā ca abhiñ‍ñāyau’’ti vuttaṃ| ñāṇavibhaṅgādīsu (vibha॰ 751) āgatanayaina aikavidhādinā bhaidaina pañ‍ñāya saṅkalayitvā sampiṇḍaitvā, gaṇaitvā vā vinicchayanaṃ pañ‍ñāsaṅkalanavinicchayau|  ariyānīti buddhādīhi ariyaihi paṭivijjhitabbattā, ariyabhāvasādhakattā vā ariyāni uttarapadalaupaina| avitathabhāvaina vā araṇīyattā, avagantabbattā ariyāni, ‘‘sac‍cānī’’timassa visaisanaṃ|

haitādipac‍cayadhammānaṃ  haitupac‍cayādibhāvaina pac‍cayuppan‍nadhammānamupakārakatā pac‍cayākārau, tassa daisanā tathā, paṭic‍casamuppādakathāti atthau| sā pana nikāyantaraladdhisaṅkararahitatāya suṭṭhu parisuddhā, ghanavinibbhaugassa ca suduk‍karatāya nipuṇā, aikattādinayasahitā ca tattha vicāritāti āha ‘‘suparisuddhanipuṇanayā’’ti| padattayampi haitaṃ pac‍cayākāradaisanāya visaisanaṃ| paṭisambhidādīsu āgatanayaṃ avissaj‍jitvāva vicāritattā avimuttau tantimaggau yassāti avimuttatanti maggā| maggauti caittha pāḷisaṅkhātau upāyau taṃtadatthānaṃ avabaudhassa, sac‍capaṭivaidhassa vā upāyabhāvatau| pabandhau vā dīghabhāvaina pakatimaggasadisattā, idaṃ pana ‘‘vipassanā, bhāvanā’’ti padadvayassa visaisanaṃ|

iti  pana sabbanti aittha iti-saddau parisamāpanai yathāuddiṭṭhauddaisassa pariniṭṭhitattā, aittakaṃ sabbanti atthau| panāti vacanālaṅkāramattaṃ visuṃ atthābhāvatau| padatthasaṃkiṇṇassa, vattabbassa ca avuttassa avasaisassa abhāvatau suviñ‍ñaiyyabhāvaina suparisuddhaṃ, ‘‘sabba’’nti iminā sambandhau, bhāvanapuṃsakaṃ vā aitaṃ ‘‘vutta’’nti iminā sambajjhanatau| bhiyyauti atiraikaṃ, ativitthāranti atthau, aitaina padatthamattamaiva vicārayissāmīti dassaiti| aitaṃ sabbaṃ idha aṭṭhakathāya na vicārayissāmi punaruttibhāvatau, ganthagarukabhāvatau cāti adhippāyau| vicarayissāmīti ca gāthābhāvatau na vuddhibhāvauti daṭṭhabbaṃ|

aivampi aisa visuddhimaggau āgamānamatthaṃ na pakāsaiyya, atha sabbaupaisau idha vicāritabbauyaivāti caudanāya tathā avicāraṇassa aikantakāraṇaṃ niddhāraitvā taṃ pariharantau ‘‘majjhai visuddhimaggau’’tiādimāha| tattha majjhaiti khuddakatau añ‍ñaisaṃ catun‍nampi āgamānaṃ abbhantarai| hi-saddau kāraṇai, taina yathāvuttaṃ kāraṇaṃ jautaiti| tatthāti taisu catūsu āgamaisu| yathābhāsitanti bhagavatā yaṃ yaṃ daisitaṃ, daisitānurūpaṃ vā| api ca saṃvaṇṇakaihi saṃvaṇṇanāvasaina yaṃ yaṃ bhāsitaṃ, bhāsitānurūpantipi atthau| ic‍caivāti aittha iti-saddaina yathāvuttaṃ kāraṇaṃ nidassaiti, imināva kāraṇaina, idamaiva vā kāraṇaṃ manasi san‍nidhāyāti atthau| katauti aitthāpi ‘‘visuddhimaggau aisā’’ti padaṃ kammabhāvaina sambajjhati āvuttiyādinayaināti daṭṭhabbaṃ| tampīti taṃ visuddhimaggampi ñāṇaina gahaitvāna| aitāyāti sumaṅgalavilāsiniyā nāma aitāya aṭṭhakathāya| aittha ca ‘‘majjhai ṭhatvā’’ti aitaina majjhattabhāvadīpanaina visaisatau catun‍nampi āgamānaṃ sādhāraṇaṭṭhakathā visuddhimaggau, na sumaṅgalavilāsinīādayau viya asādhāraṇaṭṭhakathāti dassaiti| avisaisatau pana vinayābhidhammānampi yathārahaṃ sādhāraṇaṭṭhakathā hautiyaiva, taihi sammissatāya ca tadavasaisassa khuddakāgamassa  visaisatau sādhāraṇā samānāpi taṃ ṭhapaitvā catun‍namaiva āgamānaṃ sādhāraṇātvaiva vuttāti|

iti sauḷasagāthāvaṇṇanā|

ganthārambhakathāvaṇṇanā niṭṭhitā|

nidānakathāvaṇṇanā

aivaṃ  yathāvuttaina vividhaina nayaina paṇāmādikaṃ pakaraṇārambhavidhānaṃ katvā idāni vibhāgavantānaṃ sabhāvavibhāvanaṃ vibhāgadassanavasainaiva suvibhāvitaṃ, suviñ‍ñāpitañ‍ca hautīti paṭhamaṃ tāva vaggasuttavasaina vibhāgaṃ dassaituṃ ‘‘tattha dīghāgamau nāmā’’tiādimāha| tattha tatthāti ‘‘dīghassa āgamavarassa atthaṃ pakāsayissāmī’’ti yadidaṃ vuttaṃ, tasmiṃ vacanai| ‘‘yassa atthaṃ pakāsayissāmī’’ti paṭiñ‍ñātaṃ, sau dīghāgamau nāma vaggasuttavasaina aivaṃ vaiditabbau, aivaṃ vibhāgauti vā atthau| atha vā tatthāti ‘‘dīghāgamanissita’’nti yaṃ vuttaṃ, aitasmiṃ vacanai| yau dīghāgamau vuttau, sau dīghāgamau nāma vaggasuttavasaina| aivaṃ vibhajitabbau, aidisauti vā atthau| ‘‘dīghassā’’tiādinā hi vuttaṃ dūravacanaṃ taṃ-saddaina paṭiniddisati viya ‘‘dīghāgamanissita’’nti vuttaṃ āsan‍navacanampi taṃ-saddaina paṭiniddisati attanau buddhiyaṃ parammukhaṃ viya parivattamānaṃ hutvā pavattanatau| aidisaisu hi ṭhānaisu attanau buddhiyaṃ sammukhaṃ vā parammukhaṃ vā parivattamānaṃ yathā tathā vā paṭiniddisituṃ vaṭṭati saddamattapaṭiniddaisaina atthassāviraudhanatau| vaggasuttādīnaṃ nibbacanaṃ paratau āvi bhavissati| tayau vaggā yassāti tivaggau| catuttiṃsa suttāni aittha saṅgayhanti, taisaṃ vā saṅgahau gaṇanā aitthāti catuttiṃsasuttasaṅgahau|

attanau saṃvaṇṇanāya paṭhamasaṅgītiyaṃ nikkhittānuk‍kamainaiva pavattabhāvaṃ dassaituṃ ‘‘tassa…pai॰… nidānamādī’’ti vuttaṃ| ādibhāvau haittha saṅgītik‍kamainaiva vaiditabbau| kasmā pana catūsu āgamaisu dīghāgamau paṭhamaṃ saṅgītau, tattha ca sīlakkhandhavaggau paṭhamaṃ nikkhittau, tasmiñ‍ca brahmajālasuttaṃ, tatthāpi nidānanti? nāyamanuyaugau katthacipi na pavattati sabbatthaiva vacanak‍kamamattaṃ paṭic‍ca anuyuñ‍jitabbatau| apica saddhāvahaguṇattā dīghāgamauva paṭhamaṃ saṅgītau| saddhā hi kusaladhammānaṃ bījaṃ| yathāha ‘‘saddhā bījaṃ tapau vuṭṭhī’’ti (saṃ॰ ni॰ 2.197; su॰ ni॰ 77)| saddhāvahaguṇatā cassa haiṭṭhā dassitāyaiva| kiñ‍ca bhiyyau – katipayasuttasaṅgahatāya  caiva appaparimāṇatāya ca uggahaṇadhāraṇādisukhatau paṭhamaṃ saṅgītau| tathā haisa catuttiṃsasuttasaṅgahau, catusaṭṭhibhāṇavāraparimāṇau ca| sīlakathābāhul‍latau pana sīlakkhandhavaggau paṭhamaṃ nikkhittau| sīlañhi sāsanassa ādi sīlapatiṭṭhānattā sabbaguṇānaṃ| tainaivāha ‘‘tasmā tiha tvaṃ bhikkhu ādimaiva visaudhaihi kusalaisu dhammaisu| kau cādi kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ? sīlañ‍ca suvisuddha’’ntiādi (saṃ॰ ni॰ 5.469)| sīlakkhandhakathābāhul‍latau hi sau ‘‘sīlakkhandhavaggau’’ti vuttau| diṭṭhivinivaiṭhanakathābhāvatau pana suttantapiṭakassa niravasaisadiṭṭhivibhajanaṃ brahmajālasuttaṃ paṭhamaṃ nikkhittanti vaiditabbaṃ| taipiṭakai hi buddhavacanai brahmajālasadisaṃ diṭṭhigatāni niggumbaṃ nij‍jaṭaṃ katvā vibhattasuttaṃ natthi| nidānaṃ pana paṭhamasaṅgītiyaṃ mahākassapatthairaina puṭṭhaina āyasmatā ānandaina daisakālādinidassanatthaṃ paṭhamaṃ nikkhittanti| taināha ‘‘brahmajālassāpī’’tiādi| tattha ca ‘‘āyasmatā’’tiādinā daisakaṃ niyamaiti, paṭhamasaṅgītikālaiti pana kālanti, ayamatthau upari āvi bhavissati|

paṭhamamahāsaṅgītikathāvaṇṇanā

idāni ‘‘paṭhamamahāsaṅgītikālai’’ti vacanappasaṅgaina taṃ paṭhamamahāsaṅgītiṃ dassaintau, yassaṃ vā paṭhamamahāsaṅgītiyaṃ nikkhittānuk‍kamaina saṃvaṇṇanaṃ kattukāmattā taṃ vibhāvaintau tassā tantiyā āruḷhāyapi idha vacanai kāraṇaṃ dassaituṃ ‘‘paṭhamamahāsaṅgīti nāma caisā’’tiādimāha| aittha hi kiñ‍cāpi…pai॰… māruḷhāti aitaina nanu sā saṅgītikkhandhakai tantimāruḷhā, kasmā idha puna vuttā, yadi ca vuttā assa niratthakatā, ganthagarutā ca siyāti caudanālaisaṃ dassaiti| ‘‘nidāna…pai॰… vaiditabbā’’ti pana aitaina nidānakausal‍latthabhāvatau yathāvuttadausatā na siyāti visaisakāraṇadassanaina pariharati| ‘‘paṭhamamahāsaṅgīti nāma caisā’’ti aittha ca-saddau īdisaisu ṭhānaisu vattabbasampiṇḍanatthau| taina hi paṭhamamahāsaṅgītikālai vuttaṃ nidānañ‍ca ādi, aisā ca paṭhamamahāsaṅgīti nāma aivaṃ vaiditabbāti imamatthaṃ sampiṇḍaiti| upañ‍ñāsatthau vā ca-saddau, upañ‍ñāsauti ca vākyārambhau vuc‍cati| aisā hi ganthakārānaṃ pakati, yadidaṃ kiñ‍ci vatvā puna aparaṃ vattumārabhantānaṃ ca-saddapayaugau| yaṃ pana vajirabuddhitthairaina vuttaṃ ‘‘aittha ca-saddau atiraikatthau, taina añ‍ñāpi atthīti dīpaitī’’ti (vajira ṭī॰ bāhiranidānakathāvaṇṇanā), tadayuttamaiva| na haittha ca-saddaina tadatthau viñ‍ñāyati| yadi caittha tadatthadassanatthamaiva ca-kārau adhippaitau siyā, aivaṃ sati sau na kattabbauyaiva paṭhamasaddainaiva añ‍ñāsaṃ dutiyādisaṅgītīnampi  atthibhāvassa dassitattā| dutiyādimupādāya hi paṭhamasaddapayaugau  dīghādimupādāya rassādisaddapayaugau viya| yathāpac‍cayaṃ tattha tattha daisitattā, pañ‍ñattattā ca vippakiṇṇānaṃ dhammavinayānaṃ saṅgahaitvā gāyanaṃ kathanaṃ saṅgīti, aitaina taṃ taṃ sikkhāpadānaṃ, taṃtaṃsuttānañ‍ca ādipariyausānaisu, antarantarā ca sambandhavasaina ṭhapitaṃ saṅgītikārakavacanaṃ saṅgahitaṃ hauti| mahāvisayattā, pūjitattā ca mahatī saṅgīti mahāsaṅgīti, paṭhamā mahāsaṅgīti paṭhamamahāsaṅgīti| kiñ‍cāpīti anuggahatthau, taina pāḷiyampi sā saṅgītimāruḷhāvāti anuggahaṃ karauti, aivampi tatthāruḷhamattaina idha sautūnaṃ nidānakausal‍laṃ na hautīti pana-saddaina aruciyatthaṃ dassaiti| nidadāti daisanaṃ daisakālādivasaina aviditaṃ viditaṃ katvā nidassaitīti nidānaṃ, tasmiṃ kausal‍laṃ, tadatthāyāti atthau|

idāni taṃ vitthāraitvā dassaituṃ ‘‘dhammacak‍kapavattanañhī’’tiādi vuttaṃ| tattha sattānaṃ dassanānuttariyasaraṇādipaṭilābhahaitubhūtāsu vij‍jamānāsupi añ‍ñāsu bhagavatau kiriyāsu ‘‘buddhau baudhaiyya’’nti (bu॰ vaṃ॰ aṭṭha॰ abbhantaranidāna 1; cariyā॰ aṭṭha॰ pakiṇṇakakathā; udāna aṭṭha॰ 18) paṭiñ‍ñāya anulaumanatau vinaiyyānaṃ maggaphaluppattihaitubhūtā kiriyāva nippariyāyaina buddhakic‍caṃ nāmāti taṃ sarūpatau dassaituṃ ‘‘dhammacak‍kappavattanañhi…pai॰… vinayanā’’ti vuttaṃ| dhammacak‍kappavattanatau pana pubbabhāgai bhagavatā bhāsitaṃ suṇantānampi vāsanābhāgiyamaiva jātaṃ, na saikkhabhāgiyaṃ, na nibbaidhabhāgiyaṃ tapussabhal‍likānaṃ saraṇadānaṃ viya| aisā hi dhammatā, tasmā tamaiva mariyādabhāvaina vuttanti vaiditabbaṃ| saddhindriyādi dhammauyaiva pavattanaṭṭhaina cak‍kanti dhammacak‍kaṃ| atha vā cak‍kanti āṇā, dhammatau anapaitattā dhammañ‍ca taṃ cak‍kañ‍cāti dhammacak‍kaṃ| dhammaina ñāyaina cak‍kantipi dhammacak‍kaṃ| vuttañhi paṭisambhidāyaṃ –

‘‘dhammañ‍ca pavattaiti cak‍kañ‍cāti dhammacak‍kaṃ| cak‍kañ‍ca pavattaiti dhammañ‍cāti dhammacak‍kaṃ, dhammaina pavattaitīti dhammacak‍kaṃ, dhammacariyāya pavattaitīti dhammacak‍ka’’ntiādi (paṭi॰ ma॰ 2.40, 41)|

tassa pavattanaṃ tathā| pavattananti ca pavattayamānaṃ, pavattitanti pac‍cuppan‍nātītavasaina dvidhā atthau| yaṃ sandhāya aṭṭhakathāsu vuttaṃ ‘‘dhammacak‍kapavattanasuttantaṃ  daisaintau dhammacak‍kaṃ pavattaiti nāma, añ‍ñāsikauṇḍañ‍ñatthairassa maggaphalādhigatatau paṭṭhāya pavattitaṃ nāmā’’ti (saṃ॰ ni॰ aṭṭha॰ 3.5.1081-1088; paṭi॰ ma॰ aṭṭha॰ 2.2.40)| idha pana pac‍cuppan‍navasainaiva atthau yuttau| yāvāti paricchaidatthai nipātau, subhaddassa nāma paribbājakassa vinayanaṃ  antauparicchaidaṃ katvāti abhividhivasaina atthau vaiditabbau| tañhi bhagavā parinibbānamañ‍cai nipan‍nauyaiva vinaisīti| kataṃ pariniṭṭhāpitaṃ buddhakic‍caṃ yaināti tathā, tasmiṃ| katabuddhakic‍cai bhagavati laukanāthai parinibbutaiti sambandhau, aitaina buddhakattabbassa kic‍cassa kassacipi asaisitabhāvaṃ dīpaiti| tatauyaiva hi bhagavā parinibbutauti| nanu ca sāvakaihi vinītāpi vinaiyyā bhagavatāyaiva vinītā nāma| tathā hi sāvakabhāsitaṃ suttaṃ ‘‘buddhabhāsita’’nti vuc‍cati| sāvakavinaiyyā ca na tāva vinītā, tasmā ‘‘katabuddhakic‍cai’’ti na vattabbanti? nāyaṃ dausau taisaṃ vinayanupāyassa sāvakaisu ṭhapitattā| tainaivāha –

‘‘na tāvāhaṃ pāpima parinibbāyissāmi, yāva mai bhikkhū na sāvakā bhavissanti viyattā vinītā visāradā bahussutā dhammadharā…pai॰… uppan‍naṃ parappavādaṃ saha dhammaina suniggahitaṃ niggahaitvā sapāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ daisaissantī’’tiādi (dī॰ ni॰ 2.168; udā॰ 51)|

‘‘kusinārāya’’ntiādinā bhagavatau parinibbutadaisakālavisaisavacanaṃ ‘‘aparinibbutau bhagavā’’ti gāhassa micchābhāvadassanatthaṃ, laukai jātasaṃvaddhādibhāvadassanatthañ‍ca| tathā hi manussabhāvassa supākaṭakaraṇatthaṃ mahābaudhisattā carimabhavai dārapariggahādīnipi karauntīti| kusinārāyanti aivaṃ nāmakai nagarai| tañhi nagaraṃ kusahatthaṃ purisaṃ dassanaṭṭhānai māpitattā ‘‘kusināra’’nti vuc‍cati, samīpatthai caitaṃ bhummaṃ| upavattanai mal‍lānaṃ sālavanaiti tassa nagarassa upavattanabhūtai mal‍larājūnaṃ sālavanai| tañhi sālavanaṃ nagaraṃ pavisitukāmā uyyānatau upac‍ca vattanti gacchanti aitaināti upavattanaṃ| yathā hi anurādhapurassa dakkhiṇapacchimadisāyaṃ thūpārāmau, aivaṃ taṃ uyyānaṃ kusinārāya dakkhiṇapacchimadisāyaṃ hauti| yathā ca thūpārāmatau dakkhiṇadvāraina nagaraṃ pavisanamaggau pācīnamukhau gantvā uttaraina nivattati, aivaṃ uyyānatau sālapanti pācīnamukhā gantvā uttaraina nivattā, tasmā taṃ ‘‘upavattana’’nti vuc‍cati| aparai pana  ‘‘taṃ sālavanamupagantvā mittasuhaj‍jai apalaukaitvā nivattanatau upavattananti pākaṭaṃ jātaṃ kirā’’ti vadanti| yamakasālānamantaraiti yamakasālānaṃ vaimajjhai| tattha kira bhagavatau pañ‍ñattassa parinibbānamañ‍cassa sīsabhāgai aikā sālapanti hauti, pādabhāgai aikā| tatrāpi aikau taruṇasālau sīsabhāgassa āsan‍nau hauti, aikau pādabhāgassa| tasmā ‘‘yamakasālānamantarai’’ti vuttaṃ| apica ‘‘yamakasālā nāma mūlakkhandhaviṭapapattaihi añ‍ñamañ‍ñaṃ saṃsibbaitvā ṭhitasālā’’tipi mahāaṭṭhakathāyaṃ vuttaṃ| mā iti candau vuc‍cati tassa gatiyā divasassa  minitabbatau, tadā sabbakalāpāripūriyā puṇṇau aiva māti puṇṇamā| saddavidū pana ‘‘mau sivau candimā caivā’’ti vuttaṃ sak‍katabhāsānayaṃ gahaitvā aukārantampi candimavācaka ma-saddamicchanti| visākhāya yuttau puṇṇamā yatthāti visākhāpuṇṇamau, sauyaiva divasau tathā, tasmiṃ| pac‍cūsati timiraṃ vināsaitīti pac‍cūsau, pati-pubbau usa-saddau rujāyanti hi nairuttikā, sauyaiva samayauti rattiyā pacchimayāmapariyāpan‍nau kālavisaisau vuc‍cati, tasmiṃ| visākhāpuṇṇamadivasai īdisai rattiyā pacchimasamayaiti vuttaṃ hauti|

upādīyatai kammakilaisaihīti upādi, vipākakkhandhā, kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ| sau pana upādi kilaisābhisaṅkhāramāranimmathanai anaussaṭṭhau, idha khandhamac‍cumāranimmathanai aussaṭṭhauna saisitau, tasmā natthi aitissā upādisaṅkhātau saisau, upādissa vā saisauti katvā ‘‘anupādisaisā’’ti vuc‍cati| nibbānadhātūti caittha nibbutimattaṃ adhippaitaṃ, nibbānañ‍ca taṃ sabhāvadhāraṇatau dhātu cāti katvā| nibbutiyā hi kāraṇapariyāyaina asaṅkhatadhātu tathā vuc‍cati| itthambhūtalakkhaṇai cāyaṃ karaṇaniddaisau| anupādisaisatāsaṅkhātaṃ imaṃ pakāraṃ bhūtassa pattassa parinibbutassa bhagavatau lakkhaṇai nibbānadhātusaṅkhātai atthai tatiyāti vuttaṃ hauti| nanu ca ‘‘anupādisaisāyā’’ti nibbānadhātuyāva visaisanaṃ hauti, na parinibbutassa bhagavatau, atha kasmā taṃ bhagavā pattauti vuttauti? nibbānadhātuyā sahacaraṇatau| taṃsahacaraṇaina hi bhagavāpi anupādisaisabhāvaṃ pattauti vuc‍cati| atha vā anupādisaisabhāvasaṅkhātaṃ imaṃ pakāraṃ pattāya nibbānadhātuyā lakkhaṇai sañ‍jānanakiriyāya tatiyātipi vattuṃ yuj‍jati| anupādisaisāya nibbānadhātuyāti ca anupādisaisanibbānadhātu  hutvāti atthau| ‘‘ūnapañ‍cabandhanaina pattainā’’ti (pārā॰ 612)| aittha hi ūnapañ‍cabandhanapattau hutvāti atthaṃ vadanti| apica nibbānadhātuyā anupādisaisāya anupādisaisā hutvā bhūtāyātipi yuj‍jati| vuttañhi udānaṭṭhakathāya nandasuttavaṇṇanāyaṃ ‘‘upaḍḍhul‍likhitaihi kaisaihīti itthambhūtalakkhaṇai karaṇavacanaṃ vippakatul‍likhitaihi kaisaihi upalakkhitāti atthau’’ti (udā॰ aṭṭha॰ 22) aisanayau īdisaisu| dhātubhājanadivasaiti jaiṭṭhamāsassa suk‍kapakkhapañ‍camīdivasaṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ, tañ‍ca na ‘‘san‍nipatitāna’’nti aitassa visaisanaṃ, ‘‘ussāhaṃ janaisī’’ti aitassa pana visaisanaṃ ‘‘dhātubhājanadivasai bhikkhūnaṃ ussāhaṃ janaisī’’ti ussāhajananassa kālavasaina bhin‍nādhikaraṇavisaisanabhāvatau| dhātubhājanadivasatau hi purimataradivasaisupi bhikkhū san‍nipatitāti| atha vā ‘‘san‍nipatitāna’’nti idaṃ kāyasāmaggivasaina san‍nipatanamaiva sandhāya vuttaṃ, na samāgamanamattaina| tasmā ‘‘dhātubhājanadivasai’’ti idaṃ ‘‘san‍nipatitāna’’nti aitassa visaisanaṃ sambhavati, idañ‍ca bhikkhūnaṃ ussāhaṃ janaisīti aittha ‘‘bhikkhūna’’nti aitainapi sambajjhanīyaṃ| saṅghassa thairau saṅghatthairau| sau pana saṅghau kiṃ parimāṇauti āha ‘‘sattan‍naṃ bhikkhusatasahassāna’’nti| saṅghasaddaina hi aviñ‍ñāyamānassa parimāṇassa viñ‍ñāpanatthamaivaitaṃ puna vuttaṃ| saddavidū pana vadanti –

‘‘samāsau ca taddhitau ca, vākyatthaisu visaisakā|

pasiddhiyantu sāmañ‍ñaṃ, tailaṃ sugatacīvaraṃ||

tasmā nāmamattabhūtassa saṅghatthairassa visaisanatthamaivaitaṃ puna vuttanti, nic‍casāpaikkhatāya ca aidisaisu samāsau yathā ‘‘daivadattassa garukula’’nti| nic‍casāpaikkhatā caittha saṅghasaddassa bhikkhusatasahassasaddaṃ sāpaikkhattaipi añ‍ñapadantarābhāvaina vākyai viya apaikkhitabbatthassa gamakattā| ‘‘sattan‍naṃ bhikkhusatasahassāna’’nti hi aitassa saṅghasaddai avayavībhāvaina sambandhau, tassāpi sāmibhāvaina thairasaddaiti| ‘‘sattan‍naṃ bhikkhusatasahassāna’’nti ca gaṇapāmaukkhabhikkhūyaiva sandhāya vuttaṃ| tadā hi san‍nipatitā bhikkhū aittakāti gaṇanapathamatik‍kantā| tathā hi vaiḷuvagāmai vaidanāvikkhambhanatau paṭṭhāya ‘‘nacirainaiva bhagavā parinibbāyissatī’’ti sutvā tatau tatau āgataisu bhikkhūsu aikabhikkhupi pak‍kantau nāma natthi| yathāhu –

‘‘sattasatasahassāni, taisu pāmaukkhabhikkhavau|

thairau mahākassapauva, saṅghatthairau tadā ahū’’ti||

āyasmā mahākassapau anussarantau mañ‍ñamānau cintayantau hutvā ussāhaṃ janaisi, anussarantau mañ‍ñamānau cintayantau āyasmā mahākassapau ussāhaṃ janaisīti vā sambandhau| mahantaihi sīlakkhandhādīhi saman‍nāgatattā mahantau kassapauti mahākassapau|  apica ‘‘mahākassapau’’ti uruvailakassapau nadīkassapau gayākassapau kumārakassapauti imai khuddānukhuddakai thairai upādāya vuc‍cati| kasmā panāyasmā mahākassapau ussāhaṃ janaisīti anuyaugai sati taṃ kāraṇaṃ vibhāvaintau āha ‘‘sattāhaparinibbutai’’tiādi| satta ahāni samāhaṭāni sattāhaṃ| sattāhaṃ parinibbutassa assāti tathā yathā ‘‘acirapak‍kantau, māsajātau’’ti, antatthaañ‍ñapadasamāsauyaṃ, tasmiṃ| bhagavatau parinibbānadivasatau paṭṭhāya sattāhai vītivattaiti vuttaṃ hauti, aitassa ‘‘vuttavacana’’nti padaina sambandhau, tathā ‘‘subhaddaina vuḍḍhapabbajitainā’’ti aitassapi| tattha subhaddauti tassa nāmamattaṃ, vuḍḍhakālai pana pabbajitattā ‘‘vuḍḍhapabbajitainā’’ti vuttaṃ, aitaina subhaddaparibbājakādīhi taṃ visaisaṃ karauti| ‘‘alaṃ āvusau’’tiādinā  taina vuttavacanaṃ nidassaiti| sau hi sattāhaparinibbutai bhagavati āyasmatā mahākassapatthairaina saddhiṃ pāvāya kusināraṃ addhānamaggapaṭipan‍naisu pañ‍camattaisu bhikkhusataisu avītarāgai bhikkhū antarāmaggai diṭṭhaājīvakassa santikā bhagavatau parinibbānaṃ sutvā pattacīvarāni chaḍḍaitvā bāhā paggayhaṃ nānappakāraṃ paridaivantai disvā aivamāha|

kasmā pana sau aivamāhāti? bhagavati āghātaina| ayaṃ kiraisau khandhakai āgatai ātumāvatthusmiṃ (mahāva॰ 303) nahāpitapubbakau vuḍḍhapabbajitau bhagavati kusināratau nikkhamitvā aḍḍhataiḷasaihi bhikkhusataihi saddhiṃ ātumaṃ gacchantai ‘‘bhagavā āgacchatī’’ti sutvā ‘‘āgatakālaiyāgudānaṃ karissāmī’’ti sāmaṇairabhūmiyaṃ ṭhitai dvai puttai aitadavauca ‘‘bhagavā kira tātā ātumaṃ āgacchati mahatā bhikkhusaṅghaina saddhiṃ aḍḍhataiḷasaihi bhikkhusataihi, gacchatha tumhai tātā, khurabhaṇḍaṃ ādāya nāḷiyā vā pasibbakaina vā anugharakaṃ āhiṇḍatha, lauṇampi tailampi taṇḍulampi khādanīyampi  saṃharatha, bhagavatau āgatassa yāgudānaṃ karissāmī’’ti| tai tathā akaṃsu| atha bhagavati ātumaṃ āgantvā bhusāgārakaṃ paviṭṭhai subhaddau sāyanhasamayaṃ gāmadvāraṃ gantvā manussai āmantaitvā ‘‘hatthakammamattaṃ mai daithā’’ti hatthakammaṃ yācitvā ‘‘kiṃ bhantai karaumā’’ti vuttai ‘‘idañ‍cidañ‍ca gaṇhathā’’ti sabbūpakaraṇāni gāhāpaitvā vihārai uddhanāni kāraitvā aikaṃ kāḷakaṃ kāsāvaṃ nivāsaitvā tādisamaiva pārupitvā ‘‘idaṃ karautha, idaṃ karauthā’’ti sabbarattiṃ vicāraintau satasahassaṃ vissaj‍jaitvā bhauj‍jayāguñ‍ca madhugauḷakañ‍ca paṭiyādāpaisi| bhauj‍jayāgu nāma bhuñ‍jitvā pātabbayāgu, tattha sappimadhuphāṇitamacchamaṃsapupphaphalarasādi yaṃ kiñ‍ci khādanīyaṃ nāma atthi, taṃ sabbaṃ pavisati| kīḷitukāmānaṃ sīsamakkhanayauggā hauti sugandhagandhā|
