kāyauti attabhāvau, yau rūpārūpadhammasamūhau| aivañhissa ambarukkhasadisatā, tadavayavānañ‍ca rūpakkhandhacakkhāyatanacakkhudhātādīnaṃ ambapak‍kasadisatā  yuj‍jati| tanti kāyaṃ| pañ‍capak‍kadvādasapak‍kaaṭṭhārasapak‍kaparimāṇāti pañ‍capak‍kaparimāṇā aikā, dvādasapak‍kaparimāṇā aikā, aṭṭhārasapak‍kaparimāṇā aikāti tividhā pak‍kambaphalapiṇḍī viya| piṇḍau aitassāti piṇḍī, thavakau| tadanvayānīti vaṇṭānugatāni, taināha ‘‘taṃyaiva vaṇṭaṃ anugatānī’’ti|

maṇḍūkakaṇṭakavisasamphassanti visavantassa bhaikavisaisassa kaṇṭakaina, tadañ‍ñaina ca visaina samphassaṃ, maṇḍūkakaṇṭakai vij‍jamānassa visassa samphassaṃ vā| sakaṇṭakau jalacārī sattau idha maṇḍūkau nāma, yau ‘‘pāsāṇakacchapau’’ti vauharanti, tassa naṅguṭṭhai aggakauṭiyaṃ ṭhitau kaṇṭakautipi vadanti| aikaṃ visamacchakaṇṭakantipi aikai| kirāti anussavanatthai nipātau| aittha ca vaṇṭacchaidai vaṇṭūpanibandhānaṃ ambapak‍kānaṃ ambarukkhatau vicchaidau viya bhavanaitticchaidai tadupanibandhānaṃ khandhādīnaṃ santānatau vicchaidauti aittāvatāva pāḷiyamāgataṃ aupammaṃ, tadavasaisaṃ pana atthatau laddhamaivāti daṭṭhabbaṃ|

148. buddhabalanti buddhānaṃ ñāṇabalaṃ| kathitasuttassa nāmāti aittha nāma-saddau sambhāvanai nipātau, taina ‘‘aivampi nāma kathitasuttassā’’ti vuttanayaina suttassa guṇaṃ sambhāvaiti| handāti vaussaggatthai| taina hi adhunāva gaṇhāpaissāmi| na papañ‍caṃ karissāmīti vaussaggaṃ karauti|

dhammapariyāyaiti dhammadaisanāsaṅkhātāya pāḷiyā| idhatthauti diṭṭhadhammahitaṃ| paratthauti samparāyahitaṃ, tadubhayatthau vā| bhāsitatthaupi yuj‍jati ‘‘dhammajāla’’nti aittha tantidhammassa gahitattā| ihāti idha sāsanai| nanti nipātamattaṃ ‘‘na naṃ sutau samaṇau gautamau’’tiādīsu viya| nti dhammāti pāḷidhammā| sabbaina sabbaṃ saṅgaṇhanatau atthasaṅkhātaṃ jālamaitthāti atthajālaṃ| tathā dhammajālaṃ brahmajālaṃ diṭṭhijālanti aitthāpi| saṅgāmaṃ vijināti aitaināti saṅgāmavijayau, saṅgāmau caittha pañ‍cahi māraihi samāgamanaṃ abhiyujjhananti āha ‘‘daivaputtamārampī’’tiādi| atthasampattiyā hi atthajālaṃ| byañ‍janasampattiyā, sīlādianavaj‍jadhammaniddaisatau  ca dhammajālaṃ| saiṭṭhaṭṭhaina brahmabhūtānaṃ maggaphalanibbānānaṃ vibhattattā brahmajālaṃ| diṭṭivivaicanamukhaina suñ‍ñatāpakāsanaina sammādiṭṭhiyā vibhattattā diṭṭhijālaṃ| titthiyavādanimmaddanupāyattā anuttarau saṅgāmavijayauti aivampaittha atthayaujanā vaiditabbā|

nidānāvasānatauti  ‘‘atha bhagavā anuppattau’’ti vacanasaṅkhātanidānapariyausānatau| mariyādāvadhivacanañhaitaṃ| apica nidānāvasānatauti nidānapariyausānai vuttattā nidānāvasānabhūtatau ‘‘mamaṃ vā bhikkhavai, parai avaṇṇaṃ bhāsaiyyu’’ntiādi (dī॰ ni॰ 1.5, 6) vacanatau| ābhividhiavadhivacanañhaitaṃ| idañ‍ca ‘‘avaucā’’ti kiriyāsambandhanaina vuttaṃ| ‘‘nidānaina ādikalyāṇa’’nti vacanatau pana nidānampi nigamanaṃ viya suttapariyāpan‍namaiva| alabbha…pai॰… gambhīranti sabbañ‍ñutañ‍ñāṇassa visaisanaṃ|

149. yathā anattamanā attanau anatthacaratāya paramanā vairimanā nāma haunti, yathāha dhammarājā dhammapadai, udānai ca –

‘‘disau disaṃ yaṃ taṃ kayirā, vairī vā pana vairinaṃ|

micchāpaṇihitaṃ cittaṃ, pāpiyau naṃ tatau karai’’ti|| (dha॰ pa॰ 42; udā॰ 33)|

na aivamimai anattamanā, imai pana attanau atthacaratāya attamanā nāma hauntīti āha ‘‘sakamanā’’ti| sakamanatā ca pītiyā gahitacittattāti dassaiti ‘‘buddhagatāyā’’tiādinā|

ayaṃ pana aṭṭhakathātau aparau nayau – attamanāti samattamanā, imāya daisanāya paripuṇṇamanasaṅkappāti atthau| daisanāvilāsau daisanāya vijambhanaṃ, tañ‍ca daisanākic‍canipphādakaṃ sabbañ‍ñutañ‍ñāṇamaiva| karavīkassa rutamiva mañ‍jumadhurassarau yassāti karavīkarutamañ‍jū, taina| amatābhisaikasadisaināti kāyacittadarathavūpasamakaṃ sabbasambhārābhisaṅkhataṃ udakaṃ dīghāyukatāsaṃvattanatau amataṃ nāma| tainābhisaikasadisaina| brahmunau sarau viya aṭṭhaṅgasaman‍nāgatau sarau yassātibrahmassarau, taina| abhinandatīti taṇhāyati, taināha ‘‘taṇhāyampi āgatau’’ti| anaikatthattā dhātūnaṃ abhinandantīti upagacchanti saivantīti atthauti āha ‘‘upagamanaipī’’ti|

tathā  abhinandantīti sampaṭicchantīti atthamāha ‘‘sampaṭicchanaipī’’ti| abhinanditvāti vuttauyaivatthau ‘‘anumauditvā’’ti iminā pakāsitauti sandhāya ‘‘anumaudanaipī’’ti vuttaṃ|

imamaivatthaṃ  gāthābandhavasaina dassaituṃ ‘‘subhāsita’’ntiādimāha| tattha saddatau subhāsitaṃ, atthatau sulapitaṃ| sīlappakāsanaina vā subhāsitaṃ, suñ‍ñatāpakāsanaina sulapitaṃ| diṭṭhivibhajanaina vā subhāsitaṃ, tan‍nibbaidhakasabbañ‍ñutañ‍ñāṇavibhajanaina sulapitaṃ| aivaṃ avaṇṇavaṇṇanisaidhanādīhipi idha dassitappakāraihi yaujaitabbaṃ| tādinauti iṭṭhāniṭṭhaisu samapaikkhanādīhi pañ‍cahi kāraṇaihi tādibhūtassa| imassa padassa vitthārau ‘‘iṭṭhāniṭṭhai tādī, cattāvīti tādī, vantāvīti tādī’’tiādinā (mahāni॰ 38) mahāniddaisai vuttau, sau upari aṭṭhakathāyampi āvibhavissati| kiñ‍cāpi ‘‘katamañ‍ca taṃ bhikkhavai’’tiādinā (dī॰ ni॰ 1.7) tattha tattha pavattāya kathaitukamyatāpucchāya vissaj‍janavasaina vuttattā idaṃ suttaṃ vaiyyākaraṇaṃ nāma bhavati| byākaraṇamaiva hi vaiyyākaraṇaṃ, tathāpi pucchāvissaj‍janāvasaina pavattaṃ suttaṃ sagāthakaṃ cai, gaiyyaṃ nāma bhavati| niggāthakaṃ, cai aṅgantarahaiturahitañ‍ca, vaiyyākaraṇaṃ nāma| iti pucchāvissaj‍janāvasaina pavattassāpi gaiyyasādhāraṇatau, aṅgantarahaiturahitassa ca niggāthakabhāvassaiva anañ‍ñasādhāraṇatau pucchāvissaj‍janabhāvamanapaikkhitvā niggāthakabhāvamaiva vaiyyākaraṇahaitutāya dassaintau ‘‘niggāthakattā hi idaṃ vaiyyākaraṇa’’nti āha|

kasmāti caudanaṃ saudhaiti ‘‘bhañ‍ñamānaiti hi vutta’’nti iminā| ubhayasambandhapadañhaitaṃ haiṭṭhā, upari ca sambajjhanatau| idaṃ vuttaṃ hauti – ‘‘bhañ‍ñamānai’’ti vattamānakālavasaina vuttattā na kaivalaṃ suttapariyausānaiyaiva, atha khau dvāsaṭṭhiyā ṭhānaisu akampitthāti vaiditabbāti| yadaivaṃ sakalaipi imasmiṃ suttai bhañ‍ñamānai akampitthāti atthauyaiva sambhavati, na pana tassa tassa diṭṭhigatassa pariyausānai pariyausānaiti atthauti? nāyamanuyaugau katthacipi na pavisati sambhavamattainaiva anuyuñ‍janatau, ayaṃ pana atthau na sambhavamattainaiva vuttau, atha khau daisanākālai kampanākārainaiva ācariyaparamparābhataina| tainaiva hi ākāraināyamatthau saṅgītimāruḷhau, tathāruḷhanayainaiva ca saṅgahakāraina vuttauti niṭṭhamaittha gantabbaṃ, itarathā atak‍kāvacarassa imassatthassa tak‍kapariyāhatakathanaṃ anupapan‍naṃ siyāti| aivamīdisaisu| ‘‘dhātukkhaubhainā’’tiādīsu atthau mahāparinibbānasuttavaṇṇanāya (dī॰ ni॰ aṭṭha॰ 2.171) gahaitabbau|

aparaisupīti  aittha pi-saddaina pāramipavicayanaṃ sampiṇḍaiti| vuttañhi buddhavaṃsai –

‘‘imai dhammai sammasatau, sabhāvasarasalakkhaṇai|

dhammataijaina vasudhā, dasasahassī pakampathā’’ti|| (bu॰ vaṃ॰ 166)|

tathā sāsanapatiṭṭhānantaradhānādayaupi| tattha sāsanapatiṭṭhānai tāva bhagavatau vaiḷuvanapaṭiggahaṇai, mahāmahindatthairassa mahāmaighavanapaṭiggahaṇai, mahāariṭṭhatthairassa vinayapiṭakasajjhāyanaiti aivamādīsu sāsanassa mūlāni autiṇṇānīti pītivasaṃ gatā nac‍cantā viya ayaṃ mahāpathavī kampittha| sāsanantaradhānai pana ‘‘ahau īdisassa saddhammassa antaradhāna’’nti daumanassappattā viya yathā taṃ kassapassa bhagavatau sāsanantaradhānai| vuttañhaitamapadānai –

‘‘tadāyaṃ pathavī sabbā, acalā sā calācalā|

sāgarau ca sasaukauva, vinadī karuṇaṃ gira’’nti|| (apa॰ 2.54.131)|

baudhimaṇḍūpasaṅkamanaiti visākhāpuṇṇamadivasai paṭhamaṃ baudhimaṇḍūpasaṅkamanai| paṃsukūlaggahaṇaiti puṇṇaṃ nāma dāsiṃ pārupitvā āmakasusānai chaḍḍitassa sāṇamayapaṃsukūlassa tumbamattai pāṇai vidhunitvā mahāariyavaṃsai ṭhatvā gahaṇai| paṃsukūladhauvanaiti tassaiva paṃsukūlassa dhauvanai| kāḷakārāmasuttaṃ (a॰ ni॰ 4.24) aṅguttarāgamai catuk‍kanipātai| gautamakasuttampi (a॰ ni॰ 3.176) tatthaiva tikanipātai| vīriyabalaināti mahābhinikkhamanai cak‍kavattisiriparic‍cāgahaitubhūtavīriyappabhāvaina| baudhimaṇḍūpasaṅkamanai –

‘‘kāmaṃ tacau ca nhāru ca, aṭṭhi ca avasissatu|

upasussatu nissaisaṃ, sarīrai maṃsalauhita’’nti|| (ma॰ ni॰ 2.184; saṃ॰ ni॰ 2.22, 237; a॰ ni॰ 2.5; 8.13; mahāni॰ 196; avidūrainidānakathā)|

vuttacaturaṅgasaman‍nāgatavīriyānubhāvaināti yathārahamatthau vaiditabbau| acchariyavaigābhihatāti vimhayāvahakiriyānubhāvaghaṭṭitā| paṃsukūladhauvanai bhagavatau puñ‍ñataijaināti vadanti| paṃsukūlaggahaṇai yathā acchariyavaigābhihatāti yuttaṃ viya dissati, taṃ pana kadāci pavattattā  ‘‘akālakampanainā’’ti  vuttaṃ| vaissantarajātakai (jā॰ 2.22.1655) pana pāramīpūraṇapuñ‍ñataijaina anaikakkhattuṃ kampitattā akālakampanaṃ nāma bhavati| sakkhinidassanai kathaitabbassa atthassānurūpatau sakkhi viya bhavatīti vuttaṃ ‘‘sakkhibhāvainā’’ti yathā taṃ māravijayakālai (jā॰ aṭṭha॰ 1.avidūrainidānakathā)| sādhukāradānaināti pakaraṇānurūpavasaina vuttaṃ yathā taṃ dhammacak‍kappavattanasaṅgītikālādīsu (saṃ॰ ni॰ 5.1081; mahāva॰ 13; paṭi॰ ma॰ 3.301)|

‘‘na kaivala’’ntiādinā anaikatthapathavīkampanadassanamukhaina imassa suttassa mahānubhāvatāyaiva dassitā| tattha jautivanaiti nandavanai| tañhi sāsanassa ñāṇālaukasaṅkhātāya jautiyā pātubhūtaṭṭhānattā jautivananti vuc‍catīti vinayasaṃvaṇṇanāyaṃ vuttaṃ| dhammanti anamataggasuttādidhammaṃ| pācīnaambalaṭṭhikaṭṭhānanti pācīnadisābhāgai taruṇambarukkhaina lakkhitaṭṭhānaṃ|

aivanti bhagavatā daisitakālādīsu pathavīkampanamatidisati| anaikasauti anaikadhā| sayambhunā daisitassa brahmajālassa yassa suttasaiṭṭhassāti yaujanā| idhāti imasmiṃ sāsanai| yaunisauti micchādiṭṭhippahānasammādiṭṭhisamādānādinā ñāyaina upāyaina paṭipaj‍jantūti atthau| ayaṃ tāvaittha aṭṭhakathāya līnatthavibhāvanā|

pakaraṇanayavaṇṇanā

‘‘itau paraṃ ācariya-dhammapālaina yā katā|

samuṭṭhānādihārādi-vividhatthavibhāvanā||

na sā amhaihupaikkhaiyyā, ayañhi tabbisaudhanā|

tasmā tampi pavakkhāma, sautūnaṃ ñāṇavuḍḍhiyā||

ayañhi pakaraṇanayaina pāḷiyā atthavaṇṇanā – pakaraṇanayauti ca tambapaṇṇibhāsāya vaṇṇanānayau| ‘‘naittipaiṭakappakaraṇai dhammakathikānaṃ yaujanānayautipi vadantī’’ti abhidhammaṭīkāyaṃ vuttaṃ| yasmā panāyaṃ daisanāya samuṭṭhānapayaujanabhājanaisu, piṇḍatthaisu ca paṭhamaṃ niddhāritaisu sukarā, hauti suviñ‍ñaiyyā ca, tasmā –

samuṭṭhānaṃ  payaujanaṃ, bhājanañ‍cāpi piṇḍatthaṃ|

niddhāraitvāna paṇḍitau, tatau hārādayau saṃsai||

tattha samuṭṭhānaṃ nāma daisanānidānaṃ, taṃ sādhāraṇamasādhāraṇanti duvidhaṃ, tathā sādhāraṇampi ajjhattikabāhiratau| tattha sādhāraṇaṃ ajjhattikasamuṭṭhānaṃ nāma bhagavatau mahākaruṇā| tāya hi samussāhitassa laukanāthassa vainaiyyānaṃ dhammadaisanāya cittaṃ udapādi, taṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ ‘‘sattaisu kāruñ‍ñataṃ paṭic‍ca buddhacakkhunā laukaṃ vaulaukaisī’’tiādi| aittha ca tividhāvatthāyapi mahākaruṇāya saṅgahau daṭṭhabbau yāvadaiva saddhammadaisanāhatthadānaihi saṃsāramahaughatau sattasantāraṇatthaṃ taduppattitau| yathā ca mahākaruṇā, aivaṃ sabbañ‍ñutañ‍ñāṇadasabalañāṇādayaupi daisanāya sādhāraṇamajjhattikasamuṭṭhānaṃ nāma| sabbañhi ñaiyyadhammaṃ taisaṃ daisaitabbākāraṃ, sattānaṃ āsayānusayādikañ‍ca yāthāvatau jānantau bhagavā ṭhānāṭṭhānādīsu kausal‍laina vainaiyyajjhāsayānurūpaṃ vicitranayadaisanaṃ pavattaisi| bāhiraṃ pana sādhāraṇasamuṭṭhānaṃ dasasahassimahābrahmaparivārassa sahampatibrahmunau ajjhaisanaṃ| tadajjhaisanañhi pati dhammagambhīratāpac‍cavaikkhaṇājanitaṃ appaussuk‍kataṃ paṭippassambhaitvā dhammassāmī dhammadaisanāya ussāhajātau ahausi|

asādhāraṇampi ajjhattikabāhiratau duvidhamaiva| tattha ajjhattikaṃ yāya mahākaruṇāya, yaina ca daisanāñāṇaina idaṃ suttaṃ pavattitaṃ, tadubhayamaiva| sāmañ‍ñāvatthāya hi sādhāraṇampi samānaṃ mahākaruṇādivisaisāvatthāya asādhāraṇaṃ bhavati, bāhiraṃ pana asādhāraṇasamuṭṭhānaṃ vaṇṇāvaṇṇabhaṇananti aṭṭhakathāyaṃ vuttaṃ| apica nindāpasaṃsāsu sattānaṃ vainaiyyāghātānandādibhāvamanāpatti| tattha ca anādīnavadassanaṃ bāhiramasādhāraṇasamuṭṭhānamaiva, tathā nindāpasaṃsāsu paṭipaj‍janak‍kamassa, pasaṃsāvisayassa ca khuddakādivasaina anaikavidhassa sīlassa, sabbañ‍ñutañ‍ñāṇassa ca sassatādidiṭṭhiṭṭhānai, taduttari ca appaṭihatacāratāya, tathāgatassa ca katthacipi bhavādīsu apariyāpan‍natāya sattānamanavabaudhaupi bāhiramasādhāraṇasamuṭṭhānaṃ|

payaujanampi sādhāraṇāsādhāraṇatau duvidhaṃ| tattha sādhāraṇaṃ anupādāparinibbānaṃ vimuttirasattā sabbāyapi bhagavatau daisanāya, tainaivāha  ‘‘aitadatthā kathā, aitadatthā mantanā’’tiādi (pari॰ 366) asādhāraṇaṃ pana bāhirasamuṭṭhānatau vipariyāyaina vaiditabbaṃ| nindāpasaṃsāsu hi sattānanvainaiyyāghātānandādibhāvappattiādikaṃ imissā daisanāya phalabhūtaṃ kāraṇabhāvaina  imaṃ daisanaṃ payaujaiti| phalañhi taduppādakasattiyā kāraṇaṃ payaujaiti nāma phalai satiyaiva tāya sattiyā kāraṇabhāvappattitau| atha vā yathāvuttaṃ phalaṃ imāya daisanāya bhagavantaṃ payaujaitīti ācariyasāriputtatthairaina vuttaṃ| yañhi daisanāya sādhaitabbaṃ phalaṃ, taṃ ākaṅkhitabbattā daisanāya daisakaṃ payaujaiti nāma| apica kuhanalapanādinānāvidhamicchājīvaviddhaṃsanaṃ, dvāsaṭṭhidiṭṭhijālavinivaiṭhanaṃ, diṭṭhisīsaina pac‍cayākāravibhāvanaṃ, chaphassāyatanavasaina catusac‍cakammaṭṭhānaniddaisau, sabbadiṭṭhigatānaṃ anavasaisapariyādānaṃ, attanau anupādāparinibbānadīpanañ‍ca payaujanamaiva|

bhājanaṃ pana daisanādhiṭṭhānaṃ| yai hi vaṇṇāvaṇṇanimittaanuraudhaviraudhavantacittā kuhanādivividhamicchājīvaniratā sassatādidiṭṭhipaṅkanimuggā sīlakkhandhādīsu aparipūrakārinau abuddhaguṇavisaisañāṇā vainaiyyā, tai imissā daisanāya bhājanaṃ|

piṇḍatthau pana idha labbhamānapadaihi, samudāyaina ca suttapadaina yathāsambhavaṃ saṅgahitau atthau| āghātādīnaṃ akaraṇīyatāvacanaina hi dassitaṃ paṭiñ‍ñānurūpaṃ samaṇasañ‍ñāya niyaujanaṃ, tathā khantisaurac‍cānuṭṭhānaṃ, brahmavihārabhāvanānuyaugau, saddhāpañ‍ñāsamāyaugau, satisampajañ‍ñādhiṭṭhānaṃ, paṭisaṅkhānabhāvanābalasiddhi, pariyuṭṭhānānusayappahānaṃ, ubhayahitapaṭipatti, laukadhammaihi anupalaipau ca –

pāṇātipātādīhi paṭivirativacanaina dassitā sīlavisuddhi, tāya ca hirauttappasampatti, maittākaruṇāsamaṅgitā, vītik‍kamappahānaṃ, tadaṅgappahānaṃ, duc‍caritasaṃkilaisappahānaṃ, viratittayasiddhi, piyamanāpagarubhāvanīyatānipphatti, lābhasak‍kārasilaukasamudāgamau, samathavipassanānaṃ adhiṭṭhānabhāvau, akusalamūlatanukaraṇaṃ, kusalamūlaraupanaṃ, ubhayānatthadūrīkaraṇaṃ, parisāsu visāradatā, appamādavihārau, paraihi duppadhaṃsiyatā, avippaṭisārādisamaṅgitā ca –

‘‘gambhīrā’’tiādivacanaihi  dassitaṃ gambhīradhammavibhāvanaṃ, alabbhanaiyyapatiṭṭhatā, kappānamasaṅkhyaiyyaināpi dul‍labhapātubhāvatā, sukhumainapi ñāṇaina pac‍cakkhatau paṭivijjhitumasak‍kuṇaiyyatā, dhammanvayasaṅkhātaina anumānañāṇaināpi duradhigamanīyatā, passaddhasabbadarathatā, santadhammavibhāvanaṃ, saubhanapariyausānatā, atittikarabhāvau, padhānabhāvappatti, yathābhūtañāṇagaucaratā, sukhumasabhāvatā, mahāpañ‍ñāvibhāvanā ca| diṭṭhidīpakapadaihi dassitā samāsatau sassataucchaidadiṭṭhiyau līnatātidhāvanavibhāvanaṃ, ubhayavinibandhaniddaisau, micchābhinivaisakittanaṃ, kummaggapaṭipattippakāsanaṃ, vipariyaisaggāhañāpanaṃ, parāmāsapariggahau, pubbantāparantānudiṭṭhipatiṭṭhāpanā, bhavavibhavadiṭṭhivibhāgā, taṇhāvij‍jāpavatti, antavānantavādiṭṭhiniddaisau, antadvayāvatāraṇaṃ, āsavaughayaugakilaisaganthasaṃyaujanupādānavisaisavibhajanañ‍ca –

tathā ‘‘vaidanānaṃ samudaya’’ntiādivacanaihi dassitā catun‍namariyasac‍cānaṃ anubaudhapaṭibaudhasiddhi, vikkhambhanasamucchaidappahānaṃ taṇhāvij‍jāvigamau, saddhammaṭṭhitinimittapariggahau, āgamādhigamasampatti, ubhayahitapaṭipatti, tividhapañ‍ñāpariggahau, satisampajañ‍ñānuṭṭhānaṃ, saddhāpañ‍ñāsamāyaugau, vīriyasamatānuyaujanaṃ, samathavipassanānipphatti ca –

‘‘ajānataṃ apassata’’nti padaihi dassitā avij‍jāsiddhi, tathā ‘‘taṇhāgatānaṃ paritassitavipphandita’’nti padaihi taṇhāsiddhi, tadubhayaina ca nīvaraṇasañ‍ñaujanadvayasiddhi, anamataggasaṃsāravaṭṭānupacchaidau, pubbantāharaṇāparantānusandhānāni, atītapac‍cuppan‍nakālavasaina haituvibhāgau, avij‍jātaṇhānaṃ añ‍ñamañ‍ñānativattanaṃ, añ‍ñamañ‍ñūpakāritā, pañ‍ñāvimutticaitauvimuttīnaṃ paṭipakkhaniddaisau ca –

‘‘tadapi phassapac‍cayā’’ti padaina dassitā sassatādipañ‍ñāpanassa pac‍cayādhīnavuttitā, taina ca dhammānaṃ nic‍catāpaṭisaidhau, anic‍catāpatiṭṭhāpanaṃ, paramatthatau kārakādipaṭikkhaipau, aivaṃdhammatāniddaisau, suñ‍ñatāpakāsanaṃ samatthanirīha pac‍cayalakkhaṇavibhāvanañ‍ca –

‘‘ucchin‍nabhavanaittikau’’tiādinā  dassitā bhagavatau pahānasampatti, vij‍jāvimuttivasībhāvau, sikkhattayanipphatti, nibbānadhātudvayavibhāgau, caturadhiṭṭhānaparipūraṇaṃ, bhavayauniādīsu apariyāpan‍natā ca –

sakalaina pana suttapadaina dassitau iṭṭhāniṭṭhaisu bhagavatau tādibhāvau, tattha ca paraisaṃ patiṭṭhāpanaṃ, kusaladhammānaṃ ādibhūtadhammadvayaniddaisau sikkhattayūpadaisau, attantapādipuggalacatuk‍kasiddhi, kaṇhakaṇhavipākādikammacatuk‍kavibhāgau, caturappamañ‍ñāvisayaniddaisau, samudayatthaṅgamādipañ‍cakassa yathābhūtāvabaudhau, chasāraṇīyadhammavibhāvanā, dasanāthakadhammapatiṭṭhāpananti aivamādayau yathāsambhavaṃ saṅgahaitvā dassaitabbā atthā piṇḍatthau|

sauḷasahāravaṇṇanā

daisanāhāravaṇṇanā

idāni  naittiyā, paiṭakaupadaisai ca vuttanayavasaina hārādīnaṃ niddhāraṇaṃ| tattha ‘‘attā, laukau’’ti ca diṭṭhiyā adhiṭṭhānabhāvaina, vaidanāphassāyatanādimukhaina ca gahitaisu pañ‍casu upādānakkhandhaisu taṇhāvaj‍jitā pañ‍cupādānakkhandhā dukkhasac‍caṃ| taṇhā samudayasac‍caṃ| taṃ pana ‘‘paritassanāgahaṇaina taṇhāgatāna’’nti, ‘‘vaidanāpac‍cayā taṇhā’’ti ca padaihi samudayaggahaṇainañ‍ca pāḷiyaṃ sarūpaina gahitamaiva| ayaṃ tāva suttantanayau|

abhidhammai pana vibhaṅgappakaraṇai āgatanayaina āghātānandādivacanaihi, ‘‘ātappamanvāyā’’tiādipadaihi, cittapadausavacanaina, sabbadiṭṭhigatikapadaihi, kusalākusalaggahaṇaina, bhavaggahaṇaina, saukādiggahaṇaina, diṭṭhiggahaṇaina, tattha tattha samudayaggahaṇaina cāti saṅkhaipatau sabbalaukiyakusalākusaladhammavibhāvanapadaihi gahitā dhammakilaisā samudayasac‍caṃ| tadubhayaisamappavatti niraudhasac‍caṃ| tassa pana tattha tattha vaidanānaṃ atthaṅgamanissaraṇapariyāyaihi pac‍cattaṃ nibbutivacanaina, anupādāvimuttivacanaina ca pāḷiyaṃ gahaṇaṃ vaiditabbaṃ| niraudhapajānanā paṭipadā maggasac‍caṃ| tassapi tattha tattha vaidanānaṃ samudayādīni yathābhūtapaṭivaidhanāpadaisaina chan‍naṃ phassāyatanānaṃ samudayādīni yathābhūtapajānanapariyāyaina, bhavanaittiyā ucchaidavacanaina ca gahaṇaṃ vaiditabbaṃ|

tattha  samudayaina assādau, dukkhaina ādīnavau, magganiraudhaihi nissaraṇanti aivaṃ catusac‍cavasaina, yāni pāḷiyaṃ sarūpainaiva āgatāni assādādīnavanissaraṇāni, taisañ‍ca vasaina idha assādādayau vaiditabbā| vainaiyyānaṃ tādibhāvāpattiādi phalaṃ| yañhi daisanāya sādhaitabbaṃ haiṭṭhā vuttaṃ payaujanaṃ| tadaiva phalanti vuttauvāyamatthau| tadatthañhi idaṃ suttaṃ bhagavatā daisitaṃ| āghātādīnamakaraṇīyatā, āghātādiphalassa ca anañ‍ñasantānabhāvitā nindāpasaṃsāsu yathāsabhāvaṃ paṭijānananibbaiṭhanānīti aivaṃ taṃtaṃpayaujanādhigamahaitu upāyau| āghātādīnaṃ karaṇapaṭisaidhanādiapadaisaina atthakāmaihi tatau cittaṃ sādhukaṃ rakkhitabbanti ayaṃ āṇārahassa dhammarājassa āṇattīti| ayaṃ assādādīnavanissaraṇaphalūpāyāṇattivasaina chabbidhadhammasandassanalakkhaṇau daisanāhārau nāma| vuttañ‍ca –

‘‘assādādīnavatā, nissaraṇampi ca phalaṃ upāyau ca|

āṇattī ca bhagavatau, yaugīnaṃ daisanāhārau’’ti||

vicayahāravaṇṇanā

kappanābhāvaipi vauhāravasaina, anuvādavasaina ca ‘‘mama’’nti vuttaṃ| niyamābhāvatau vikappanatthaṃ vāggahaṇaṃ| taṃguṇasamaṅgitāya, abhimukhīkaraṇāya ca ‘‘bhikkhavai’’ti āmantanaṃ| añ‍ñabhāvatau, paṭiviruddhabhāvatau ca ‘‘parai’’ti vuttaṃ, vaṇṇapaṭipakkhatau, avaṇṇanīyatau ca ‘‘avaṇṇa’’nti, byattivasaina, vitthāravasaina ca ‘‘bhāsaiyyu’’nti, dhāraṇasabhāvatau, adhammapaṭipakkhatau ca ‘‘dhammassā’’ti, diṭṭhisīlaihi saṃhatabhāvatau, kilaisānaṃ saṅghātakaraṇatau ca ‘‘saṅghassā’’ti, vuttapaṭiniddaisatau, vacanupanyāsatau ca ‘‘tatrā’’ti, sammukhībhāvatau, puthubhāvatau ca ‘‘tumhaihī’’ti, cittassa hananatau, ārammaṇābhighātatau ca ‘‘āghātau’’ti, ārammaṇai saṅkaucavuttiyā anabhimukhatāya, atuṭṭhākāratāya ca ‘‘appac‍cayau’’ti, ārammaṇacintanatau, nissayatau ca ‘‘caitasau’’ti, atthassa asādhanatau, anu anu anatthasādhanatau ca ‘‘anabhiraddhī’’ti, kāraṇānarahattā, satthusāsanai

ṭhitaihi  kātumasak‍kuṇaiyyattā ca ‘‘na karaṇīyā’’ti vuttaṃ| aivaṃ tasmiṃ tasmiṃ adhippaitatthai pavattatānidassanaina, atthasau ca –

mamanti sāminiddiṭṭhaṃ sabbanāmapadaṃ| vāti vikappananiddiṭṭhaṃ nipātapadaṃ| bhikkhavaiti ālapananiddiṭṭhaṃ nāmapadaṃ| paraiti kattuniddiṭṭhaṃ nāmapadaṃ| avaṇṇanti kammaniddiṭṭhaṃ nāmapadaṃ| bhāsaiyyunti kiriyāniddiṭṭhaṃ ākhyātapadaṃ| dhammassa, saṅghassāti ca sāminiddiṭṭhaṃ nāmapadaṃ| tatrāti ādhāraniddiṭṭhaṃ sabbanāmapadaṃ| tumhaihīti kattuniddiṭṭhaṃ sabbanāmapadaṃ| na-iti paṭisaidhaniddiṭṭhaṃ nipātapadaṃ| āghātau, appac‍cayau, anabhiraddhīti ca kammaniddiṭṭhaṃ nāmapadaṃ| caitasauti sāminiddiṭṭhaṃ nāmapadaṃ| karaṇīyāti kiriyāniddiṭṭhaṃ nāmapadanti| aivaṃ tassa tassa padassa visaisatānidassanaina, byañ‍janasau ca vicayanaṃ padavicayau| ativitthārabhayaina pana sak‍kāyaiva aṭṭhakathaṃ, tassā ca līnatthavibhāvanaṃ anugantvā ayamatthau viñ‍ñunā vibhāvaitunti na vitthārayimha|

‘‘tatra cai tumhai assatha kupitā vā anattamanā vā, api nu tumhai paraisaṃ subhāsitaṃ dubbhāsitaṃ  ājānaiyyāthā’’ti ayaṃ anumatipucchā| sattādhiṭṭhānā, anaikādhiṭṭhānā, paramatthavisayā, pac‍cuppan‍navisayāti aivaṃ sabbattha yathāsambhavaṃ pucchāvicayanaṃ pucchāvicayau| ‘‘nau haitaṃ bhantai’’ti idaṃ vissaj‍janaṃ aikaṃsabyākaraṇaṃ, niravasaisaṃ, sauttaraṃ, laukiyanti aivaṃ sabbassāpi vissaj‍janassa yathārahaṃ vicayanaṃ vissaj‍janāvicayau|

‘‘mamaṃ vā bhikkhavai parai avaṇṇaṃ bhāsaiyyuṃ…pai॰… na caitasau anabhiraddhi karaṇīyā’’ti imāya paṭhamadaisanāya ‘‘mamaṃ vā…pai॰… tumhaṃyaivassa taina antarāyau’’ti ayaṃ dutiyadaisanā saṃsandati| kasmā? paṭhamāya manaupadausaṃ nivāraitvā dutiyāya tatthādīnavassa dassitattā| tathā imāya dutiyadaisanāya ‘‘mamaṃ vā…pai॰… api nu tumhai paraisaṃ subhāsitaṃ dubbhāsitaṃ ājānaiyyāthā’’ti ayaṃ tatiyadaisanā saṃsandati| kasmā? dutiyāya tatthādīnavaṃ dassaitvā tatiyāya vacanatthasal‍lakkhaṇamattaipi asamatthabhāvassa dassitattā| tathā imāya tatiyadaisanāya ‘‘mamaṃ vā…pai॰… na ca panaitaṃ amhaisu saṃvij‍jatī’’ti ayaṃ catutthadaisanā saṃsandati| kasmā? tatiyāya manaupadausaṃ sabbathā nivāraitvā catutthāya avaṇṇaṭṭhānai paṭipaj‍jitabbākārassa dassitattāti iminā nayaina pubbaina aparaṃ saṃsanditvā vicayanaṃ pubbāparavicayau| assādavicayādayau vuttanayāva| taisaṃ lakkhaṇasandassanamattamaiva haittha visaisau|

‘‘api  nu tumhai paraisaṃ subhāsitaṃ dubbhāsitaṃ ājānaiyyāthā’’ti imāya pucchāya ‘‘nau haitaṃ bhantai’’ti ayaṃ vissaj‍janā samaiti| kupitau hi naiva buddhapac‍caikabuddhaariyasāvakānaṃ na mātāpitūnaṃ na pac‍catthikānaṃ subhāsitadubbhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānāti| ‘‘katamañ‍ca taṃ bhikkhavai, appamattakaṃ…pai॰… tathāgatassa vaṇṇaṃ vadamānau vadaiyyā’’ti imāya pucchāya ‘‘pāṇātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭiviratau’’tiādikā ayaṃ vissaj‍janā samaiti| bhagavā hi anuttaraina pāṇātipātaviramaṇādiguṇaina saman‍nāgatau, tañ‍ca khau samādhiṃ, pañ‍ñañ‍ca upanidhāya appamattakaṃ auramattakaṃ sīlamattakaṃ| ‘‘katamai ca tai bhikkhavai, dhammā gambhīrā duddasā’’tiādikāya pucchāya ‘‘santi bhikkhavai, aikai samaṇabrāhmaṇā pubbantakappikā’’tiādikā vissaj‍janā samaiti| sabbañ‍ñutañ‍ñāṇaguṇā hi añ‍ñatra tathāgatā añ‍ñaisaṃ ñāṇaina alabbhanaiyyapatiṭṭhattā gambhīrā duddasā duranubaudhā santā paṇītā atak‍kāvacarā nipuṇā paṇḍitavaidanīyāti iminā nayaina vissaj‍janāya pucchānurūpatāvicayanamaiva idha saṅgahagāthāya abhāvatau anugītivicayauti| ayaṃ padapañhādiaikādasadhammavicayanalakkhaṇau vicayahārau nāma| vuttañ‍ca ‘‘yaṃ pucchitañ‍ca vissaj‍jitañ‍cā’’tiādi (naitti॰ 4.2)|

yuttihārasaṃvaṇṇanā

mamanti  sāminiddaisau yuj‍jati sabhāvaniruttiyā tathāpayaugadissanatau, avaṇṇassa ca tadapaikkhattā| vāti vikappanatthaniddaisau yuj‍jati naipātikānamanaikatthattā, aittha ca niyamābhāvatau| bhikkhavaiti āmantananiddaisau yuj‍jati tadatthaiyaiva aitassa payaugassa dissanatau, daisakassa ca paṭiggāhakāpaikkhatauti aivamādinā byañ‍janatau ca –

sabbaina sabbaṃ āghātādīnamakaraṇaṃ tādibhāvāya saṃvattatīti yuj‍jati iṭṭhāniṭṭhaisu samappavattisabbhāvatau| yasmiṃ santānai āghātādayau uppan‍nā, tan‍nimittakā antarāyā tassaiva sampattivibandhāya saṃvattantīti yuj‍jati kammānaṃ santānantaraisu asaṅkamanatau| cittamabhibhavitvā uppan‍nā āghātādayau subhāsitadubbhāsitasal‍lakkhaṇaipi asamatthatāya  saṃvattantīti yuj‍jati kaudhalaubhānaṃ andhatamasabhāvatau| pāṇātipātādidussīlyatau vairamaṇī sabbasattānaṃ pāmauj‍japāsaṃsāya saṃvattatīti yuj‍jati sīlasampattiyā mahatau kittisaddassa abbhuggatattā| gambhīratādivisaisayuttaina guṇaina tathāgatassa vaṇṇanā aikadaisabhūtāpi sakalasabbañ‍ñuguṇaggahaṇāya saṃvattatīti yuj‍jati anañ‍ñasādhāraṇattā| taj‍jāayaunisaumanasikāraparikkhatāni adhigamatak‍kanāni sassatavādādiabhinivaisāya saṃvattantīti yuj‍jati kappanajālassa asamugghāṭitattā| vaidanādīnaṃ anavabaudhaina vaidanāpac‍cayā taṇhā vaḍḍhatīti yuj‍jati assādānupassanāsabbhāvatau, sati ca vaidayitabhāvai (vaidayitarāgai (dī॰ ni॰ ṭī॰ 1.149) tattha attattaniyagāhau, sassatādigāhau ca viparipphandatīti yuj‍jati kāraṇassa san‍nihitattā| taṇhāpac‍cayā hi upādānaṃ sambhavati| sassatādivādai pañ‍ñapaintānaṃ, tadanucchavikañ‍ca vaidanaṃ vaidayantānaṃ phassau haitūti yuj‍jati visayindriyaviñ‍ñāṇasaṅgatiyā vinā tadabhāvatau| chaphassāyatananimittaṃ vaṭṭassa anupacchaidauti yuj‍jati tattha avij‍jātaṇhānaṃ appahīnattā| chan‍naṃ phassāyatanānaṃ samudayatthaṅgamādipajānanā sabbadiṭṭhigatikasañ‍ñaṃ atic‍ca tiṭṭhatīti yuj‍jati catusac‍capaṭivaidhabhāvatau| imāhiyaiva dvāsaṭṭhiyā sabbadiṭṭhigatānaṃ antaujālīkatabhāvauti yuj‍jati akiriyavādādīnaṃ, issaravādādīnañ‍ca tadantaugadhattā, tathā caiva haiṭṭhā saṃvaṇṇitaṃ| ucchin‍nabhavanaittikau tathāgatassa kāyauti yuj‍jati bhagavatau abhinīhārasampattiyā catūsu satipaṭṭhānaisu ṭhatvā sattan‍naṃ baujjhaṅgānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ bhāvitattā| kāyassa bhaidā parinibbutaṃ na dakkhantīti yuj‍jati anupādisaisanibbānappattiyaṃ rūpādīsu kassacipi anavasaisatauti iminā nayaina atthatau ca suttai byañ‍janatthānaṃ yuttitāvibhāvanalakkhaṇau  yuttihārau nāma yathāha ‘‘sabbaisaṃ hārānaṃ, yā bhūmī’’tiādi (naitti॰ 4.3)|

padaṭṭhānahāravaṇṇanā

vaṇṇārahāvaṇṇadubbaṇṇatānādaiyyavacanatādi vipattīnaṃ padaṭṭhānaṃ| vaṇṇārahavaṇṇasubbaṇṇatāsaddhaiyyavacanatādi sampattīnaṃ padaṭṭhānaṃ| tathā āghātādayau nirayādidukkhassa padaṭṭhānaṃ| āghātādīnamakaraṇaṃ saggasampattiyādisabbasampattīnaṃ padaṭṭhānaṃ| pāṇātipātādipaṭivirati ariyassa sīlakkhandhassa  padaṭṭhānaṃ, ariyau sīlakkhandhau ariyassa samādhikkhandhassa padaṭṭhānaṃ| ariyau samādhikkhandhau ariyassa pañ‍ñākkhandhassa padaṭṭhānaṃ| gambhīratādivisaisayuttaṃ bhagavatau paṭivaidhappakārañāṇaṃ daisanāñāṇassa padaṭṭhānaṃ| daisanāñāṇaṃ vainaiyyānaṃ sakalavaṭṭadukkhanissaraṇassa padaṭṭhānaṃ| sabbāyapi diṭṭhiyā diṭṭhupādānabhāvatau sā yathārahaṃ navavidhassapi bhavassa padaṭṭhānaṃ| bhavau jātiyā| jāti jarāmaraṇassa, saukādīnañ‍ca padaṭṭhānaṃ| vaidanānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ samudayatthaṅgamādipaṭivaidhanā catun‍naṃ ariyasac‍cānaṃ anubaudhapaṭivaidhau hauti| tattha anubaudhau paṭivaidhassa padaṭṭhānaṃ| paṭivaidhau catubbidhassa sāmañ‍ñaphalassa padaṭṭhānaṃ| ‘‘ajānataṃ apassata’’nti avij‍jāgahaṇaṃ| tattha avij‍jā saṅkhārānaṃ padaṭṭhānaṃ, saṅkhārā viñ‍ñāṇassa| yāva vaidanā taṇhāya padaṭṭhānanti naitvā taisaṃ ‘‘vaidanāpac‍cayā taṇhā’’tiādinā pāḷiyamāgatanayaina sambajjhitabbaṃ| ‘‘taṇhāgatānaṃ paritassitavipphandita’’nti aittha taṇhā upādānassa padaṭṭhānaṃ| ‘‘tadapi phassapac‍cayā’’ti aittha sassatādipañ‍ñāpanaṃ paraisaṃ micchābhinivaisassa padaṭṭhānaṃ| micchābhinivaisau saddhammassavanasappurisūpanissayayaunisaumanasikāradhammānudhammapaṭipattīhi vimukhatāya asaddhammassavanādīnañ‍ca padaṭṭhānaṃ| ‘‘añ‍ñatra phassā’’tiādīsu phassau vaidanāya padaṭṭhānaṃ| cha phassāyatanāni phassassa, sakalassa ca vaṭṭadukkhassa padaṭṭhānaṃ| chan‍naṃ phassāyatanānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ samudayādipajānanaṃ nibbidāya padaṭṭhānaṃ, nibbidā virāgassātiādinā yāva anupādāparinibbānaṃ naitabbaṃ| bhagavatau bhavanaittisamucchaidau sabbañ‍ñutāya padaṭṭhānaṃ, tathā anupādāparinibbānassa cāti| ayaṃ suttai āgatadhammānaṃ padaṭṭhānadhammā, taisañ‍ca padaṭṭhānadhammāti yathāsambhavaṃ padaṭṭhānadhammaniddhāraṇalakkhaṇau padaṭṭhānahārau nāma| vuttañhi ‘‘dhammaṃ daisaiti jinau, tassa ca dhammassa yaṃ padaṭṭhāna’’ntiādi (naitti॰ 4.4)|

lakkhaṇahāravaṇṇanā

āghātādiggahaṇaina  kaudhūpanāhamakkhapalāsaissāmacchariyasārambhaparavambhanādīnaṃ saṅgahau paṭighacittuppādapariyāpan‍natāya aikalakkhaṇattā| ānandādiggahaṇaina abhijjhāvisamalaubhamānātimānamadappamādānaṃ saṅgahau laubhacittuppādapariyāpan‍natāya aikalakkhaṇattā| tathā  āghātaggahaṇaina avasiṭṭhaganthanīvaraṇānaṃ saṅgahau kāyaganthanīvaraṇalakkhaṇaina aikalakkhaṇattā| ānandaggahaṇaina phassādīnaṃ saṅgahau saṅkhārakkhandhalakkhaṇaina aikalakkhaṇattā| sīlaggahaṇaina adhicittādhipañ‍ñāsikkhānaṃ saṅgahau sikkhālakkhaṇaina aikalakkhaṇattā| diṭṭhiggahaṇaina avasiṭṭhaupādānānaṃ saṅgahau upādānalakkhaṇaina aikalakkhaṇattā| ‘‘vaidanāna’’nti aittha vaidanāggahaṇaina avasiṭṭhaupādānakkhandhānaṃ saṅgahau upādānakkhandhalakkhaṇaina aikalakkhaṇattā| tathā dhammāyatanadhammadhātupariyāpan‍navaidanāggahaṇaina sammasanupagānaṃ sabbaisampi āyatanānaṃ, dhātūnañ‍ca saṅgahau āyatanalakkhaṇaina, dhātulakkhaṇaina ca aikalakkhaṇattā| ‘‘ajānataṃ apassata’’nti aittha avij‍jāggahaṇaina haituāsavaughayauganīvaraṇādīnaṃ saṅgahau haitādilakkhaṇaina aikalakkhaṇattā, tathā ‘‘taṇhāgatānaṃ paritassitavipphandita’’nti aittha taṇhāggahaṇainapi| ‘‘tadapi phassapac‍cayā’’ti aittha phassaggahaṇaina sañ‍ñāsaṅkhāraviñ‍ñāṇānaṃ saṅgahau vipal‍lāsahaitubhāvaina, khandhalakkhaṇaina ca aikalakkhaṇattā| chaphassāyatanaggahaṇaina avasiṭṭhakhandhāyatanadhātindriyādīnaṃ saṅgahau phassuppattinimittatāya, sammasanīyabhāvaina ca aikalakkhaṇattā| bhavanaittiggahaṇaina avij‍jādīnaṃ saṃkilaisadhammānaṃ saṅgahau vaṭṭahaitubhāvaina aikalakkhaṇattāti| ayaṃ suttai anāgataipi dhammai aikalakkhaṇatādinā āgatai viya niddhāraṇalakkhaṇau lakkhaṇahārau nāma| tathā hi vuttaṃ ‘‘vuttamhi aikadhammai, yai dhammā aikalakkhaṇā’’tiādi (naitti॰ 4.5)|

catubyūhahāravaṇṇanā

mamanti anairuttapadaṃ, tathā vāti ca| bhikkhanasīlā bhikkhū| paraintiviruddhabhāvamupagacchantīti parā, añ‍ñatthai panaitaṃ anairuttapadanti aivamādinā nairuttaṃ, taṃ pana ‘‘aiva’’ntiādinidānapadānaṃ, ‘‘mama’’ntiādipāḷipadānañ‍ca aṭṭhakathāvasaina, tassā līnatthavibhāvanīvasaina ca suviñ‍ñaiyyattā ativitthārabhayaina na vitthārayimha| yai tai nindāpasaṃsāhi sammākampitacaitasā micchājīvatau anauratā sassatādimicchābhinivaisinau sīlādidhammakkhandhaisu appatiṭṭhitā sammāsambuddhaguṇarasassādavimukhā vainaiyyā, tai kathaṃ nu khau yathāvuttadausavinimuttā  sammāpaṭipattiyā ubhayahitaparā  bhavaiyyunti ayamaittha bhagavatau adhippāyau| aivamadhippaitā puggalā, daisanābhājanaṭṭhānai ca dassitā imissā daisanāya nidānaṃ|

pubbāparānusandhi pana padasandhipadatthaniddaisanikkhaipasuttadaisanāsandhivasaina chabbidhā| tattha ‘‘mama’’nti aitassa ‘‘avaṇṇa’’nti iminā sambandhautiādinā padassa padantaraina sambandhau padasandhi| ‘‘mama’’nti vuttassa bhagavatau ‘‘avaṇṇa’’nti vuttaina paraihi upavaditaina aguṇainasambandhautiādinā padatthassa padatthantaraina sambandhau padatthasandhi| ‘‘mamaṃ vā bhikkhavai, parai avaṇṇaṃ bhāsaiyyu’’ntiādidaisanā suppiyaina paribbājakaina vuttaavaṇṇānusandhivasaina pavattā| ‘‘mamaṃ vā bhikkhavai, parai vaṇṇaṃ bhāsaiyyu’’ntiādidaisanā brahmadattaina māṇavaina vuttavaṇṇānusandhivasaina pavattā| ‘‘atthi bhikkhavai, añ‍ñaiva dhammā gambhīrā duddasā duranubaudhā’’tiādidaisanā bhikkhūhi vuttavaṇṇānusandhivasaina pavattāti aivaṃ nānānusandhikassa suttassa taṃtadanusandhīhi, aikānusandhikassa ca pubbāparabhāgaihi sambandhau niddaisasandhi| nikkhaipasandhi pana catubbidhasuttanikkhaipavasaina| suttasandhi ca tividhasuttānusandhivasaina aṭṭhakathāyaṃ aiva vicāritā, amhaihi ca pubbai saṃvaṇṇitā| aikissā daisanāya daisanāntaraihi saddhiṃ saṃsandanaṃ daisanāsandhi, sā panaivaṃ vaiditabbā – ‘‘mamaṃ vā bhikkhavai…pai॰… na caitasau anabhiraddhi karaṇīyā’’ti ayaṃ daisanā ‘‘ubhataudaṇḍakaina caipi bhikkhavai, kakacaina caurā aucarakā aṅgamaṅgāni aukantaiyyuṃ, tatrapi yau manau padūsaiñ‍ña, na mai sau taina sāsanakarau’’ti (ma॰ ni॰ 1.232) imāya daisanāya saddhiṃ saṃsandati| ‘‘tumhaṃyaivassa taina anantarāyau’’ti ayaṃ ‘‘kammassakā māṇava sattā kammadāyādā kammayaunī kammabandhū kammapaṭisaraṇā kammaṃ sattai vibhajati, yadidaṃ hīnapaṇītatāyā’’ti (ma॰ ni॰ 3.289-297) imāya, ‘‘api nu tumhai…pai॰… ājānaiyyāthā’’ti ayaṃ –

‘‘kuddhau atthaṃ na jānāti, kuddhau dhammaṃ na passati|

andhaṃ tamaṃ tadā hauti, yaṃ kaudhau sahatai nara’’nti|| (a॰ ni॰ 7.64; mahāni॰ 5, 156, 195)| –

imāya, ‘‘mamaṃ vā bhikkhavai, parai vaṇṇaṃ…pai॰… na caitasau ubbilāvitattaṃ karaṇīya’’nti ayaṃ ‘‘dhammāpi vau bhikkhavai, pahātabbā, pagaiva adhammā’’ti  (ma॰ ni॰ 1.240), ‘‘kul‍lūpamaṃ vau bhikkhavai, dhammaṃ daisaissāmi nittharaṇatthāya, nau gahaṇatthāyā’’ti (ma॰ ni॰ 1.240) ca imāya, ‘‘tatra cai tumhai…pai॰… tumhaṃyaivassa taina antarāyau’’ti ayaṃ –

‘‘luddhau  atthaṃ na jānāti, luddhau dhammaṃ na passati|

andhaṃ tamaṃ tadā hauti, yaṃ laubhau sahatai nara’’nti|| (itivu॰ 88; mahāni॰ 5, 156; cūḷani॰ 128) ca –

‘‘kāmandhā jālasañchan‍nā, taṇhāchadanachāditā|

pamattabandhunābaddhā, macchāva kumīnāmukhai|

jarāmaraṇamanvainti, vacchau khīrapakauva mātara’’nti|| (udā॰ 64; naitti॰ 27, 90; paiṭakau॰ 14) ca –

imāya, ‘‘appamattakaṃ khau panaitaṃ sīlamattaka’’nti ayaṃ ‘‘vivic‍caiva kāmaihi…pai॰… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampaj‍ja viharati, ayampi khau brāhmaṇa yañ‍ñau purimaihi yañ‍ñaihi appaṭṭhatarau ca appasamārambhatarau ca mahapphalatarau ca mahānisaṃsatarau cā’’ti (dī॰ ni॰ 1.353) imāya paṭhamajjhānassa sīlatau mahapphalamahānisaṃsataratāvacanaina jhānatau sīlassa appaphalaappānisaṃsatarabhāvadīpanatau|

‘‘pāṇātipātaṃ pahāyā’’tiādidaisanā ‘‘samaṇau khalu bhau gautamau sīlavā ariyasīlaina saman‍nāgatau’’tiādidaisanāya (dī॰ ni॰ 1.304), ‘‘añ‍ñaiva dhammā gambhīrā’’tiādidaisanā ‘‘adhigatau khau myāyaṃ dhammau gambhīrau duddasau duranubaudhau’’tiādidaisanāya, (dī॰ ni॰ 2.67; ma॰ ni॰ 1.281; 2.337; saṃ॰ ni॰ 1.172; mahāva॰ 7, 8) gambhīratādivisaisayuttadhammapaṭivaidhaina hi ñāṇassa gambhīrādibhāvau viñ‍ñāyati|

‘‘santi bhikkhavai, aikai samaṇabrāhmaṇā pubbantakappikā’’tiādidaisanā ‘‘santi bhikkhavai, aikai samaṇabrāhmaṇā pubbantakappikā…pai॰… abhivadanti sassatau attā ca laukau ca, idamaiva sac‍caṃ, maughamañ‍ñanti itthaikai abhivadanti, asassatau, sassatau ca asassatau ca, naivasassatau ca nāsassatau ca, antavā, anantavā, antavā ca anantavā ca, naivantavā ca nānantavā ca attā ca laukau ca, idamaiva sac‍caṃ, maughamañ‍ñanti itthaikai abhivadantī’’tiādidaisanāya (ma॰ ni॰ 3.27)|

tathā  ‘‘santi bhikkhavai, aikai samaṇabrāhmaṇā aparantakappikā’’tiādidaisanā ‘‘santi bhikkhavai  …pai॰… abhivadanti sañ‍ñī attā hauti araugau paraṃ maraṇā| itthaikai abhivadanti asañ‍ñī, sañ‍ñī ca asañ‍ñī ca, naivasañ‍ñī ca nāsañ‍ñī ca attā hauti araugau paraṃ maraṇā| itthaikai abhivadanti satau vā pana sattassa ucchaidaṃ vināsaṃ vibhavaṃ pañ‍ñapainti, diṭṭhadhammanibbānaṃ vā panaikai abhivadantī’’ntiādidaisanāya (ma॰ ni॰ 3.21), ‘‘vaidanānaṃ samudayañ‍ca…pai॰… tathāgatau’’tiādidaisanā ‘‘tadidaṃ saṅkhataṃ auḷārikaṃ, atthi khau pana saṅkhārānaṃ niraudhau, atthaitanti iti viditvā tassa nissaraṇadassāvī tathāgatau tadupātivattau’’tiādidaisanāya (ma॰ ni॰ 3.29), ‘‘tadapi taisaṃ…pai॰… vipphanditamaivā’’ti ayaṃ ‘‘idaṃ taisaṃ vata añ‍ñatraiva saddhāya añ‍ñatra ruciyā añ‍ñatra anussavā añ‍ñatra ākāraparivitak‍kā añ‍ñatra diṭṭhinijjhānakkhantiyā pac‍cattaṃyaiva ñāṇaṃ bhavissati parisuddhaṃ pariyaudāta’nti naitaṃ ṭhānaṃ vij‍jati| pac‍cattaṃ khau pana bhikkhavai, ñāṇai asati parisuddhai pariyaudātai yadapi tai bhauntau samaṇabrāhmaṇā tattha ñāṇabhāvamattamaiva pariyaudāpainti, tadapi taisaṃ bhavataṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ upādānamakkhāyatī’’tiādidaisanāya (saṃ॰ ni॰ 2.43), ‘‘tadapi phassapac‍cayā’’ti ayaṃ ‘‘cakkhuñ‍ca paṭic‍ca rūpai ca uppaj‍jati cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇaṃ, tiṇṇaṃ saṅgati phassau, phassapac‍cayā vaidanā, vaidanāpac‍cayā taṇhā, taṇhāpac‍cayā upādāna’’nti (saṃ॰ ni॰ 2.45), ‘‘chandamūlakā imai āvusau dhammā manasikārasamuṭṭhānā phassasamaudhānā vaidanāsamausaraṇā’’ti (pariyaisitabbaṃ) ca ādidaisanāya, ‘‘yatau khau bhikkhavai, bhikkhu chan‍naṃ phassāyatanāna’’ntiādidaisanā ‘‘yatau khau bhikkhavai, bhikkhu naiva vaidanaṃ attatau samanupassati, na sañ‍ñaṃ, na saṅkhārai, na viñ‍ñāṇaṃ attatau samanupassati, sau aivaṃ asamanupassantau na kiñ‍ci laukai upādiyati, anupādiyaṃ na paritassati, aparitassaṃ pac‍cattaṃyaiva parinibbāyatī’’tiādidaisanāya, ‘‘sabbaitai imaihaiva dvāsaṭṭhiyā vatthūhi antaujālīkatā’’tiādidaisanā ‘‘yai hi kaici bhikkhavai…pai॰… abhivadanti, sabbaitai imānaiva pañ‍ca kāyāni abhivadanti aitaisaṃ vā añ‍ñatara’’ntiādidaisanāya (ma॰ ni॰ 3.26), ‘‘kāyassa bhaidā…pai॰… daivamanussā’’ti ayaṃ –

‘‘ac‍cī  yathā vātavaigaina khittā (upasivāti bhagavā),

atthaṃ palaiti na upaiti saṅkhaṃ|

aivaṃ munī nāmakāyā vimuttau,

atthaṃ palaiti na upaiti saṅkha’’nti|| (su॰ ni॰ 1080) –

ādidaisanāya  saddhiṃ saṃsandatīti| ayaṃ nairuttamadhippāyadaisanānidānapubbāparānusandhīnaṃ catun‍naṃ vibhāvanalakkhaṇau catubyūhahārau nāma| vuttampi caitaṃ ‘‘nairuttamadhippāyau’’tiādi (naitti॰ 4.6)|

āvattahāravaṇṇanā

āghātādīnamakaraṇīyatāvacanaina khantisaurac‍cānuṭṭhānaṃ| tattha khantiyā saddhāpañ‍ñāparāpakāradukkhasahagatānaṃ saṅgahau, tathā saurac‍caina sīlassa| saddhādiggahaṇaina ca saddhindriyādisakalabaudhipakkhiyadhammā āvattanti| sīlaggahaṇaina avippaṭisārādayau sabbaipi sīlānisaṃsadhammā āvattanti| pāṇātipātādīhi paṭivirativacanaina appamādavihārau, taina sakalaṃ sāsanabrahmacariyaṃ āvattati| gambhīratādivisaisayuttadhammaggahaṇaina mahābaudhipakittanaṃ| anāvaraṇañāṇapadaṭṭhānañhi āsavakkhayañāṇaṃ, āsavakkhayañāṇapadaṭṭhānañ‍ca anāvaraṇañāṇaṃ mahābaudhīti vuc‍cati, taina dasabalādayau sabbai buddhaguṇā āvattanti| sassatādidiṭṭhiggahaṇaina taṇhāvij‍jānaṃ saṅgahau, tāhi anamataggaṃ saṃsāravaṭṭaṃ āvattati| vaidanānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ samudayādipaṭivaidhanaina bhagavatau pariñ‍ñāttayavisuddhi, tāya pañ‍ñāpāramimukhaina sabbāpi pāramiyau āvattanti| ‘‘ajānataṃ apassata’’nti aittha avij‍jāggahaṇaina ayaunisaumanasikārapariggahau, taina ca nava ayaunisaumanasikāramūlakā dhammā āvattanti| ‘‘taṇhāgatānaṃ paritassitavipphandita’’nti aittha taṇhāggahaṇaina nava taṇhāmūlakā dhammā āvattanti| ‘‘tadapi phassapac‍cayā’’tiādi sassatādipañ‍ñāpanassa pac‍cayādhīnavuttidassanaṃ, taina anic‍catādilakkhaṇattayaṃ āvattati| chan‍naṃ phassāyatanānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānanaina vimuttisampadāniddaisau, taina sattapi visuddhiyau āvattanti| ‘‘ucchin‍nabhavanaittikau tathāgatassa kāyau’’ti taṇhāpahānaṃ vuttaṃ, taina bhagavatau sakalasaṃkilaisappahānaṃ āvattatīti ayaṃ daisanāya gahitadhammānaṃ sabhāgavisabhāgadhammavasaina  āvattanalakkhaṇau āvattahārau nāma| yathāha ‘‘aikamhi padaṭṭhānai, pariyaisati saisakaṃ padaṭṭhāna’’ntiādi (naitti॰ 4.7)|

vibhattihāravaṇṇanā

āghātānandādayau akusalā dhammā, taisaṃ ayaunisaumanasikārādi padaṭṭhānaṃ| yaihi pana dhammaihi āghātānandādīnaṃ akaraṇaṃ appavatti, tai abyāpādādayau kusalā dhammā, taisaṃ yaunisaumanasikārādi padaṭṭhānaṃ| taisu āghātādayaukāmāvacarāva, abyāpādādayau catubhūmakā, tathā  pāṇātipātādīhi paṭivirati kusalā vā abyākatā vā, tassā hirauttappādayau dhammā padaṭṭhānaṃ| tattha kusalā siyā kāmāvacarā, siyā laukuttarā| abyākatā laukuttarāva| ‘‘atthi bhikkhavai, añ‍ñaiva dhammā gambhīrā’’ti vuttadhammā siyā kusalā, siyā abyākatā| tattha kusalānaṃ vuṭṭhānagāminivipassanā padaṭṭhānaṃ| abyākatānaṃ maggadhammā, vipassanā, āvaj‍janā vā padaṭṭhānaṃ| taisu kusalā laukuttarāva, abyākatā siyā kāmāvacarā, siyā laukuttarā, sabbāpi diṭṭhiyau akusalāva kāmāvacarāva, tāsaṃ avisaisaina micchābhinivaisai ayaunisaumanasikārau padaṭṭhānaṃ| visaisatau pana santatighanavinibbhaugābhāvatau aikattanayassa micchāgāhau atītajātianussaraṇatak‍kasahitau sassatadiṭṭhiyā padaṭṭhānaṃ| haituphalabhāvaina sambandhabhāvassa aggahaṇatau nānattanayassa micchāgāhau taj‍jāsaman‍nāhārasahitau ucchaidadiṭṭhiyā padaṭṭhānaṃ| aivaṃ saisadiṭṭhīnampi yathāsambhavaṃ vattabbaṃ|

‘‘vaidanāna’’nti aittha vaidanā siyā kusalā, siyā akusalā, siyā abyākatā, siyā kāmāvacarā, siyā rūpāvacarā, siyā arūpāvacarā, tāsaṃ phassau padaṭṭhānaṃ| vaidanānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ vaidanānaṃ samudayādipaṭivaidhanaṃ maggañāṇaṃ, anupādāvimutti ca phalañāṇaṃ, taisaṃ ‘‘añ‍ñaiva dhammā gambhīrā’’ti aittha vuttanayaina dhammādivibhāgau naitabbau| ‘‘ajānataṃ apassata’’ntiādīsu avij‍jātaṇhā akusalā kāmāvacarā, tāsu avij‍jāya āsavā, ayaunisaumanasikārau aiva vā padaṭṭhānaṃ| taṇhāya saṃyaujaniyaisu dhammaisu assādadassanaṃ padaṭṭhānaṃ| ‘‘tadapi phassapac‍cayā’’ti  aittha phassassa vaidanāya viya dhammādivibhāgau vaiditabbau| iminā nayaina phassāyatanādīnampi yathārahaṃ dhammādivibhāgau naitabbauti ayaṃ saṃkilaisadhammai, vaudānadhammai ca sādhāraṇāsādhāraṇatau, padaṭṭhānatau, bhūmitau ca vibhajanalakkhaṇau vibhattihārau nāma| yathāha ‘‘dhammañ‍ca padaṭṭhānaṃ, bhūmiñ‍ca vibhaj‍jatai ayaṃ hārau’’tiādi (naitti॰ 4.8)|

parivattanahāravaṇṇanā

āghātādīnamakaraṇaṃ khantisaurac‍cāni anubrūhaitvā paṭisaṅkhānabhāvanābalasiddhiyā ubhayahitapaṭipattimāvahati| āghātādayau pana pavattiyamānā dubbaṇṇataṃ, dukkhasaiyyaṃ, bhaugahāniṃ, akittiṃ, paraihi durupasaṅkamanatañ‍ca nipphādaintā nirayādīsu mahādukkhamāvahanti| pāṇātipātādipaṭivirati avippaṭisārādikalyāṇaṃ paramparamāvahati| pāṇātipātādi pana vippaṭisārādiakalyāṇaṃ paramparamāvahati| gambhīratādivisaisayuttaṃ ñāṇaṃ vainaiyyānaṃ yathārahaṃ vij‍jābhiñ‍ñādiguṇavisaisamāvahati sabbañ‍ñaiyyassa yathāsabhāvāvabaudhatau| tathā gambhīratādivisaisarahitaṃ  pana ñāṇaṃ ñaiyyaisu sādhāraṇabhāvatau yathāvuttaguṇavisaisaṃ nāvahati| sabbāpi caitā diṭṭhiyau yathārahaṃ sassatucchaidabhāvatau antadvayabhūtā sak‍kāyatīraṃ nātivattanti aniyyānikasabhāvattā| sammādiṭṭhi pana saparikkhārā majjhimapaṭipadābhūtā sak‍kāyatīramatik‍kamma pāraṃ gacchati niyyānikasabhāvattā| vaidanānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ samudayādipaṭivaidhanā anupādāvimuttimāvahati maggabhāvatau| vaidanānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ samudayādiasampaṭivaidhau saṃsāracārakāvaraudhamāvahati saṅkhārānaṃ pac‍cayabhāvatau| vaidayitasabhāvapaṭicchādakau sammauhau tadabhinandanamāvahati, yathābhūtāvabaudhau pana tattha nibbaidhaṃ, virāgañ‍ca āvahati| micchābhinivaisai ayaunisaumanasikārasahitā taṇhā anaikavihitaṃ diṭṭhijālaṃ pasāraiti| yathāvuttataṇhāsamucchaidau paṭhamamaggau taṃ diṭṭhijālaṃ saṅkaucaiti| sassatavādādipañ‍ñāpanassa phassau pac‍cayau asati phassai tadabhāvatau| diṭṭhibandhanabaddhānaṃ phassāyatanādīnamaniraudhanaina phassādianiraudhau saṃsāradukkhassa anivattiyaiva yāthāvatau phassāyatanādipariñ‍ñā sabbadiṭṭhidassanāni ativattati, taisaṃ pana tathā apariñ‍ñā  diṭṭhidassanaṃ nātivattati| bhavanaittisamucchaidau āyatiṃ attabhāvassa anibbattiyā saṃvattati, asamucchin‍nāya bhavanaittiyā anāgatai bhavappabandhau parivattatiyaivāti ayaṃ suttai niddiṭṭhānaṃ dhammānaṃ paṭipakkhatau parivattanalakkhaṇau parivattanahārau nāma| kimāha ‘‘kusalākusalai dhammai, niddiṭṭhai bhāvitai pahīnai cā’’tiādi|

vaivacanahāravaṇṇanā

‘‘mamaṃ mama mai’’ti pariyāyavacanaṃ| ‘vā yadi cā’’ti pariyāyavacanaṃ| ‘‘bhikkhavai samaṇā tapassinau’’ti pariyāyavacanaṃ| ‘‘parai añ‍ñai paṭiviruddhā’’ti…pai॰… naṃ| ‘‘avaṇṇaṃ akittiṃ ninda’’nti…pai॰… naṃ| ‘‘bhāsaiyyuṃ bhaṇaiyyuṃ kathaiyyu’’nti…pai॰… naṃ| ‘‘dhammassa vinayassa satthusāsanassā’’ti…pai॰… naṃ| ‘‘saṅghassa samūhassa gaṇassā’’ti…pai॰… naṃ| ‘‘tatra tattha taisū’’ti…pai॰… naṃ| ‘‘tumhaihi vau bhavantaihī’’ti…pai॰… naṃ| ‘‘āghātau dausau byāpādau’’ti…pai॰… naṃ ‘‘appac‍cayau daumanassaṃ caitasikadukkha’’nti…pai॰… naṃ| ‘‘caitasau cittassa manasau’’ti…pai॰… naṃ| ‘‘anabhiraddhi byāpatti manaupadausau’’ti…pai॰… naṃ| ‘‘na nau a mā’’ti…pai॰… naṃ| ‘‘karaṇīyā uppādaitabbā pavattaitabbā’’ti pariyāyavacanaṃ| iminā nayaina sabbapadaisu vaivacanaṃ vattabbanti ayaṃ tassa tassa atthassa taṃtaṃpariyāyasaddayaujanālakkhaṇau vaivacanahārau nāma| vuttañhaitaṃ ‘‘vaivacanāni bahūni tu, suttai vuttāni aikadhammassā’’tiādi (naitti॰ 4.10)|

pañ‍ñattihāravaṇṇanā

āghātau  vatthuvasaina dasavidhaina, aikūnavīsatividhaina vā pañ‍ñattau| apac‍cayau upavicāravasaina chadhā pañ‍ñattau| ānandau pītiādivasaina vaivacanaina navadhā pañ‍ñattau| pīti sāmañ‍ñatau pana khuddikādivasaina pañ‍cadhā pañ‍ñattau| saumanassaṃ upavicāravasaina chadhā, sīlaṃ vārittacārittādivasaina anaikadhā, gambhīratādivisaisayuttaṃ ñāṇaṃ cittuppādavasaina catudhā, dvādasadhā vā, visayabhaidatau anaikadhā ca, diṭṭhisassatādivasaina dvāsaṭṭhiyā bhaidaihi, tadantaugadhavibhāgaina anaikadhā ca, vaidanā chadhā, aṭṭhasatadhā, anaikadhā ca, tassā samudayau pañ‍cadhā, tathā atthaṅgamaupi, assādau duvidhaina, ādīnavau tividhaina, nissaraṇaṃ aikadhā, catudhā ca, anupādāvimutti duvidhaina, ‘‘ajānataṃ apassata’’nti vuttā avij‍jā visayabhaidaina catudhā, aṭṭhadhā ca, ‘‘taṇhāgatāna’’ntiādinā vuttā taṇhā chadhā, aṭṭhasatadhā, anaikadhā ca, phassau nissayavasaina chadhā, upādānaṃ catudhā, bhavau dvidhā, anaikadhā ca, jāti vaivacanavasaina chadhā, tathā jarā sattadhā, maraṇaṃ aṭṭhadhā, navadhā ca, saukau pañ‍cadhā, paridaivau chadhā, dukkhaṃ catudhā, tathā daumanassaṃ, upāyāsau catudhā pañ‍ñattauti ayaṃ pabhaidapañ‍ñatti, samūhapañ‍ñatti ca|

‘‘samudayau hautī’’ti pabhavapañ‍ñatti, ‘‘yathābhūtaṃ pajānātī’’ti dukkhassa pariñ‍ñāpañ‍ñatti, samudayassa pahānapañ‍ñatti, niraudhassa sacchikiriyāpañ‍ñatti, maggassa bhāvanāpañ‍ñatti| ‘‘antaujālīkatā’’tiādisabbadiṭṭhīnaṃ saṅgahapañ‍ñatti| ‘‘ucchin‍nabhavanaittikau’’tiādi duvidhaina parinibbānapañ‍ñattīti aivaṃ āghātādīnaṃ pabhavapañ‍ñattipariñ‍ñāpañ‍ñattiādivasaina| tathā ‘‘āghātau’’ti byāpādassa vaivacanapañ‍ñatti| ‘‘appac‍cayau’’ti daumanassassavaivacanapañ‍ñattītiādivasaina ca pañ‍ñattibhaidau vibhaj‍jitabbauti ayaṃ aikaikassa dhammassa anaikāhi pañ‍ñattīhi pañ‍ñapaitabbākāravibhāvanalakkhaṇau pañ‍ñattihārau nāma, taina vuttaṃ ‘‘aikaṃ bhagavā dhammaṃ, paṇṇattīhi vividhāhi daisaitī’’tiādi (naitti॰ 4.11)|

autaraṇahāravaṇṇanā

āghātaggahaṇaina saṅkhārakkhandhasaṅgahau, tathā anabhiraddhiggahaṇaina| appac‍cayaggahaṇaina vaidanākkhandhasaṅgahauti idaṃ khandhamukhaina autaraṇaṃ| tathā āghātādiggahaṇaina dhammāyatanaṃ, dhammadhātu, dukkhasac‍caṃ, samudayasac‍caṃ vā gahitanti idaṃ āyatanamukhaina, dhātumukhaina, sac‍camukhaina ca autaraṇaṃ| tathā āghātādīnaṃ sahajātā avij‍jā haitusahajātaañ‍ñamañ‍ñanissasampayuttaatthiavigatapac‍cayaihi pac‍cayau, asahajātā pana anantaraniruddhā anantarasamanantaraanantarūpanissayanatthivigatāsaivanapac‍cayaihi pac‍cayau| ananantarā pana upanissayavasainaiva pac‍cayau| taṇhāupādānādi phassādīnampi taisaṃ sahajātānaṃ, asahajātānañ‍ca yathārahaṃ pac‍cayabhāvau vattabbau| kauci panaittha adhipativasaina, kauci kammavasaina, kauci āhāravasaina, kauci indriyavasaina, kauci jhānavasaina kauci  maggavasaināpi pac‍cayauti ayampi visaisau vaiditabbauti idaṃ paṭic‍casamuppādamukhaina autaraṇaṃ| imināva nayaina ānandādīnampi khandhādimukhaina autaraṇaṃ vibhāvaitabbaṃ|

tathā sīlaṃ pāṇātipātādīhi viraticaitanā, abyāpādādicaitasikadhammā ca, pāṇātipātādayau caitanāva, taisaṃ, tadupakārakadhammānañ‍ca laj‍jādayādīnaṃ saṅkhārakkhandhadhammāyatanādīsu saṅgahatau purimanayainaiva khandhādimukhaina autaraṇaṃ vibhāvaitabbaṃ| aisa nayau ñāṇadiṭṭhivaidanāavij‍jātaṇhādiggahaṇaisupi| nissaraṇānupādāvimuttiggahaṇaisu pana asaṅkhatadhātuvasainapi dhātumukhaina autaraṇaṃ vibhāvaitabbaṃ, tathā ‘‘vaidanānaṃ…pai॰… anupādāvimuttau’’ti aitaina bhagavatau sīlādayau pañ‍cadhammakkhandhā, satipaṭṭhānādayau ca baudhipakkhiyadhammā pakāsitā hauntīti taṃmukhainapi autaraṇaṃ vaiditabbaṃ| ‘‘tadapi phassapac‍cayā’’ti sassatādipañ‍ñāpanassa pac‍cayādhīnavuttitādīpanaina anic‍catāmukhaina autaraṇaṃ, tathā aivaṃdhammatāya paṭic‍casamuppādamukhaina autaraṇaṃ| anic‍cassa dukkhānattabhāvatau appaṇihitamukhaina, suñ‍ñatāmukhaina autaraṇaṃ| saisapadaisupi aisaiva nayau| ayaṃ paṭic‍casamuppādādimukhaihi suttatthassa autaraṇalakkhaṇau autaraṇahārau nāma| tathā hi vuttaṃ ‘‘yau ca paṭic‍cuppādau, indriyakhandhā ca dhātuāyatanā’’tiādi (naitti॰ 4.12)|

saudhanahāravaṇṇanā

‘‘mamaṃ vā bhikkhavai, parai avaṇṇaṃ bhāsaiyyu’’nti ārambhau| ‘‘dhammassa vā avaṇṇaṃ bhāsaiyyuṃ saṅghassa vā avaṇṇaṃ bhāsaiyyu’’nti padasuddhi, nau ārambhasuddhi| ‘‘tatra tumhaihi na āghātau, na appac‍cayau, na caitasau anabhiraddhi karaṇīyā’’ti padasuddhi caiva ārambhasuddhi ca| dutiyanayādīsupi aisaiva nayau, tathā ‘‘appamattakaṃ khau panaita’’ntiādi ārambhau| ‘‘katama’’ntiādi pucchā| ‘‘pāṇātipātaṃ pahāyā’’tiādi padasuddhi, nau ārambhasuddhi| nau ca pucchāsuddhi| ‘‘idaṃ khau’’tiādi pucchāsuddhi caiva padasuddhi ca, ārambhasuddhi|

tathā  ‘‘atthi bhikkhavai’’tiādi ārambhau| ‘‘katamai ca tai’’tiādi pucchā| ‘‘santi bhikkhavai’’tiādi ārambhau| ‘‘kimāgammā’’tiādi ārambhapucchā| ‘‘yathā samāhitai’’tiādi padasuddhi, nau ārambhasuddhi, nau ca pucchāsuddhi| ‘‘imai khau’’tiādi padasuddhi caiva pucchāsuddhi ca ārambhasuddhi ca| iminā nayaina sabbattha ārambhādayau vaiditabbā| ayaṃ padārambhānaṃ saudhitāsaudhitabhāvavicāraṇalakkhaṇau saudhanahārau nāma, vuttampi ca ‘‘vissaj‍jitamhi pañhai, gāthāyaṃ pucchitāyamārabbhā’’tiādi (naitti॰ 4.13)|

adhiṭṭhānahāravaṇṇanā

‘‘avaṇṇa’’nti sāmañ‍ñatau adhiṭṭhānaṃ| tamavikappaitvā visaisavacanaṃ ‘‘mamaṃ vā’’ti| dhammassa vā saṅghassa vāti pakkhaipi aisa nayau| tathā ‘‘sīla’’nti sāmañ‍ñatau adhiṭṭhānaṃ| tamavikappaitvā visaisavacanaṃ ‘‘pāṇātipātā paṭiviratau’’tiādi| ‘‘añ‍ñaiva dhammā’’tiādi sāmañ‍ñatau adhiṭṭhānaṃ, tamavikappaitvā visaisavacanaṃ ‘‘tayidaṃ bhikkhavai, tathāgatau pajānātī’’tiādi, tathā ‘‘pubbantakappikā’’tiādi sāmañ‍ñatau adhiṭṭhānaṃ| tamavikappaitvā visaisavacanaṃ ‘‘sassatavādā’’tiādi| iminā nayaina sabbattha yathādaisitamaiva sāmañ‍ñavisaisā niddhāraitabbā| ayaṃ suttāgatānaṃ dhammānaṃ avikappanāvasaina yathādaisitamaiva sāmañ‍ñavisaisaniddhāraṇalakkhaṇau adhiṭṭhānahārau nāma, yathāha ‘‘aikattatāya dhammā, yaipi ca vaimattatāya niddiṭṭhā’’tiādi (naitti॰ 4.14)|

parikkhārahāravaṇṇanā

āghātādīnaṃ ‘‘anatthaṃ mai acarī’’tiādīni (dha॰ sa॰ 1237; vibha॰ 909) aikūnavīsati āghātavatthūni haitu| ānandādīnaṃ ārammaṇābhisinaihau haitu| sīlassa hiriauttappaṃ, appicchatādayau ca haitu| ‘‘gambhīrā’’tiādinā vuttadhammassa sabbāpi pāramiyau haitu| visaisaina pañ‍ñāpāramī| diṭṭhīnaṃ asappurisūpanissayau, asaddhammassavanaṃ micchābhinivaisaina ayaunisaumanasikārau ca avisaisaina haitu| visaisaina pana sassatavādādīnaṃ atītajātianussaraṇādi haitu| vaidanānaṃ avij‍jā, taṇhā, kammādiphassau ca haitu| anupādāvimuttiyā ariyamaggau haitu| añ‍ñāṇassa ayaunisaumanasikārau haitu| taṇhāya saṃyaujaniyaisu assādānupassanā haitu| phassassa saḷāyatanāni haitu| saḷāyatanassa nāmarūpaṃ haitu| bhavanaittisamucchaidassa visuddhibhāvanā haitūti ayaṃ parikkhārasaṅkhātai haitupac‍cayai niddhāraitvā  saṃvaṇṇanālakkhaṇau parikkhārahārau nāma, taina vuttaṃ ‘‘yai dhammā yaṃ dhammaṃ, janayantippac‍cayā paramparatau’’tiādi|

samāraupanahāravaṇṇanā

āghātādīnamakaraṇīyatāvacanaina khantisampadā dassitā hauti| ‘‘appamattakaṃ khau panaita’’ntiādinā saurac‍casampadā| ‘‘atthi bhikkhavai’’tiādinā ñāṇasampadā| ‘‘aparāmasatau cassa pac‍cattañ‍ñaiva nibbuti viditā’’ti, ‘‘vaidanānaṃ…pai॰… yathābhūtaṃ viditvā anupādāvimuttau’’ti ca aitaihi samādhisampadāya saddhiṃ vij‍jāvimuttivasībhāvasampadā dassitā| tattha khantisampadā paṭisaṅkhānabalasiddhitau saurac‍casampadāya padaṭṭhānaṃ, saurac‍casampadā pana atthatau sīlamaiva, sīlaṃ samādhisampadāya padaṭṭhānaṃ| samādhi ñāṇasampadāya padaṭṭhānanti ayaṃ padaṭṭhānasamāraupanā|

pāṇātipātādīhi paṭivirativacanaṃ sīlassa pariyāyavibhāgadassanaṃ| sassatavādādivibhāgadassanaṃ pana diṭṭhiyā pariyāyavacananti ayaṃ vaivacanasamāraupanā|

sīlaina vītik‍kamappahānaṃ, tadaṅgappahānaṃ, duc‍caritasaṃkilaisappahānañ‍ca sijjhati| samādhinā pariyuṭṭhānappahānaṃ, vikkhambhanappahānaṃ, taṇhāsaṃkilaisappahānañ‍ca sijjhati| pañ‍ñāya diṭṭhisaṃkilaisappahānaṃ, samucchaidappahānaṃ, anusayappahānañ‍ca sijjhatīti ayaṃ pahānasamāraupanā|

sīlādidhammakkhandhaihi samathavipassanābhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati pahānattayasiddhitauti ayaṃ bhāvanāsamāraupanā| ayaṃ suttai āgatadhammānaṃ padaṭṭhānavaivacanapahānabhāvanāsamāraupanavicāraṇalakkhaṇau samāraupanahārau nāma| vuttañhaitaṃ ‘‘yai dhammā yaṃ mūlā, yai caikatthā pakāsitā muninā’’tiādi, (naitti॰ 4.16) ayaṃ sauḷasahārayaujanā|

sauḷasahāravaṇṇanā niṭṭhitā|

pañ‍cavidhanayavaṇṇanā

nandiyāvaṭṭanayavaṇṇanā

āghātādīnamakaraṇavacanaina  taṇhāvij‍jāsaṅkaucau dassitau| sati hi attattaniyavatthūsu sinaihai, sammauhai ca ‘‘anatthaṃ mai acarī’’tiādinā āghātau jāyati, nāsati| tathā ‘‘pāṇātipātā paṭiviratau’’tiādivacanaihi ‘‘pac‍cattañ‍ñaiva nibbuti viditā, anupādāvimuttau, chan‍naṃ phassāyatanānaṃ…pai॰… yathābhūtaṃ pajānātī’’tiādivacanaihi ca taṇhāvij‍jānaṃ ac‍cantappahānaṃ dassitaṃ hauti| tāsaṃ pana pubbantakappikādipadaihi, ‘‘ajānataṃ apassata’’ntiādipadaihi ca sarūpataupi dassitānaṃ taṇhāvij‍jānaṃ rūpadhammā, arūpadhammā ca adhiṭṭhānaṃ| yathāk‍kamaṃ samathau ca vipassanā ca paṭipakkhau, taisaṃ pana caitauvimutti, pañ‍ñāvimutti ca phalaṃ| tattha taṇhā samudayasac‍caṃ, taṇhāvij‍jā vā, tadadhiṭṭhānabhūtā rūpārūpadhammā dukkhasac‍caṃ, taisamappavatti niraudhasac‍caṃ, niraudhapajānanā samathavipassanā maggasac‍canti aivaṃ, catusac‍cayaujanā vaiditabbā|

taṇhāggahaṇaina caittha māyāsāṭhaiyyamānātimānamadapamādapāpicchatāpāpamittatāahirikānauttappādivasaina sabbaupi akusalapakkhau naitabbau| tathā avij‍jāggahaṇainapi viparītamanasikārakaudhupanāhamakkhapaḷāsaissāmacchariyasārambha dauvacassatā bhavadiṭṭhivibhavadiṭṭhādivasaina| vuttavipariyāyaina pana amāyāasāṭhaiyyādivasaina, aviparītamanasikārādivasaina ca sabbaupi kusalapakkhau naitabbau| tathā samathapakkhiyānaṃ saddhindriyādīnaṃ, vipassanāpakkhiyānañ‍ca anic‍casañ‍ñādīnaṃ vasaināti ayaṃ taṇhāvij‍jāhi saṃkilaisapakkhaṃ suttatthaṃ samathavipassanāhi ca vaudānapakkhaṃ catusac‍cayaujanamukhaina nayanalakkhaṇassa nandiyāvaṭṭanayassa bhūmi| vuttañhi ‘‘taṇhañ‍ca avij‍jampi ca, samathaina vipassanāya yau naitī’’tiādi|

tipukkhalanayavaṇṇanā

āghātādīnamakaraṇavacanaina adausasiddhi, tathā pāṇātipātapharusavācāhi paṭivirativacanaināpi| ānandādīnamakaraṇavacanaina pana alaubhasiddhi, tathā abrahmacariyatau paṭivirativacanaināpi| adin‍nādānādīhi pana paṭivirativacanaina tadubhayasiddhi| ‘‘tayidaṃ bhikkhavai, tathāgatau pajānātī’’tiādinā amauhasiddhi| iti tīhi akusalamūlaihi gahitaihi tappaṭipakkhatau āghātādīnamakaraṇavacanaina ca tīṇi kusalamūlāni siddhāniyaiva haunti| tattha tīhi akusalamūlaihi tividhaduc‍caritasaṃkilaisamalavisamākusalasañ‍ñāvitak‍kapañ‍cādivasaina sabbaupi akusalapakkhau vitthāraitabbau| tathā tīhi kusalamūlaihi tividhasucaritavaudānasamakusalasañ‍ñāvitak‍kapañ‍ñāsaddhammasamādhi- vimaukkhamukhavimaukkhādivasaina sabbaupi kusalapakkhau vibhāvaitabbau|

aittha cāyaṃ sac‍cayaujanā – laubhau samudayasac‍caṃ, sabbāni vā kusalākusalamūlāni, taihi pana nibbattā taisamadhiṭṭhānagaucarabhūtā upādānakkhandhā dukkhasac‍caṃ, taisamappavatti niraudhasac‍caṃ, niraudhapajānanā vimaukkhādikā maggasac‍canti| ayaṃ akusalamūlaihi saṃkilaisapakkhaṃ, kusalamūlaihi ca vaudānapakkhaṃ catusac‍cayaujanamukhaina nayanalakkhaṇassa tipukkhalanayassa bhūmi| tathā hi vuttaṃ –

‘‘yau akusalai samūlaihi,

naiti kusalai ca kusalamūlaihī’’tiādi|| (naitti॰ 4.18)|

sīhavik‍kīḷitanayavaṇṇanā

āghātānandādīnamakaraṇa-vacanaina satisiddhi| micchājīvāpaṭivirativacanaina vīriyasiddhi| vīriyaina hi kāmabyāpādavihiṃsāvitak‍kai vinaudaiti, vīriyasādhanañ‍ca ājīvapārisuddhisīlanti| pāṇātipātādīhi paṭivirativacanaina satisiddhi| satiyā hi sāvaj‍jānavaj‍jau diṭṭhau hauti| tattha ca ādīnavānisaṃsai sal‍lakkhaitvā sāvaj‍jaṃ pahāya anavaj‍jaṃ samādāya vattati| tathā hi sā ‘‘niyyātanapac‍cupaṭṭhānā’’ti vuc‍cati| ‘‘tayidaṃ bhikkhavai, tathāgatau pajānātī’’tiādinā samādhipañ‍ñāsiddhi| pañ‍ñavā hi yathābhūtāvabaudhau samāhitau ca yathābhūtaṃ pajānātīti|

tathā ‘‘nic‍cau dhuvau’’tiādinā anic‍cai ‘‘nic‍ca’’nti vipal‍lāsau, ‘‘araugau paraṃ maraṇā, aikantasukhī attā, diṭṭhadhammanibbānappattau’’ti ca aivamādīhi asukhai ‘‘sukha’’nti vipal‍lāsau| ‘‘pañ‍cahi kāmaguṇaihi samappitau’’tiādinā  asubhai ‘‘subha’’nti vipal‍lāsau| sabbaihaiva diṭṭhippakāsanapadaihi anattani ‘‘attā’’ti vipal‍lāsauti aivamaittha cattārau vipal‍lāsā siddhā  haunti, taisaṃ paṭipakkhatau cattāri satipaṭṭhānāni siddhānaiva| tattha catūhi yathāvuttaihi indriyaihi cattārau puggalā niddisitabbā| kathaṃ duvidhau hi taṇhācaritau mudindriyau tikkhindriyauti, tathā diṭṭhicaritaupi| taisu paṭhamau asubhai ‘‘subha’’nti vipal‍latthadiṭṭhikau satibalaina yathābhūtaṃ kāyasabhāvaṃ sal‍lakkhaitvā sammattaniyāmaṃ auk‍kamati| dutiyau asukhai ‘‘sukha’’nti vipal‍latthadiṭṭhikau ‘‘uppan‍naṃ kāmavitak‍kaṃ nādhivāsaitī’’tiādinā (ma॰ ni॰ 1.26; a॰ ni॰ 4.14; 6.58) vuttaina vīriyasaṃvarasaṅkhātaina vīriyabalaina taṃ vipal‍lāsaṃ vidhamati| tatiyau anic‍cai ‘‘nic‍ca’’nti vipal‍latthadiṭṭhikau samādhibalaina samāhitabhāvatau saṅkhārānaṃ khaṇikabhāvaṃ yathābhūtaṃ paṭivijjhati| catutthau santatisamūhakic‍cārammaṇaghanavicittattā phassādidhammapuñ‍jamattai anattani ‘‘attā’’ti vipal‍latthadiṭṭhikau catukauṭikasuñ‍ñatāmanasikāraina taṃ micchābhinivaisaṃ viddhaṃsaiti| catūhi caittha vipal‍lāsaihi caturāsavaughayaugaganthaagatitaṇhuppādupādānasattaviñ‍ñāṇaṭṭhitiapariñ‍ñādivasaina sabbaupi akusalapakkhau naitabbau| tathā catūhi satipaṭṭhānaihi catubbidhajhānavihārādhiṭṭhānasukhabhāgiyadhammaappamañ‍ñāsammappadhānaiddhipādādivasaina sabbaupi vaudānapakkhau naitabbau|

aittha cāyaṃ sac‍cayaujanā – subhasañ‍ñāsukhasañ‍ñāhi, catūhipi vā vipal‍lāsaihi samudayasac‍caṃ, taisamadhiṭṭhānārammaṇabhūtā pañ‍cupādānakkhandhā dukkhasac‍caṃ, taisamappavatti niraudhasac‍caṃ, niraudhapajānanā satipaṭṭhānādikā maggasac‍canti| ayaṃ vipal‍lāsaihi saṃkilaisapakkhaṃ, saddhindriyādīhi vaudānapakkhaṃ catusac‍cayaujanamukhaina nayanalakkhaṇassa sīhavik‍kīḷitanayassa bhūmi, yathāha ‘‘yau naiti vipal‍lāsaihi, kilaisai indriyaihi saddhammai’’tiādi (naitti॰ 4.19)|

disālaucanaaṅkusanayadvayavaṇṇanā

iti tiṇṇaṃ atthanayānaṃ siddhiyā vauhāranayadvayampi siddhamaiva hauti| tathā hi atthanayattayadisābhūtadhammānaṃ samālaucanamaiva disālaucananayau| taisaṃ samānayanamaiva aṅkusanayau| tasmā yathāvuttanayaina  atthanayānaṃ disābhūtadhammasamālaukananayanavasaina tampi nayadvayaṃ yaujaitabbanti, taina vuttaṃ ‘‘vaiyyākaraṇaisu hi yai, kusalākusalā’’tiādi (naitti॰ 4.20)| ayaṃ pañ‍canayayaujanā|

pañ‍cavidhanayavaṇṇanā niṭṭhitā|

sāsanapaṭṭhānavaṇṇanā

idaṃ  pana suttaṃ sauḷasavidhai sāsanapaṭṭhānai saṃkilaisavāsanāsaikkhabhāgiyaṃ taṇhādiṭṭhādisaṃkilaisānaṃ sīlādipuñ‍ñakiriyassa, asaikkhasīlādikkhandhassa ca vibhattattā, saṃkilaisavāsanānibbaidhāsaikkhabhāgiyamaiva vā yathāvuttatthānaṃ saikkhasīlakkhandhādikassa ca vibhattattā| aṭṭhavīsatividhai pana sāsanapaṭṭhānai laukiyalaukuttaraṃ sattadhammādhiṭṭhānaṃ ñāṇañaiyyaṃ dassanabhāvanaṃ sakavacanaparavacanaṃ vissaj‍janīyāvissaj‍janīyaṃ kammavipākaṃ kusalākusalaṃ anuñ‍ñātapaṭikkhittaṃ bhavau ca laukiyalaukuttarādīnamatthānaṃ idha vibhattattāti| ayaṃ sāsanapaṭṭhānayaujanā|

pakaraṇanayavaṇṇanā niṭṭhitā|

iti sumaṅgalavilāsiniyā dīghanikāyaṭṭhakathāya paramasukhumagambhīraduranubaudhatthaparidīpanāya suvimalavipulapañ‍ñāvaiyyattiyajananāya aj‍javamaddavasaurac‍casaddhāsatidhitibuddhikhantivīriyādidhammasamaṅginā sāṭṭhakathai piṭakattayai asaṅgāsaṃhīravisāradañāṇacārinā anaikappabhaidasakasamayasamayantaragahanajjhaugāhinā mahāgaṇinā mahāvaiyyākaraṇaina ñāṇābhivaṃsadhammasaināpatināmathairaina mahādhammarājādhirājagarunā katāya sādhuvilāsiniyā nāma līnatthapakāsaniyā brahmajālasuttavaṇṇanāya līnatthavibhāvanā|

brahmajālasuttavaṇṇanā niṭṭhitā|

paṭhamau bhāgau niṭṭhitau|
